https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.body: Korean financial authorities said Thursday they will closely monitor the impact of the U.S. midterm elections on financial markets and take immediate countermeasures if necessary in the event of sharp market fluctuations. Finance Minister Lee Hyoung-il held discussions on the issue with Bank of Korea (BOK) Gov. Shin Hyun-song, Financial Services Commission Chairman Lee Eog-weon and Financial Supervisory Service Gov. Lee Chan-jin after the U.S. Federal Reserve held its benchmark interest rate steady overnight. The Fed decided to maintain the rate in the 3.75-4.00 percent range in a 10-2 vote. The decision left the gap between the key interest rates of Korea and the United States at up to 1 percentage point. "The decision appears to reflect the Fed's continued focus on stabilizing consumer prices while assessing the impact of September's rate hike and other economic indicators to determine its future policy direction," Lee said. Lee noted that earnings and investment outlooks for major technology firms, along with movements in global oil prices, are fueling volatility in financial markets at home and abroad. "We also need to monitor the composition of the U.S. Congress following the midterm elections, changes in Washington's external policies amid the shifting political landscape and their impact on markets," the finance minister added. Lee, however, said Korea's economic fundamentals remain sound, with its gross domestic product (GDP) advancing 1 percent on-quarter in the third quarter. The finance minister pointed out that the U.S. elections and fiscal instability in France may also adversely affect the government bond market, noting that Korea will work with relevant institutions to implement timely market stabilization measures, such as emergency bond buybacks, when necessary. Separately, Lee said he would also discuss with the participants ways to shorten the stock settlement cycle from the current T+2 system to T+1. "Shortening the settlement cycle is an important task as it can reduce related risks and improve the efficiency of fund management," Lee said, noting the government will gather opinions on the matter from market participants. The BOK, meanwhile, said it will continue to keep a close eye on key market developments following the latest Fed decision. "The Fed held its policy rate steady overnight, as expected. However, external risks persist due to lingering tensions in the Middle East, concerns over the fiscal soundness of major countries and uncertainties surrounding artificial intelligence (AI) investment," BOK Senior Deputy Gov. Kwon Min-soo said in a separate statement. Kwon added that the central bank will closely monitor developments in financial and foreign exchange markets, with the European Central Bank and the Bank of Japan also set to make rate decisions this week
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.title_zh: 韩国将密切关注美国中期选举带来的影响
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.body_zh: 韩国金融当局周四表示，将密切关注美国中期选举对金融市场的影响，如市场出现剧烈波动，将立即采取应对措施。美国联邦储备 overnight 维持基准利率不变后，韩国财政部长李亨il与韩国银行（BOK）行长申铉松、金融服务委员会主席李彦元以及金融监督院院长李宰镇就此事进行了讨论。美联储以10票赞成、2票反对的决定，将利率维持在3.75%-4.00%的区间。该决定使韩国与美国的关键利率差距最高达到1个百分点。李亨il说：“这一决定似乎反映出，美联储在评估9月加息及其他经济指标，以确定未来政策方向的同时，继续专注于稳定消费者价格。”李亨il指出，主要科技企业的盈利和投资前景，以及全球油价走势，正在加剧国内外金融市场的波动。财政部长补充道：“中期选举后，我们还需要关注美国国会的构成、政治格局变化背景下华盛顿对外政策的调整及其对市场的影响。”不过，李亨il表示，韩国经济基本面依然稳健，第三季度国内生产总值（GDP）环比增长1%。财政部长指出，美国选举和法国财政不稳定也可能对政府债券市场产生不利影响，并表示韩国将在必要时与相关机构合作，及时采取市场稳定措施，例如紧急回购债券。李亨il还表示，他将与相关参与方讨论如何将目前T+2的股票结算周期缩短至T+1。李亨il说：“缩短结算周期是一项重要任务，因为它能够降低相关风险并提高资金管理效率。”他指出，政府将就此事征询市场参与者的意见。与此同时，韩国银行表示，将继续密切关注美联储最新决定后的重要市场动态。韩国银行高级副行长权民秀在一份单独声明中说：“美联储如预期般 overnight 维持政策利率不变。然而，中东紧张局势持续、主要国家财政稳健性受到质疑，以及人工智能（AI）投资前景的不确定性，使外部风险依然存在。”权民秀补充称，韩国央行将密切关注金融和外汇市场的发展；欧洲中央银行和日本银行也将于本周作出利率决定

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/pol.body: The government plans to designate six new public housing zones in Gyeonggi Province, surrounding Seoul, to build more than 76,700 homes as part of efforts to boost the housing supply, the land ministry said Thursday. The Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport announced the six candidate sites as a follow-up to its August plan to supply 100,000 new homes. The proposed sites are located in Gimpo, Guri, Hanam, Uijeongbu and Goyang in Gyeonggi Province, all within 5 kilometers of Seoul's boundaries and offering relatively easy access to the capital. The ministry said the sites are located in greenbelt areas where environmental conservation value has already been diminished, making them suitable for systematic development. Land Minister Hong Jee-sun stressed the need to expand the housing supply in areas favored by young people and newlyweds, pledging government support to accelerate construction

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.title: S. Korea, US, partners reaffirm N. Korea denuclearization goal, back sanctions enforcement
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.summary: WASHINGTON — South Korea, the United States and other like-minded partners on Wednesday reaffirmed their commitment to the denuclearization of North Korea, highlighting recent sanctions targeting Pyongyang's overseas workers, cyber activities and military cooperation with Russia.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.summary_zh: 华盛顿——韩国、美国及其他志同道合的伙伴周三再次承诺推动朝鲜无核化，并强调近期针对平壤海外劳工、网络活动以及与俄罗斯军事合作的制裁。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body: WASHINGTON — South Korea, the United States and other like-minded partners on Wednesday reaffirmed their commitment to the denuclearization of North Korea, highlighting recent sanctions targeting Pyongyang's overseas workers, cyber activities and military cooperation with Russia. In a joint statement issued by 11 countries and the European Union, the participants welcomed sanctions imposed by the U.S., Australia and the European Union in October to disrupt North Korea's efforts to finance its nuclear weapons and ballistic missile programs. The statement was issued by South Korea, the U.S., Australia, Canada, France, Germany, Italy, Japan, the Netherlands, New Zealand, Britain and the EU. The countries highlighted findings by the Multilateral Sanctions Monitoring Team (MSMT), which shed light on Pyongyang's military cooperation with Russia, cyber-enabled IT worker schemes and overseas labor operations. The team was established after a U.N. expert panel, tasked with monitoring sanctions enforcement, was disbanded in April 2024 due to Russia's veto of a resolution to extend its mandate. It consists of 11 countries, including South Korea, the United States, Japan, Australia and Canada. "The MSMT and EU reaffirm our commitment to the complete, verifiable, and irreversible denuclearization of the DPRK," the statement said, referring to the North's official name, the Democratic People's Republic of Korea. The participants also urged all United Nations member states, particularly permanent members of the Security Council, to fully implement sanctions resolutions against North Korea. Earlier in the day, the U.S. Treasury Department announced fresh sanctions against 10 individuals and one entity accused of facilitating North Korean IT worker schemes targeting American businesses and generating illicit revenue for Pyongyang's weapons programs
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.title_zh: 韩国、美国及合作伙伴重申朝鲜无核化目标，支持加强制裁执行
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body_zh: 华盛顿——韩国、美国及其他志同道合的伙伴于星期三重申了推动朝鲜无核化的承诺，并强调近期针对平壤海外劳工、网络活动以及与俄罗斯军事合作的制裁。在11个国家和欧盟发表的一份联合声明中，参与方对美国、澳大利亚和欧盟于10月实施的制裁表示欢迎，这些制裁旨在阻碍朝鲜为核武器和弹道导弹计划筹资的努力。声明由韩国、美国、澳大利亚、加拿大、法国、德国、意大利、日本、荷兰、新西兰、英国和欧盟发布。这些国家强调了多边制裁监测小组（MSMT）的调查结果，该小组揭示了平壤与俄罗斯的军事合作、利用网络手段运作的信息技术劳工计划以及海外劳工行动。该小组是在一个负责监督制裁执行的联合国专家小组于2024年4月因俄罗斯否决延长其授权的决议而被解散后成立的。小组成员包括11个国家，其中有韩国、美国、日本、澳大利亚和加拿大。声明称：“MSMT和欧盟重申我们致力于实现朝鲜民主主义人民共和国完全、可核查且不可逆的无核化。”声明中“朝鲜”指的是朝鲜的正式名称朝鲜民主主义人民共和国。参与方还敦促联合国所有会员国，特别是安全理事会常任理事国，全面执行针对朝鲜的制裁决议。当天早些时候，美国财政部宣布对10名个人和1个实体实施新制裁，这些个人和实体被指控协助朝鲜利用信息技术劳工计划针对美国企业，并为平壤的武器计划创造非法收入

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.summary: SEATTLE — A former U.S. diplomat said it is "very unusual" for Korean lawmakers to have their official visits disrupted by visa complications, suggesting that stricter interpretations of U.S. immigration rules may be behind the recent difficulties. His comments came after Rep. Jin Sung-joon, chair of the National Assembly's defense committee, disclosed that his U.S. visa application had been marked "refused" ahead of a planned visit to Hawaii in early November.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.summary_zh: 西雅图——一名前美国外交官表示，韩国议员因签证问题而无法按计划进行正式访问“非常不同寻常”，并暗示，近期遇到的困难可能源于美国移民规则得到更严格的解释。此前，国会国防委员会主席 Jin Sung-joon 披露，他的美国签证申请已被标注为“拒签”，而他原计划于11月初前往夏威夷访问。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.body: SEATTLE — A former U.S. diplomat said it is "very unusual" for Korean lawmakers to have their official visits disrupted by visa complications, suggesting that stricter interpretations of U.S. immigration rules may be behind the recent difficulties. Henry Haggard, a former minister counselor for political affairs at the U.S. Embassy in Seoul who now heads a Washington, D.C.-based geopolitical advisory firm, said additional screening for applicants with criminal records is normal, but such procedures have historically rarely prevented senior officials from traveling to the United States on official business. His comments came after Rep. Jin Sung-joon, chair of the National Assembly's defense committee, disclosed that his U.S. visa application had been marked "refused" ahead of a planned visit to Hawaii in early November. Jin was scheduled to lead a parliamentary delegation for meetings with senior U.S. military officials, including Adm. Samuel Paparo, commander of U.S. Indo-Pacific Command. The incident followed a visa delay involving Rep. Jung Chung-rae earlier this month, which forced him to change his planned overseas parliamentary audit itinerary. Haggard said the U.S. Embassy historically worked closely with the State Department and Department of Homeland Security in Washington to facilitate official visits, while keeping South Korean officials informed of possible delays. Such coordination generally allowed trips to proceed, sometimes after minor delays, he said. "Rather than diplomatic shifts, these are most likely due to a stricter interpretation of the rules that limit or prohibit travel by those who have criminal records," Haggard said. He suggested similar difficulties could be occurring elsewhere. Haggard also warned that the visa complications could damage bilateral relations, noting that many South Koreans regard the anti-government protests of the 1980s as central to the country's democratization. He said the violent and anti-American nature of some protests could make U.S. visa waivers harder to obtain, while potentially prompting even strongly pro-American Koreans to reconsider their favorable views of the United States. Jin reportedly was asked to submit court records related to a 1991 conviction under South Korea's National Security Act. He was pardoned in 1995. The State Department's visa tracking system listed his application as "Refused" as of Oct. 28, although that status can also apply to cases undergoing administrative processing. South Korea's foreign ministry has indicated that the application process may still be ongoing
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.title_zh: 美国前外交官：韩国议员遭遇美国签证问题“非常不同寻常”
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.body_zh: 西雅图——一名美国前外交官表示，韩国议员因签证问题导致正式访问行程受阻“非常不寻常”，并暗示，近期困难可能源于美国对移民法规作出了更严格的解释。曾任美国驻首尔大使馆政治事务公使、现领导一家总部位于华盛顿特区的地缘政治咨询公司的亨利·哈加德说，对有犯罪记录的申请人进行额外审查属于正常程序，但此类程序过去很少阻止高级官员赴美执行公务。他的这番评论是在韩国国会国防委员会主席金星埙披露其美国签证申请在计划于11月初访问夏威夷前被标注为“拒签”之后发表的。金星埙原计划率领一个议员代表团，与包括美国印太司令部司令塞缪尔·帕帕罗海军上将在内的美国高级军事官员会面。此前，本月早些时候，韩国议员郑清莱也因签证延误而被迫调整原定的海外议会审计行程。哈加德说，美国大使馆过去通常会与华盛顿的美国国务院和国土安全部密切协作，为正式访问提供便利，同时让韩国官员了解可能出现的延误。他说，这种协调一般能够确保行程成行，有时只会稍有延误。“这更可能是因为对限制或禁止有犯罪记录者出境的规则作出了更严格的解释，而不是外交政策发生了变化。”哈加德说。他暗示，其他地方可能也出现了类似困难。哈加德还警告称，签证问题可能损害韩美双边关系，并指出，许多韩国人将20世纪80年代的反对政府抗议视为韩国民主化的重要组成部分。他说，部分抗议具有暴力性和反美性质，可能使韩国人更难获得美国免签待遇，也可能促使即使强烈亲美的韩国人重新审视他们对美国的友好看法。据报道，金星埙被要求提交与韩国《国家安全法》下1991年定罪有关的法院记录。他于1995年获得赦免。截至10月28日，美国国务院的签证追踪系统将其申请列为“拒签”，不过这一状态也可能适用于仍在接受行政处理的案件。韩国外交部表示，申请程序可能仍在进行中……

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.title: US sanctions N. Korean network accused of defrauding businesses
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.summary: The United States imposed sanctions on Wednesday to target what the Treasury Department said were North Korean government-run schemes that use IT workers to defraud U.S. businesses and generate revenue for Pyongyang's weapons programs. The Treasury Department said the schemes involve North Korean IT workers fraudulently gaining employment with companies in the United States and elsewhere, and Pyongyang taking most of the workers' wages to fund its weapons of mass destruction and ballistic missile programs.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.summary_zh: 美国于周三实施制裁，以打击美国财政部所称由朝鲜政府掌控、利用信息技术人员诈骗美国企业并为平壤武器计划创造收入的阴谋。财政部称，这些阴谋涉及朝鲜信息技术人员通过欺诈手段在 美国及其他地区的公司获得就业，随后平壤拿走这些人员的大部分工资，为其大规模杀伤性武器和弹道导弹计划提供资金。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.body: The United States imposed sanctions on Wednesday to target what the Treasury Department said were North Korean government-run schemes that use IT workers to defraud U.S. businesses and generate revenue for Pyongyang's weapons programs. The Treasury Department said the schemes involve North Korean IT workers fraudulently gaining employment with companies in the United States and elsewhere, and Pyongyang taking most of the workers' wages to fund its weapons of mass destruction and ballistic missile programs. "These networks permeate through the global financial system, necessitating a unified response to match the threat," the department said in a statement, adding that Australia and the European Union also imposed North Korea-related sanctions this month. North Korea's mission to the United Nations in New York did not immediately respond to a request for comment. The sanctions come as U.S. President Donald Trump has been eager to jump-start talks with North Korea, but Pyongyang has shown little interest in diplomacy aimed at containing its nuclear program. However, earlier this month Trump downplayed the idea of another high-profile meeting with Kim in China next month. Trump became the only U.S. president to have met a North Korean leader when he held an unprecedented series of summits with Kim in 2018 and 2019, but the diplomatic efforts broke down over U.S. demands that North Korea give up its nuclear weapons. Trump has since referred to North Korea repeatedly as a "nuclear power," although his administration has continued to call for the country's denuclearization and has not formally recognized it as a nuclear-weapons state. The Treasury Department sanctioned a separate North Korean IT worker network in March
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.title_zh: 美国制裁被控诈骗企业的朝鲜网络
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.body_zh: 美国于周三实施制裁，以打击美国财政部所称的朝鲜政府运作的欺诈计划。这些计划利用信息技术 workers 欺诈美国企业，并为平壤的武器计划创造收入。财政部表示，这些计划涉及朝鲜信息技术人员以欺诈手段受雇于美国及其他地区的公司，而平壤则拿走这些人员的大部分工资，为其大规模杀伤性武器和弹道导弹计划提供资金。该部门在一份声明中表示：“这些网络渗透全球金融体系，因此需要采取统一行动，以应对相关威胁。”声明还指出，澳大利亚和欧盟本月也实施了与朝鲜有关的制裁。朝鲜常驻联合国代表团在纽约没有立即回应置评请求。此项制裁出台之际，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普一直急于重启与朝鲜的谈判，但平壤对旨在遏制其核计划的外交谈判兴趣不大。不过，特朗普本月早些时候淡化了下月在中国再次与金正恩举行高调会晤的想法。2018年和2019年，特朗普与金正恩举行了一系列前所未有的峰会，成为首位与朝鲜领导人会面的美国总统，但美国要求朝鲜放弃核武器，外交努力因此破裂。此后，特朗普多次将朝鲜称为“核国家”，尽管其政府仍继续呼吁朝鲜实现无核化，并且尚未正式承认朝鲜为核武器国家。财政部3月还制裁了一个独立的朝鲜信息技术人员网络

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/20.summary: Korea will ease export restrictions currently imposed on diesel starting in November on condition that domestic supply remains stable, the industry ministry said Thursday. Korea adopted export restrictions on fuel products when it implemented the oil price cap system in March to maintain stable domestic supply. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/20.summary_zh: 韩国产业通商部周四表示，只要国内供应保持稳定，韩国将从11月起放宽目前对柴油实施的出口限制。韩国于3月实施油价上限制度时，对燃料产品采取出口限制，以维持国内供应稳定。产业通商部援引10月和11月原油进口量称，原油供应保持稳定，两个月的进口量均相当于去年同期月均进口量的至少100%。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/20.body: Korea will ease export restrictions currently imposed on diesel starting in November on condition that domestic supply remains stable, the industry ministry said Thursday. The Ministry of Trade, Industry and Resources said the government will allow diesel exports of up to 110 percent of the volume recorded in the same month a year earlier, up from the current cap of 100 percent. The higher cap will apply only when oil refiners fulfill their domestic supply obligations and maintain adequate inventories, the ministry added. Korea adopted export restrictions on fuel products when it implemented the oil price cap system in March to maintain stable domestic supply. Local oil refiners have recently called for such restrictions to be eased. The industry ministry said crude supplies remain stable, citing crude import volumes for October and November equivalent to at least 100 percent of last year's monthly average. "With tensions in the Middle East lingering, the government will closely monitor the supply of petroleum products and immediately reinstate the previous cap should further supply concerns arise," a ministry official said
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/20.title_zh: 在原油供应稳定之际，韩国将有条件放宽柴油出口限制
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/20.body_zh: 韩国产业部周四表示，条件是国内供应保持稳定，韩国将从11月起放宽目前对柴油实施的出口限制。韩国贸易、工业和资源部表示，政府将允许柴油出口量达到去年同期销量的110%，高于目前100%的上限。该部补充称，只有在炼油企业履行国内供应义务并保持充足库存的情况下，新上限才会适用。韩国3月实施石油价格上限制度时，为维持国内稳定供应，开始对燃料产品实施出口限制。当地炼油企业近期呼吁放宽此类限制。产业部援引10月和11月原油进口量相当于去年月均至少100%的数据，称原油供应保持稳定。一位部门官员说：“在中东紧张局势持续的情况下，政府将密切监测石油产品供应，一旦再次出现供应方面的担忧，将立即恢复此前的出口上限。”

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/k.title: Korean traditional arts take center stage on European tour
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/k.summary: Korea’s traditional rhythms, masked dances and epic storytelling are heading to European stages next month in a three-country tour designed to bring the energy of its intangible cultural heritage to international audiences. The tour is intended to raise the international profile of Korean cultural heritage while introducing audiences unfamiliar with its traditional arts to the exuberance and communal spirit at the heart of these performances.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/k.summary_zh: 韩国的传统节奏、假面舞和史诗叙事将于下月登上欧洲舞台，开展三国巡演，把韩国非物质文化遗产的活力带给国际观众。此次巡演旨在提升韩国文化遗产的国际影响力，同时向不熟悉韩国传统艺术的观众介绍这些表演的核心魅力、欢腾氛围和群体精神。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/k.body: Korea’s traditional rhythms, masked dances and epic storytelling are heading to European stages next month in a three-country tour designed to bring the energy of its intangible cultural heritage to international audiences. The National Intangible Heritage Center, under the Korea Heritage Service, said Thursday that “K-Intangible Heritage Festival: Pungjang Korea” would stage performances in Budapest on Wednesday, Podgorica on Nov. 8 and Ankara on Nov. 13. More than 20 performers, including practitioners of nationally recognized intangible heritage and contemporary artists, will combine traditional music, dance and theatrical performance in a production making its European debut. The tour is intended to raise the international profile of Korean cultural heritage while introducing audiences unfamiliar with its traditional arts to the exuberance and communal spirit at the heart of these performances. The program unfolds across four scenes, opening with “Mungut,” a ritual that launches the performance, followed by “Saemgut,” which invokes life and well-being. “Jisinbapgi” draws on the pansori epic “Jeokbyeokga,” reflecting on war and expressing hopes for peace, before “Dwitgut” brings performers and audiences together through music and dance. Among the featured artists is Yoon Jin-cheol, a master performer recognized for his rendition of “Jeokbyeokga,” one of the five surviving traditional pansori epics. The lineup also includes Akdan Gwangchil, The Gwangdae, Yeonhui Jumchuri, contemporary dance troupe Sinabro Gaseume and composer and singer Bang Cho-rong. Director Cheon Jae-hyeon, who staged the center’s 2024 opening performance “Pungjang, Opening a New Path,” will lead the production. The Podgorica performance carries particular significance, coinciding with the 20th anniversary of diplomatic relations between Korea and Montenegro and marking the first presentation of a Korean traditional performance in the country, according to the center. Performances in Hungary and Türkiye are being organized in connection with Touring K-Arts, a program supported by the Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism and the Korean Foundation for International Cultural Exchange. The center said it would use the festival to support international opportunities for practitioners of intangible heritage and build lasting exchanges with overseas cultural institutions. This article was published with the assistance of generative AI and edited by The Korea Times
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/k.title_zh: 韩国传统艺术成为欧洲巡演主角
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/k.body_zh: 韩国的传统节奏、假面舞蹈和史诗讲述将于下月登上欧洲舞台，开启三国巡演，把韩国非物质文化遗产的活力带给国际观众。韩国文化遗产厅旗下国家非物质文化遗产中心周四表示，“非物质文化遗产节：韩国丰釐”将分别于周三在布达佩斯、11月8日在波德戈里察以及11月13日在安卡拉演出。20多名表演者将登台，其中包括国家级非物质文化遗产传承人和当代艺术家；这场制作首次在欧洲上演，将传统音乐、舞蹈和戏剧表演融为一体。此次巡演旨在提升韩国文化遗产的国际知名度，同时让不熟悉韩国传统艺术的观众感受这些表演的核心魅力与群体精神。演出分为四个场景，开场仪式“Mungut”拉开表演序幕，随后通过“Saemgut”祈求生命与安康。“Jisinbapgi”取材于盘索里史诗《Jeokbyeokga》，反思战争并表达对和平的期望，之后“Dwitgut”以音乐和舞蹈串联表演者与观众。参演艺术家包括凭借《Jeokbyeokga》表演而获得认可的大师级表演者尹进哲；《Jeokbyeokga》是现存五大传统盘索里史诗之一。演出阵容还包括Akdan Gwangchil、The Gwangdae、Yeonhui Jumchuri、当代舞蹈团Sinabro Gaseume，以及作曲家兼歌手方初蓉。导演千在贤将执导这场制作；他曾执导该中心2024年的开场演出《Pungjang, Opening a New Path》。据该中心称，波德戈里察的演出意义尤为突出，恰逢韩国与黑山建交20周年，也将首次在该国呈现韩国传统表演。在匈牙利和土耳其的演出由Touring K-Arts项目组织，该项目得到文化、体育和旅游部以及韩国国际文化交流财团的支持。该中心表示，将利用这一节庆活动为非物质文化遗产传承人拓展国际机会，并与海外文化机构建立持久的交流关系。本文在生成式人工智能协助下完成，并由《韩国时报》编辑。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/20.body: Korea Hydro & Nuclear Power Co. (KHNP), Korea's state-run nuclear power operator, said Thursday it has ended negotiations with a local consortium on a construction contract for a nuclear power plant project in the Czech Republic after the two sides failed to agree on key terms. "The company has decided to terminate negotiations with a consortium comprising Daewoo Engineering & Construction and Doosan Enerbility for the Dukovany nuclear power plant project. The breakdown is due to differences over key contract terms," KHNP said in a press release. KHNP said it will formally conclude the negotiations and begin preparations for a tender to select a new contractor. The Dukovany project, valued at about 25 trillion won ($17.5 billion), involves the construction of two 1,000-megawatt APR1000 reactors, a Korean-designed model, in the Czech Republic. A Korean consortium led by KHNP won the project last year. KHNP subsequently negotiated a construction contract with the Daewoo-Doosan consortium, which had been designated as the construction contractor. "The end of the negotiations does not mean the overall nuclear power plant project has been cancelled as KHNP is preparing follow-up measures," the company said
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/20.title_zh: KHNP结束与财团就捷克核电站建设合同的谈判
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/20.body_zh: 韩国水电与核电公司（KHNP）是韩国国营核电运营商。该公司周四表示，在双方未能就关键条款达成一致后，已结束与一个当地联合体就捷克共和国一座核电站项目建设合同进行的谈判。KHNP在一份新闻稿中表示：“公司已决定终止与由现代工程与建设、斗山能源组成的联合体就杜科瓦尼核电站项目进行的谈判。谈判破裂的原因是双方在关键合同条款上存在分歧。”KHNP表示，将正式结束谈判，并为招标选定新承包商做准备。杜科瓦尼项目估值约为25万亿韩元（175亿美元），涉及在捷克共和国建设两座1000兆瓦的APR1000反应堆。该反应堆为韩国设计型号。由KHNP牵头的一家韩国联合体去年赢得了该项目。KHNP随后与此前被指定为建设承包商的现代—斗山联合体商谈建设合同。该公司表示：“谈判结束并不意味着整个核电站项目已被取消，因为KHNP正在准备后续措施。”

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.title: Renault Korea blends French design with Korean lifestyle
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary: Renault Korea is combining French design sensibilities with Korean consumers’ practical needs, blending distinctive driving pleasure with spacious interiors, quiet cabins and advanced convenience features. Renault Korea works with Renault's French design organization to incorporate these expectations into its vehicles, balancing the brand's European aesthetic with the practical requirements of the local market.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary_zh: 雷诺韩国将法国设计理念与韩国消费者的实际需求相结合，融合鲜明的驾驶乐趣与宽敞的车内空间、安静的车厢和先进的便利配置。雷诺韩国与雷诺法国设计团队合作，将这些期待融入旗下车型，在品牌的欧洲美学与本地市场的实际需求之间取得平衡。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body: Renault Korea is combining French design sensibilities with Korean consumers’ practical needs, blending distinctive driving pleasure with spacious interiors, quiet cabins and advanced convenience features. The approach reflects Renault's philosophy of “voitures a vivre,” or cars for living, which views vehicles as spaces where drivers and passengers spend part of their daily lives, rather than simply as means of transportation. Under this concept, exterior styling is only one part of the design process, alongside interior usability, passenger comfort and intuitive technology. Alexandre Malval, Renault's vice president of design, has outlined four core design values: Designed to be Loved, Crafted Space, Electrified by Passion and People-first Tech. The principles emphasize creating vehicles that appeal emotionally while improving the everyday experiences of those inside them, according to Renault Group. Korean consumer preferences play a key role in translating these principles into products. Demand for generous rear-seat space, passenger comfort, multimedia functions and convenient in-car technologies requires automakers to consider how vehicles are used in everyday settings, particularly by families. Renault Korea works with Renault's French design organization to incorporate these expectations into its vehicles, balancing the brand's European aesthetic with the practical requirements of the local market. The carmaker's midsize Grand Koleos flagship SUV illustrates this strategy. The model offers a spacious cabin along with a range of convenience features and an emphasis on quietness. The vehicle's design combines Renault's distinctive styling with the roominess and comfort that Korean consumers often prioritize when choosing family vehicles. The flagship crossover Filante takes the approach further by combining a sleek, sedan-like silhouette with the practicality of an SUV. Its interior follows a “premium tech lounge” concept, integrating advanced driver-focused technology with a cabin designed to accommodate passengers comfortably. Technology is another pillar of Renault's design philosophy. Rather than adding features simply to showcase technological sophistication, the company aims to make displays, driver assistance systems and other functions intuitive and accessible. The goal is to integrate technology naturally into the driving experience without compromising comfort or usability. Renault Korea's strategy reflects an effort to translate the French brand's design identity into products suited to local expectations. Grand Koleos and Filante demonstrate how collaboration between French and Korean design teams can bring that approach to market. "With Filante produced in Korea scheduled to expand into overseas markets, Renault Korea will have an opportunity to test whether a design strategy shaped by Korean consumer preferences can also resonate with international buyers," an official from the carmaker said
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.title_zh: Renault Korea将法国设计与韩国生活方式相融合
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body_zh: 雷诺韩国将法式设计理念与韩国消费者的实用需求相结合，在独特驾驶乐趣与宽敞内饰、安静座舱及先进便利配置之间取得平衡。这一思路体现了雷诺“voitures a vivre”，即“生活之车”的理念：将汽车视为驾驶者和乘客度过部分日常生活的空间，而不仅是交通出行工具。在这一理念下，外部造型只是设计流程的一部分，内部实用性、乘坐舒适性和直观易用的技术同样重要。雷诺设计副总裁Alexandre Malval提出了四项核心设计价值：Designed to be Loved、Crafted Space、Electrified by Passion和People-first Tech。据雷诺集团称，这些原则强调打造能够在情感上吸引消费者、同时改善车内人员日常体验的车型。韩国消费者的偏好是将这些理念转化为产品的关键。对宽敞后排空间、乘坐舒适性、多媒体功能和便捷车载技术的需求，要求汽车制造商考虑车辆在日常场景中的使用方式，尤其是家庭用车需求。雷诺韩国与雷诺法国设计团队合作，将这些期待融入旗下车型，在品牌的欧洲美学与本地市场的实际需求之间寻求平衡。该车企的中型旗舰SUV Grand Koleos体现了这一战略。该车型拥有宽敞座舱，并提供一系列便利配置，同时注重安静性。车辆设计将雷诺鲜明的造型风格与韩国消费者选购家庭用车时经常重视的宽敞空间和舒适性相结合。旗舰跨界车型Filante进一步推进这一理念，将流畅的轿车式轮廓与SUV的实用性融为一体。其内饰采用“高端科技休息室”概念，将以驾驶者为核心的先进技术融入可舒适容纳乘客的座舱。技术是雷诺设计理念的另一支柱。公司并不只是为展示技术先进程度而堆砌配置，而是力求让显示屏、驾驶辅助系统及其他功能直观且易用。其目标是将技术自然融入驾驶体验，同时不妨碍舒适性和实用性。雷诺韩国的战略体现了将这一法国品牌的设计身份转化为符合本地期待的产品所作的努力。Grand Koleos和Filante展示了法国与韩国设计团队如何协作，将这一理念推向市场。该车企一名官员表示：“随着在韩国生产的Filante计划拓展至海外市场，雷诺韩国将有机会验证一种由韩国消费者偏好塑造的设计战略能否同样引起国际买家的共鸣。”

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.title: Shaping the next 30 years of Korea-Germany relations
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.summary: Since the signing of the Korea-Germany Treaty of 1883, the two countries have built a relationship of trust over 143 years through cooperation in politics, business, culture and education. My three years as chairman of ADeKo (Alumninetzwerk Deutschland-Korea) further reinforced my conviction that academic, cultural and youth exchanges are essential foundations for the long-term sustainability of bilateral relations.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.summary_zh: 自1883年签署《韩德条约》以来，两国通过政治、商业、文化和教育合作，在143年间建立了互信关系。我担任ADeKo（德国—韩国校友网络）主席的三年经历进一步坚定了我的信念：学术、文化和青年交流是双边关系长期可持续发展的必要基础。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.body: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz's visit to Korea and his summit with President Lee Jae Myung present an important opportunity to elevate bilateral relations to a new level. Since the signing of the Korea-Germany Treaty of 1883, the two countries have built a relationship of trust over 143 years through cooperation in politics, business, culture and education. Now is the time to consider how we can build upon this historical foundation to shape the next 30 years of our partnership. Having spent more than three decades with BMW Group, I have witnessed firsthand the remarkable results that can be achieved when German technological excellence and long-term strategic thinking are combined with Korea's dynamism and ability to execute. My three years as chairman of ADeKo (Alumninetzwerk Deutschland-Korea) further reinforced my conviction that academic, cultural and youth exchanges are essential foundations for the long-term sustainability of bilateral relations. Although geographically distant, Korea and Germany face remarkably similar challenges. Both countries have built their prosperity on manufacturing and exports. Yet the intensifying strategic rivalry between the United States and China, rising protectionism, the restructuring of global supply chains and the energy transition are fundamentally challenging their traditional growth models. Russia's invasion of Ukraine and North Korea's military cooperation with Russia also demonstrate that European and East Asian security can no longer be viewed separately. Against this backdrop, Korea and Germany must move beyond a partnership centered primarily on trade toward a broader strategic relationship that contributes jointly to economic security, technological innovation and the stability of the international order. This direction was clearly reflected in the 24th Koreanisch-Deutsch Forum, held in Eschborn, Germany, in early September. Representatives from politics, business, academia and civil society emphasized the need for closer strategic cooperation to uphold a rules-based international order and shared democratic values. They also proposed concrete initiatives in economic security, supply chain resilience, medical artificial intelligence (AI) and defense industry cooperation. The challenge now is to turn these discussions into tangible results. We must combine our industrial strengths to create new engines of growth. Germany possesses world-class capabilities in precision engineering, industrial automation, materials and components, supported by a strong ecosystem of medium-sized enterprises. Korea, meanwhile, has competitive strengths in semiconductors, batteries, digital technologies and the rapid commercialization of innovation. These capabilities are highly complementary. Our cooperation should therefore expand beyond traditional trade and individual corporate investments to encompass joint research and development, technology standards, collaboration in third-country markets, industrial AI and smart manufacturing. In particular, closer partnerships between Germany's Mittelstand and Korea's small and medium-sized enterprises could open up significant new growth opportunities. To turn this vision into action, I proposed the establishment of a Seoul-Berlin Business Forum at the Koreanisch-Deutsch Forum in September. The proposal received unanimous support from participants, and the creation of an annual bilateral economic forum was subsequently included in the forum's official policy recommendations. While the existing Koreanisch-Deutsch Forum provides a broad platform for policy dialogue, the proposed Business Forum should serve as an action-oriented platform led by business leaders. Governments should create the necessary institutional environment, while the private sector takes the lead in delivering concrete results. Education and youth exchanges for future generations must become a central pillar of Korea-Germany relations. The 14th Koreanisch-Deutsch Junior Forum, held alongside the main forum in Eschborn, brought together 50 young participants from both countries. They discussed technological sovereignty in the age of AI, economic security, digital democracy, climate technologies and cultural exchange, presenting concrete policy recommendations. Their proposals on industrial AI, supply chain early-warning systems and joint training for young professionals closely reflected the concerns of senior policymakers and business leaders. This experience reaffirmed my belief that young people should not merely be beneficiaries of exchange programs, but active partners in shaping the future of our two countries. During my tenure as chairman of ADeKo, one initiative to which I devoted particular attention was the Youth Exchange Program. The program enables Korean and German high school students to visit each other's schools and host families, study together and experience everyday life in another culture. Beginning in Seoul, we have sought to expand the program nationwide, with the long-term goal of enabling 1,000 students annually to participate in bilateral exchanges. Friendships and mutual understanding formed during adolescence can become invaluable assets connecting our businesses, governments, academic institutions and civil societies 20 or 30 years from now. Greater institutional and financial support is needed to ensure that students from diverse economic backgrounds can participate. Germany's dual vocational education and training system, known as Ausbildung, also offers a valuable model for cooperation. By combining Germany's experience in integrating classroom education with practical workplace training and Korea's strengths in digital technologies and industrial applications, the two countries could develop joint vocational training and internship programs in smart manufacturing and AI. We must broaden the foundations of civil society and cultural exchange beyond governments and businesses. The development of Korea-Germany relations has been made possible by the dedication of countless individuals and organizations. The Koreanisch-Deutsch Gesellschaft, the Korean-German Chamber of Commerce and Industry, ADeKo, universities, research institutions and cultural organizations have all served as important bridges between our two nations. We must now strengthen institutional cooperation and establish more sustainable support mechanisms so that these activities do not depend solely on individual enthusiasm or occasional events. On Nov. 2, the Koreanisch-Deutsch Gesellschaft will celebrate its 70th anniversary. At the commemorative event, former Korean Prime Minister Kim Hwang-sik will receive the 2026 Mirok Li Award in recognition of his contributions to bilateral relations. This occasion reminds us that one of the most valuable assets of Korea-Germany relations is the trust built between people over generations. Just as Li, the Korean writer who lived and worked in Germany, connected the two cultures through literature, exchanges in education, academia, culture and youth engagement continue to deepen mutual understanding and respect. Summits between national leaders can set the direction for cooperation, but it is ultimately businesses, research institutions, educational organizations and civil society that transform this vision into lasting achievements. A strategic partnership cannot be built on declarations alone. It requires regular dialogue, joint projects, sustained youth exchanges and effective mechanisms to turn commitments into action. I hope Chancellor Merz's visit and the 70th anniversary of the Koreanisch-Deutsch Gesellschaft will mark the beginning of a new chapter in which our two countries work together to shape their shared future. The future of Korea-Germany relations should be measured not merely by how much we trade, but by what we create together and what kind of future we prepare for the next generation. Building on the strong foundation of trust established over the past decades, it is time for Korea and Germany to shape the next 30 years together. Kim Hyo-joon is chairman of Future Consulting Group, vice chairman of Koreanisch-Deutsch Gesellschaft and former chairman of BMW Group Korea, Alumninetzwerk Deutschland-Korea and Korean-German Chamber of Commerce and Industry
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.title_zh: 塑造韩德关系未来30年的发展道路
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.body_zh: 德国总理弗里德里希·默茨访问韩国并与李在明总统举行会晤，为提升双边关系至新的高度提供了重要机会。自1883年《韩德条约》签署以来，两国在政治、商业、文化和教育领域的合作中，经过143年建立了互信关系。如今，我们应当思考如何在这一历史基础上再接再厉，塑造未来30年的伙伴关系。我在BMW Group工作30余年，亲眼见证了德国的技术卓越与长期战略思维同韩国的活力和执行能力相结合时，能够取得非凡成果。我担任ADeKo（Alumninetzwerk Deutschland-Korea）主席的3年经历进一步强化了我的信念，即学术、文化和青年交流是双边关系长期可持续发展的坚实基础。尽管地理相隔遥远，韩国和德国却面临着极为相似的挑战。两国都依靠制造业和出口实现繁荣。然而，美国与中国之间日益加剧的战略竞争、保护主义抬头、全球供应链重组以及能源转型，正从根本上挑战着两国传统的增长模式。俄罗斯入侵乌克兰，以及朝鲜与俄罗斯开展军事合作，也表明欧洲和东亚的安全已无法割裂看待。在此背景下，韩国和德国必须超越以贸易为主的伙伴关系，发展更广泛的战略关系，共同为经济安全、技术创新和国际秩序稳定作出贡献。这一方向在9月初于德国埃施博恩举行的第24届Koreanisch-Deutsch Forum上得到了明确体现。来自政界、商界、学术界和公民社会的代表强调，需要加强战略合作，以维护基于规则的国际秩序和共同民主价值观。他们还提出了在经济安全、供应链韧性、医疗人工智能和国防工业合作等方面的具体倡议。当前的挑战在于将这些讨论转化为实实在在的成果。我们必须整合双方的产业优势，打造新的增长引擎。德国拥有世界一流的精密工程、工业自动化、材料和零部件能力，并由强大的中型企业生态系统提供支撑。与此同时，韩国在半导体、电池、数字技术以及创新成果快速商业化方面具备竞争优势。这些能力具有高度互补性。因此，我们的合作应当超越传统贸易和企业单独投资，扩大到联合研发、技术标准、第三国市场协作、工业人工智能和智能制造等领域。尤其是加强德国Mittelstand与韩国中小企业的伙伴关系，有望开辟重要的新增长空间。为将这一愿景付诸行动，我建议在9月的Koreanisch-Deutsch Forum上设立首尔—柏林商业论坛。该提议获得与会者一致支持，随后，建立年度双边经济论坛被纳入论坛的正式政策建议。现有的Koreanisch-Deutsch Forum为政策对话提供了广泛平台，而拟议中的商业论坛则应成为由商业领袖主导、注重行动落实的平台。各国政府应创造必要的制度环境，私营部门则应牵头交付具体成果。面向下一代的教育和青年交流必须成为韩德关系的核心支柱。与主论坛同期在埃施博恩举行的第14届Koreanisch-Deutsch Junior Forum，汇聚了两国50名青年参与者。他们讨论了人工智能时代的技术自主、经济安全、数字民主、气候技术和文化交流，并提出具体政策建议。他们关于工业人工智能、供应链预警系统以及青年专业人士联合培训的建议，与高级政策制定者和商业领袖的关切高度契合。这一经历再次印证了我的看法：年轻人不应只是交流项目的受益者，而应成为塑造两国未来的积极伙伴。我担任ADeKo主席期间，特别关注的一项倡议是青年交流项目。该项目让韩德高中生互访对方学校和寄宿家庭，共同学习并体验另一种文化的日常生活。我们从首尔起步，寻求将项目推广至全国，长期目标是每年让1,000名学生参与双边交流。青春期建立的友谊和相互理解，可能在20年或30年后成为连接两国企业、政府、学术机构和公民社会的宝贵资产。我们需要加强制度支持和资金保障，确保来自不同经济背景的学生都能参与。德国以Ausbildung著称的雙元制职业教育与培训体系，也为双方合作提供了有价值的模式。结合德国将课堂教育与实际工作场所培训相融合的经验，以及韩国在数字技术和工业应用方面的优势，两国可以开发智能制造和人工智能领域的联合职业培训与实习项目。我们必须在政府和企业的基础上，进一步拓宽公民社会和文化交流的根基。韩德关系的发展，凝聚着无数个人和组织的付出。Koreanisch-Deutsch Gesellschaft、韩德工商会、ADeKo、各大学、研究机构和文化组织都已成为两国之间的重要桥梁。现在，我们必须加强机构合作，建立更加可持续的支持机制，使这些活动不再仅仅依赖个人热情或偶发活动。11月2日，Koreanisch-Deutsch Gesellschaft将庆祝成立70周年。纪念活动上，韩国前总理金泓锡将获颁2026年Mirok Li Award，以表彰其对双边关系的贡献。这一时刻提醒我们，韩德关系最宝贵的财富之一，是几代人之间积累的信任。正如旅居德国生活和工作过的韩国作家李铭一通过文学连接两种文化一样，教育、学术、文化和青年参与方面的交流仍在不断加深相互理解与尊重。国家领导人之间的会晤可以确定合作方向，但最终将这一愿景转化为持久成就的，是企业、研究机构、教育组织和公民社会。战略伙伴关系不能仅靠宣言建立，而是需要定期对话、联合项目、持续的青年交流，以及将承诺转化为行动的有效机制。我希望默茨总理的访问和Koreanisch-Deutsch Gesellschaft成立70周年，能够成为两国携手塑造共同未来的新篇章的开端。衡量韩德关系的未来，不仅要看双方贸易额有多大，更要看我们共同创造着什么，以及我们为下一代准备怎样的未来。以过去几十年建立的深厚信任为基础，现在正是韩国和德国携手塑造未来30年的时候。Kim Hyo-joon是Future Consulting Group主席、Koreanisch-Deutsch Gesellschaft副主席，以及BMW Group Korea、Alumninetzwerk Deutschland-Korea和韩德工商会前主席

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.body: South Korean stocks traded 3 percent lower late Thursday morning, reversing earlier gains as Samsung Electronics delivered weaker-than-expected third-quarter earnings. The benchmark Korea Composite Stock Price Index (KOSPI) lost 181.1 points, or 3.01 percent, to 5,831.34 as of 11:20 a.m., after rising as high as 6,100.11. The index opened slightly higher, tracking overnight gains on Wall Street after the Federal Reserve held its benchmark interest rate steady at 3.75-4 percent. The market turned lower shortly before 10 a.m., following the release of Samsung's third-quarter earnings, which fell slightly short of analysts' expectations. The world's largest memory chipmaker reported a record third-quarter operating profit of 107.44 trillion won, up 783.1 percent from a year earlier, while revenue surged 126.9 percent to 195.25 trillion won, on robust artificial intelligence (AI)-driven chip demand. Market bellwether Samsung Electronics fell 6.61 percent, while chip giant SK hynix increased 0.4 percent. Battery maker LG Energy Solution dipped 9.76 percent after its parent company, LG Chem, announced plans to sell 2.5 trillion won worth of shares in the battery subsidiary as part of efforts to boost shareholder value. Shares of construction companies involved in a consortium led by Korea Hydro & Nuclear Power (KHNP) for a nuclear power project in the Czech Republic sank after the state-run nuclear operator said it had ended contract negotiations over disagreements on key terms. Doosan Enerbility plunged 12.21 percent, while Daewoo Engineering & Construction tumbled 21.79 percent following KHNP's announcement. The Korean won was trading at 1,333.5 won against the U.S. dollar at 11:20 a.m., up 8.5 won from the previous stock trading session's close

Lee and Merz are scheduled to hold a summit at Cheong Wa Dae later in the day, followed by a joint press statement and an official dinner, according to Seoul's presidential office.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.summary_zh: 李在明总统计划于周四在首尔与德国总理弗里德里希·默茨举行峰会，讨论扩大两国经济合作的方式。默茨自就任以来首次访问韩国，也是德国总理三年来首次访问该国。首尔总统办公室表示，李和默茨预计于当天晚些时候在青瓦台举行峰会，随后发表联合声明并出席官方晚宴。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body: President Lee Jae Myung was set Thursday to hold a summit with German Chancellor Friedrich Merz in Seoul to discuss ways to expand economic cooperation between the two countries. The trip marks Merz's first visit to Korea since taking office and the first visit by a German chancellor to the country in three years. Lee and Merz are scheduled to hold a summit at Cheong Wa Dae later in the day, followed by a joint press statement and an official dinner, according to Seoul's presidential office. During the talks, the two leaders are expected to discuss economic cooperation in future industries, such as batteries, semiconductors and artificial intelligence, as well as defense and arms industry cooperation, and regional and international issues. "The visit is expected to help advance bilateral ties in a more strategic and forward-looking direction," presidential spokesperson Kang Yu-jung said earlier. The presidential office said some 60 business leaders from Korea and Germany, including Hyundai Motor Group Executive Chair Euisun Chung, have been invited to the dinner to help boost economic ties between the two countries. Merz will also attend the 19th Asia-Pacific Conference of German Business in Seoul during his two-day visit. The two leaders last met on the sidelines of the Group of Seven (G7) summit in France in June. Thursday's summit will be their third meeting since Merz took office
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.title_zh: 李在明拟与德国总理举行峰会，探讨经济合作
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body_zh: 韩国总统李在明将于周四在首尔与德国总理弗里德里希·默茨举行峰会，讨论扩大两国经济合作的方式。这是默茨就任德国总理以来首次访问韩国，也是德国总理三年来首次访韩。首尔总统办公室表示，李在明和默茨预计当天稍晚将在青瓦台举行会谈，随后发表联合声明并出席正式晚宴。会谈期间，两国领导人预计将讨论未来产业领域的经济合作，包括电池、半导体和人工智能，以及国防与军工业合作，并讨论地区和国际问题。总统发言人姜유정早些时候表示：“此次访问预计将推动双边关系朝着更具战略性和前瞻性的方向发展。”总统办公室表示，来自韩国和德国的约60名商界领袖受邀出席晚宴，其中包括现代汽车集团执行主席郑义现，旨在加强两国经济联系。默茨还将在为期两天的访问期间出席在首尔举行的第19届德国亚太企业大会。两国领导人上次会面是在6月于法国举行的七国集团（G7）峰会期间。周四举行的峰会是默茨就任总理以来两者的第三次会面。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary_zh: 特别检察官团队周四将一箱箱选票搬出一座手球体育馆。这些选票自6月地方选举以来一直存放在那里；此次搬运属于对选举日选票短缺事件的调查。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: A special counsel team on Thursday moved boxes of ballot papers out of a handball arena where they had been kept since June's local elections as part of its investigation into ballot shortages on election day. Special counsel Lee Tae-han's team removed the ballot boxes from the Olympic Park Handball Gymnasium in southeastern Seoul after conducting an on-site inspection of the 2.47 million ballots for more than 12 hours until past midnight, according to the National Election Commission (NEC), the state election watchdog. Lee's team has been investigating an unprecedented shortage of ballots that occurred on the day of the June 3 local elections, which forced some people to turn back without casting their votes. All 2.47 million ballots, which had been cast in the southeastern Songpa Ward, were inspected by the special counsel team and placed in some 420 boxes, of which all but 13 were taken to a storage facility managed by the NEC in the capital area, a commission official said. In accordance with the election law, those ballots will be stored for the duration of the elected officials' terms. The remaining 13 boxes were taken by the special counsel team, and the ballots inside them will be inspected further based on objections raised by on-site observers. Some of them will be sent to the National Forensic Service for closer examination. The gymnasium was used as a vote counting center during the elections, but protesters had blocked the ballots' removal since June amid calls for accountability for the shortage and a rerun of the elections. Lee's team has said the examination will not serve as a recount of the votes and is aimed at determining whether there had been any acts of tampering or forgery. The handball arena had effectively been sealed by protesters since the vote count in June. Riot police were deployed to the site during Wednesday's inspection to prevent clashes, and no major incidents have been reported. In addition to on-site observers chosen by the National Assembly, some 100 lawmakers from both the ruling and opposition parties watched the inspection. Dozens of journalists also took part. Jang Dong-hyeok, leader of the main opposition People Power Party, staged a sit-in at the arena overnight to stop the ballot boxes from being removed. "The NEC and the special counsel took the ballot boxes and disappeared as if they were engaging in some operation with the police and fleeing in the middle of the night," Jang told reporters. "The evidence to preserve the people's precious votes has disappeared." Jang went on to claim the inspection revealed "numerous" instances of election fraud, citing damaged seals on ballot boxes, boxes containing ballots from other districts, and ballots of different colors or layouts
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 特别法律顾问团队将地方选举选票从手球馆转移至储存点
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 特别顾问调查小组周四将一批投票用纸搬出一座手球馆。这些选票自6月地方选举以来一直存放在馆内，调查小组正借此调查选举日选票短缺问题。据国家选举委员会（NEC）这一国家选举监督机构介绍，特别顾问李泰宪的团队对247万张选票进行了长达12个多小时、持续至午夜之后的现场检查，随后将投票箱从首尔东南部的奥林匹克公园手球馆搬走。李的团队一直在调查6月3日地方选举当天出现的空前选票短缺事件，短缺导致一些人不得不折返，未能投票。一名委员会官员说，在首尔东南部松坡区投出的全部247万张选票均接受了特别顾问调查小组的检查，并被放入约420个投票箱；除13箱外，其余投票箱均被运往首都地区一处由NEC管理的储存设施。根据选举法，这些选票将在当选官员任期内封存。剩余13箱被特别顾问调查小组带走，箱内选票将根据现场观察员提出的异议作进一步检查。其中一部分将送往国家科学检验研究院接受更仔细的检验。该体育馆在选举期间被用作计票中心，但自6月以来，抗议者一直阻挠选票运出，要求就选票短缺问题追究责任并重新举行选举。李的团队表示，检查不会重新计算选票，而是旨在确定是否存在篡改或伪造行为。自6月计票以来，这座手球馆实际上一直被抗议者封锁。周三检查期间，防暴警察被部署到现场以防止冲突，目前没有重大事件报告。除由国会选出的现场观察员外，执政党和反对党的约100名议员也观摩了检查，数十名记者亦参与其中。主要反对党国民力量党 leader 張东赫在体育馆内彻夜静坐，阻止投票箱被运走。张东赫对记者说：“NEC和特别顾问像是在与警方开展某种行动、半夜仓皇逃走一样，带走了投票箱消失了。保存人民宝贵选票的证据已经不见了。”张东赫进一步声称，检查揭露了“大量的”选举舞弊，包括投票箱封条受损、箱内装有其他选区的选票，以及颜色或版式各异的选票……

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.summary_zh: 韩国央行周四的一项调查显示，受制造业信心稳固和非制造业前景改善推动，韩国10月商业景气度升至四年多以来的高位。根据韩国央行（BOK）的数据，涵盖所有行业的综合商业景气指数（CBSI）10月为104.2，比上月上升5.1点。调查显示，11月前景从上月的99.6上升2.2点至101.8。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.body: South Korea's business sentiment rose to a more than four-year high in October, driven by solid confidence in manufacturing and an improved outlook in nonmanufacturing, a central bank survey showed Thursday. The Composite Business Sentiment Index (CBSI) for all industries stood at 104.2 in October, up 5.1 points from the previous month, according to data from the Bank of Korea (BOK). The reading marked the highest level since August 2022, when the index recorded 105.5 after the COVID-19 pandemic. The index measures corporate outlooks on overall business conditions, with a reading below 100 indicating that pessimists outnumber optimists. "Increased investment and production in major sectors, including semiconductors, automobiles and shipbuilding, boosted related upstream industries," a BOK official said. "A strengthening Korean won also helped local firms ease the financial burden of purchasing imported raw materials." The CBSI among manufacturers climbed 6.1 points on-month to 105.6 in October, marking the highest point in more than four years since June 2022, when the reading stood at 107.1. The manufacturing index had surpassed the 100 mark for the fourth consecutive month after topping the threshold in May for the first time since August 2022 but dropped to 99.5 in September. The index among nonmanufacturers also went up 4.3 points on-month to 103.2, the highest level since September 2022. The outlook for November rose 2.2 points to 101.8 from the previous month's prospect of 99.6, the survey showed. The economic sentiment index, or ESI, which reflects sentiment among both consumers and businesses, went up 0.9 point to 100.8 for October
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.title_zh: 韩国央行：10月商业景气指数升至4年多来高点，前景改善
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.body_zh: 韩国央行周四公布的一项调查显示，得益于对制造业的坚定信心以及非制造业前景改善，韩国10月商业景气升至四年多来的高位。根据韩国央行（BOK）数据，10月全行业综合商业景气指数（CBSI）为104.2，较上月上升5.1点。该读数创下2022年8月以来最高水平，当时新冠疫情之后指数录得105.5。该指数衡量企业对整体经营状况的预期，低于100意味着悲观者多于乐观者。韩国央行一名官员说：“半导体、汽车和造船等主要行业的投资与生产增加，带动了相关上游产业；韩元走强也帮助本地企业减轻了采购进口原材料的财务负担。”10月制造业CBSI环比上升6.1点至105.6，创下2022年6月以来四年多来的最高水平，当时读数为107.1。该制造业指数在5月自2022年8月以来首次突破100关口后，9月曾回落至99.5，但10月已连续第四个月保持在100以上。非制造业指数也环比上升4.3点至103.2，为2022年9月以来最高水平。调查显示，11月预期指数由上月的99.6上升2.2点至101.8。反映消费者和企业双方信心的经济景气指数（ESI）10月上升0.9点至100.8

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary_zh: 随着低成本车型不断推出、燃油费用飙升，韩国电动汽车（EV）市场正显现出在全面普及前跨越鸿沟的明显迹象，对消费者的吸引力日益增强。据韩国汽车与出行协会称，前9个月国内电动汽车销量合计约29.7万辆，超过2025年全年售出的22万辆。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body: Korea’s electric vehicle (EV) market is showing clear signs of crossing the chasm before mass adoption, as lower-cost models and surging fuel expenses make EVs increasingly attractive to consumers. The trend is seen in the increasing demand for used EVs. Their growing popularity could also help ease concerns over resale values — which was considered one of the longstanding obstacles blocking widespread EV adoption. As demand strengthens and prices stabilize, prospective buyers may become less wary of losing money when selling their vehicles, potentially supporting further growth in new EV sales. According to K Car, the country’s major used car sales platform, used all-electric cars took an average of 81 percent as long to sell as internal combustion engine vehicles during the January-September period. In other words, used EVs sold 19 percent faster than their gasoline- and diesel-powered counterparts. EVs also accounted for a share of K Car’s total used car sales that was approximately 32 percent higher than a year earlier during the same period, indicating that consumer interest is gaining traction in the secondhand market as well. The trend is attributable to rising fuel costs and growing interest in environmentally friendly vehicles. The momentum is also evident in the new vehicle market. According to the Korea Automobile and Mobility Association, the number of domestic EV sales reached approximately 297,000 units in the first nine months combined, surpassing the 220,000 units sold throughout 2025. The rapid growth comes as Tesla and China's BYD expand their presence in Korea with competitively-priced models. Their growing sales have helped accelerate the shift toward EVs, challenging the perception that high prices and limited consumer acceptance would keep the market in a prolonged period of sluggish demand. However, the transition remains incomplete. Charging inconvenience, vehicle prices and concerns over battery performance and resale values continue to weigh on some potential buyers, suggesting that the market has yet to reach full mainstream adoption. An industry official said the complete transition to an all-electric market would still take time, but that continued price stabilization and infrastructure expansion would make wider adoption increasingly difficult to avoid. “Consumers are still going through a transition period due to factors such as charging inconvenience and high vehicle prices,” the official said. “But as EV prices stabilize and charging infrastructure expands further, it will be difficult to avoid EVs becoming mainstream before long,” the official said. The growing turnover of used EVs offers an additional sign that consumer acceptance is expanding beyond early adopters. If stronger demand helps support resale values, it could create a reinforcing cycle in which greater confidence in the secondhand market encourages more consumers to consider buying new EVs
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.title_zh: 电动汽车有望跨越韩国市场的鸿沟
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body_zh: 韩国电动汽车市场正明显呈现跨越鸿沟、进入大规模普及阶段的迹象。随着低价车型推出和燃油费用飙升，电动汽车日益受到消费者青睐。这一趋势体现在二手电动汽车需求持续上升。其日益扩大的受欢迎程度也有助于缓解消费者对转售价值的担忧，而转售价值较低一直是阻碍电动汽车广泛普及的长期障碍之一。随着需求走强、价格趋稳，准购车者可能不再那么担心卖车时亏损，从而进一步推动新车电动汽车销量增长。据韩国主要二手车销售平台K Car的数据，1月至9月，二手纯电动汽车的平均售出时间仅相当于内燃机汽车的81%。换言之，二手电动汽车的售出速度比汽油和柴油动力汽车快19%。同期，电动汽车在K Car二手车总销量中的占比较上年同期约提高32%，表明消费者对二手电动汽车的兴趣也在上升。这一趋势归因于燃油价格上涨以及人们对环保车型的兴趣增长。新车市场同样呈现出这一势头。据韩国汽车与移动出行协会的数据，今年前9个月韩国国内电动汽车销量约为29.7万辆，超过2025年全年22万辆的销量。随着特斯拉和中国比亚迪凭借具有竞争力的价格在韩国扩大布局，快速增长的销量有助于加快向电动汽车的转型，也挑战了“高价和消费者接受度有限将使市场长期低迷”的看法。然而，这一转型仍未完成。充电不便、车辆价格以及消费者对电池性能和转售价值的担忧，仍在影响部分潜在买家，表明市场尚未实现全面主流化。一位行业人士表示，全面转向纯电动汽车市场仍需时日，但价格持续趋稳和基础设施不断扩大，将使电动汽车日益难以避免成为主流。该人士说：“由于充电不便和车辆价格较高等因素，消费者仍处于过渡期。”“但随着电动汽车价格趋稳、充电基础设施进一步扩大，电动汽车不久将成为主流将难以避免。”二手电动汽车交易量日益增长，进一步表明消费者接受度正在扩大，不再局限于早期采用者。如果更强劲的需求有助于支撑二手车转售价值，就可能形成一个相互促进的循环：消费者对二手车市场的信心增强，会促使更多人考虑购买新的电动汽车

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary: Food Experience 2026 draws record 19 companies French food and beverage brands gathered in Seoul to court health-conscious Korean consumers, with a record 19 companies taking part in Business France’s Food Experience 2026 exhibition at the French ambassador’s residence and the Kim Chung-up Pavilion, Monday.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary_zh: 美食体验2026创纪录：19家法国食品饮料品牌齐聚首尔，争夺注重健康的韩国消费者。周一，Business France举办的“美食体验2026”展览在法国大使官邸和金忠显 pavilion 举行，共有创纪录的19家企业参加。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body: Food Experience 2026 draws record 19 companies French food and beverage brands gathered in Seoul to court health-conscious Korean consumers, with a record 19 companies taking part in Business France’s Food Experience 2026 exhibition at the French ambassador’s residence and the Kim Chung-up Pavilion, Monday. Now in its fifth year, Food Experience is a business-to-business event connecting French companies with Korean importers, distributors and food service industry professionals. Coinciding with the 140th anniversary of diplomatic relations between the two countries this year, the event featured a record 19 brands, presenting a wide range of products, from those already available in Korea to brands yet to enter the market. A particular focus this year was on companies from Occitania, a major food-producing region in southern France with diverse landscapes stretching from the Mediterranean coast to the Pyrenees and inland agricultural areas. Among them was beverage brand Gopy, which showcased ginger drinks positioned as a milder alternative to Korean ginger. "In France, it is now like a fashion," Anisa Maleck, Gopy's export manager, said. "Koreans are also health-conscious, so we thought this exhibition would be a good opportunity to introduce our products." Another Occitanie brand hoping to reach Korean consumers is Jean Hervé, which specializes in nut-based vegan spreads. "Koreans are familiar with sesame seeds and are very health-conscious, so we thought our low-sugar products could appeal to them," said sales director Ludovic Guillot. Though not from Occitania, French artisanal pasta brand Maison Pâtes Fabre also targeted the wellness segment, showcasing some 50 varieties, including spirulina and gluten-free options. "We use traditional slow, low-temperature drying methods to preserve nutrients and flavor," said Maison Pâtes Fabre chairman, Julien Baucher, said. The event was not just a venue for French companies to explore the Korean market but also was a opportunity for Korean buyers and chefs to discover French ingredients and products. Tanzy Lee, chief marketing officer at specialty coffee brand Terarosa, said she attended the event to explore new ingredients, with the company already using French imports in many of its products. "I came to explore and source ingredients and desserts with a French-inspired style," Lee said. Kim Kyung-yeon, raw material sourcing manager at Lotte Wellfood, said French products remain competitive because there are customers who prefer them. Chef Cho Won-jun of Flour Artisan Bakery, who won first place at the 2023 Le Pain Baguette Championship, considers the event a great gateway to items that can be hard to find in KOrea. This time, his interest was drawn by different cheeses and charcuterie paired with bread. "This kind of event is rare. I'd like to attend every year to discover more varieties and experience different food." Three brand atelier sessions took place, during which French culinary experts and chefs prepared a variety of dishes using ingredients from participating brands, highlighting the unique characteristics of each product and how they could be incorporated into restaurant menus. Chef Choi Min-kyu presented a creative dish using bottarga, or salt-cured fish roe, and pasta. "For the atelier session, I paired bottarga with aged pumpkin. Many people associate French cuisine with high-end, expensive ingredients, but bottarga is actually more affordable than sea urchin roe," he explained, adding that the experience opened his eyes to new possibilities for French ingredients, despite his usual preference for Italian products. Business France said the expanded lineup was designed to showcase the depth and diversity of French agricultural and food products. "We hope the event provided an opportunity for Korean importers, distributors and food service industry professionals to explore the products firsthand and identify new opportunities for distribution partnerships and menu development," it said in a statement

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body_zh: 法国食品体验展2026吸引创纪录的19家企业，众多法国食品和饮料品牌齐聚首尔，瞄准注重健康的韩国消费者。周一，Business France举办的“法国食品体验2026”展在法国大使官邸和金忠显 Pavilion举行，共有创纪录的19家企业参加。已进入第五年的“法国食品体验”是一项面向企业的活动，旨在连接法国企业与韩国进口商、经销商及餐饮服务行业专业人士。今年恰逢两国建交140周年，活动展出了创纪录的19个品牌，呈现种类繁多的产品，既有已在韩国上市的产品，也有尚未进入该市场的品牌。今年的一大重点是来自法国南部重要食品产区的奥克西塔尼大区企业，该地区地貌多样，从地中海沿岸延伸至比利牛斯山脉及内陆农业区。其中包括饮料品牌Gopy，该品牌展示了以姜为原料的饮品，并将其定位为比韩国姜饮料口感更温和的替代选择。Gopy出口经理Anisa Maleck表示：“在法国，这如今已经成为一种时尚。韩国人也非常注重健康，所以我们认为这次展览是推介我们产品的好机会。”另一家希望开拓韩国消费者的奥克西塔尼大区品牌是Jean Hervé specializes in nut-based vegan spreads。Jean Hervé specializes in nut-based vegan spreads，专注于以坚果为原料的纯素涂抹酱。销售总监Ludovic Guillot表示：“韩国人熟悉芝麻，而且非常注重健康，所以我们认为低糖产品能够吸引他们。”法国手工意面品牌Maison Pâtes Fabre虽然并非来自奥克西塔尼大区，但同样瞄准健康养生市场，展示了约50种产品，包括螺旋藻意面和无麸质选项。Maison Pâtes Fabre董事长Julien Baucher表示：“我们采用传统的低温慢速干燥方法，以保留营养成分和风味。”这场活动不仅是法国企业探索韩国市场的平台，也为韩国采购商和厨师了解法国食材与产品提供了机会。精品咖啡品牌Terarosa首席营销官Tanzy Lee表示，她参加活动是为了探索新食材，该公司许多产品已经使用法国进口原料。Lee说：“我来这里探索并采购具有法式风格的食材和甜点。”乐天wellfood原材料采购经理Kim Kyung-yeon表示，法国产品仍具有竞争力，因为有顾客偏爱这些产品。Flour Artisan Bakery主厨Cho Won-jun曾赢得2023年Le Pain Baguette锦标赛冠军，他认为这是一次了解在韩国难以寻觅食品的绝佳机会。这一次，他关注的是搭配面包的各类奶酪和肉制品。“这类活动很少见。我想每年参加，发现更多品类，体验不同的美食。”活动还举行了3场品牌工作坊体验活动，法国烹饪专家和厨师使用参展品牌的食材制作了多种菜肴，突出每种产品的独特特性，以及如何将其融入餐厅菜单。主厨Choi Min-kyu呈现了一道以鱼子酱和意面为主角的创意菜肴。鱼子酱即盐渍鱼卵，他解释道：“在这次工作坊活动中，我将鱼子酱与陈年南瓜搭配。许多人把法国美食与高端、昂贵食材联系在一起，但实际上鱼子酱比海胆卵更实惠。”尽管他平时更偏爱意大利产品，但这次体验让他发现了法国食材的更多新可能。Business France表示，扩充参展阵容旨在展示法国农业和食品的深度与多样性。该机构在一份声明中说：“我们希望此次活动为韩国进口商、经销商和餐饮服务行业专业人士提供亲身体验产品的机会，并发掘新的分销合作和菜单开发机会。”

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: University education should change how students think, not just what they know Editor’s note This is the seventh in a series of interviews as The Korea Times speaks with leading university presidents across the globe to examine how institutions are redefining education, research and international collaboration in an era shaped by artificial intelligence, demographic shifts and geopolitical uncertainty. The series is supported by the Korea Press Foundation's Press Promotion Fund. HONG KONG — When asked how artificial intelligence (AI) is changing higher education, Jay S. Siegel, vice president of the University of Hong Kong (HKU), began by challenging the premise of the question. “I don’t think that higher education is moving beyond content delivery and into critical thinking,” he said during an interview with The Korea Times on the university’s campus. Siegel, who also serves as pro-vice-chancellor for teaching and learning, argued that leading universities have always sought to develop independent thinkers. What concerns him more is whether universities place too much emphasis on grades and examinations rather than encouraging students to develop a lasting desire to learn. Siegel believes examinations are valuable primarily because they encourage students to study, rather than because of the grades they produce. Preparing for a test requires students to read, think and engage with material, and that effort may matter more than the eventual score. A student who studies diligently but receives 70 percent instead of 85 percent may still have gained considerably from the experience, he explained. “Again, it’s a behavioral modification, not an outcome,” he said. He pointed out that some highly creative people performed poorly in school, even though they may have studied hard and discovered new interests while preparing for exams. Conversely, students who excel at memorizing and reproducing information may not develop the intellectual habits needed to become creative thinkers. Siegel also questioned the assumption that a student with a 4.0 grade point average is necessarily better equipped for intellectual growth than one with a 3.0. Placing excessive value on grades, he argued, can encourage students to seek external approval rather than question their own knowledge and judgment. “In some ways, the 3.0 student is better off because she questions her own knowledge,” he said. Such students may be more willing to examine their shortcomings and ask what they need to do differently, he explained. Siegel stressed that his personal philosophy should not be taken as HKU’s official position on assessment. He does not advocate eliminating examinations or relaxing standards for factual accuracy. Instead, he believes universities should focus more on what drives students to learn than on the grades they receive. At HKU, Siegel said, AI has a role to play in administration, teaching and research. AI could simplify admissions procedures, freeing staff to focus on other work. Researchers, meanwhile, could use AI to spot patterns in large amounts of data that might otherwise go unnoticed. In teaching, he believes AI could help students prepare for more productive discussions with their professors. He described a learning environment in which students could use AI to access lectures and reading materials and ask questions whenever they encounter difficulties. HKU is working to support this through its AI Hub, which offers AI-based applications such as Ark Junior. Such tools could encourage students to make reading, questioning and independent thinking part of their daily routine. By the time they meet their professors, they would be ready for more substantial discussions, rather than simply receiving information. “Then when you get to finally sit with the professor, now you get great value,” he said. For Siegel, the aim is not to replace educators or other university employees with technology, but to give them more time for work that requires human judgment and creativity. “We’re not interested in replacing people as much as we are in making sure that these very talented people that we’ve hired have more time,” he said. Having spent five decades in higher education, Siegel said universities were already emphasizing inquiry and critical thinking in the 1970s. Students were expected to acquire much of their factual knowledge independently, while professors helped them develop intellectual maturity and the analytical skills needed to ask meaningful questions. What matters most, he argued, is whether an education changes the way students behave long after they have completed their courses. “Teaching is not done through certificates and degrees. Teaching is done by changing behavior,” he said. He offered the example of a writing course. Even if students earn excellent grades and understand the principles of effective writing, the course has accomplished little if they never develop the habit of writing afterwards. He described universities as communities of scholars in which students develop relationships that sustain learning throughout their lives. Even years after graduation, students can keep learning from the people they met at university, he said. AI may make knowledge easier to obtain, but Siegel noted that libraries have long contained far more information than any individual could absorb. Access to knowledge alone has never been sufficient to explain the value of university education. “Knowledge is not the same as wisdom,” he said. “Wisdom manifests in the creative character of what questions one asks and in the maturity of the decisions we make. Wisdom comprises personal knowledge and social experience without being limited or fully defined by them.” As HKU seeks to strengthen connections between academic and campus life, Siegel said he wants graduates to carry with them a distinctive way of thinking, rather than merely a collection of qualifications. His ambition is that even a decade after graduation, a brief conversation with an HKU alumnus would reveal how the university had shaped that person’s outlook, intellectual habits and approach to life
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 港大副校长称，人工智能时代，动机比成绩更重要
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh:
大学教育应改变学生的思维方式，而非仅仅传授知识

编者按：这是《韩国时报》系列访谈的第七期，该系列邀请全球顶尖大学校长，探讨各院校如何在人工智能、人口结构变化和地缘政治不确定性塑造的时代，重新定义教育、科研与国际合作。本系列由韩国新闻基金会新闻促进基金支持。

香港——当被问及人工智能（AI）如何改变高等教育时，香港大学（HKU）副校长杰伊·S·西格尔（Jay S. Siegel）首先质疑了这一问题的前提。在《韩国时报》对该校校园进行的采访中，他说：“我认为，高等教育并没有超越知识传递、进入批判性思维阶段。”西格尔还兼任负责教学与学习的副校长。他认为，顶尖大学一直致力于培养独立思考者。让他更为担忧的是，大学是否过分强调成绩和考试，而非鼓励学生形成持久的学习欲望。

西格尔认为，考试之所以有价值，主要在于它能促使学生学习，而非取决于考试给出的分数。准备考试要求学生阅读、思考并理解材料，这种努力可能比最终得分更重要。他解释说，一名勤奋学习但取得70%而非85%成绩的学生，仍可能从这一经历中获得很大提升。“归根结底，这是一种行为上的改变，而不是一个结果。”他说。他指出，有些极具创造力的人在校园里表现不佳，尽管他们可能学习刻苦，并在备考过程中发现了新的兴趣。相反，善于记忆和复述信息的学生，可能无法形成成为创造性思考者所需的思维习惯。

西格尔还质疑了这样一种假设： GPA为4.0的学生必然比GPA为3.0的学生更有条件实现智识成长。他认为，过度看重成绩可能促使学生寻求外界认可，而不是质疑自己的知识与判断。“在某些方面，3.0的学生处境更好，因为她会质疑自己的知识。”他说。他解释道，这类学生可能更愿意审视自身不足，并思考自己需要作出哪些改变。

西格尔强调，他的个人观点不应被视为香港大学对评估工作的官方立场。他并不主张取消考试，也不主张放宽对事实准确性的标准。相反，他认为大学应更加关注促使学生学习的动力，而非他们获得的成绩。

西格尔表示，在香港大学，人工智能可以在行政管理、教学和研究中发挥作用。人工智能可以简化招生流程，使工作人员腾出时间处理其他工作。与此同时，研究人员可以利用人工智能，从大量数据中发现原本可能被忽略的模式。在教学方面，他认为人工智能可以帮助学生为与教授开展更有成效的讨论做好准备。他描述了一种学习环境：学生可以利用人工智能获取讲座和阅读材料，并在遇到困难时随时提问。香港大学正通过其人工智能中心支持这一模式，该中心提供基于人工智能的应用，如Ark Junior。此类工具可以鼓励学生将阅读、提问和独立思考融入日常生活。等到与教授见面时，他们便已准备好进行更深入的讨论，而非只是被动接收信息。“这样，当你最终与教授坐下来交流时，就能获得更大的价值。”他说。

在西格尔看来，目标不是用技术取代教育工作者或其他大学员工，而是让他们拥有更多时间从事需要人类判断力和创造力的工作。“与取代人员相比，我们更希望确保自己聘用的这些才华出众的人才拥有更多时间。”他说。

西格尔在高等教育领域工作已有50年。他表示，早在20世纪70年代，大学就已开始强调探究和批判性思维。学生被要求自主掌握大量事实性知识，同时由教授帮助他们形成智识成熟度，以及提出有意义的问题所需的分析能力。他认为，最重要的是教育能否在学生完成课程多年之后仍改变其行为方式。“教学不是通过证书和学位完成的。教学通过改变行为来完成。”他说。

他以写作课程为例。即使学生取得了优异成绩并理解了有效写作的原则，但如果他们此后从未养成写作的习惯，这门课程取得的成效仍然微乎其微。他将大学描述为由学者组成的共同体，学生在其中建立能够支撑终身学习的人际关系。他说，即使毕业多年之后，学生仍可向自己在大学期间结识的人继续学习。

人工智能或许能让知识更容易获得，但西格尔指出，图书馆长期以来所收藏的信息，也远非任何个人所能全部吸收。仅仅获得知识，从来不足以说明大学教育的价值。“知识不等同于智慧。”他说，“智慧体现在一个人提出何种问题的创造性特质中，也体现在我们作出决定时的成熟度中。智慧包含个人知识和社会经验，却不受二者限制，也无法仅由二者完全界定。”

西格尔表示，在香港大学努力加强学术生活与校园生活联系之际，他希望毕业生带走的是一种独特的思维方式，而非仅仅是一组学历证书。他的目标是，即便在毕业十年之后，与一位香港大学校友进行一次简短交谈，也能看出这所大学如何塑造了对方的眼界、思维习惯和面对生活的方式

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026102909.title: '투표용지 부족사태·올공 시위' 마무리…선관위 개혁은 진행형
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026102909.summary: (서울=연합뉴스) 박경준 기자 = 선거관리위 특별검사팀이 서울 올림픽공원 핸드볼경기장에서 현장검증을 실시하고 해당 투표용지가 다른 장소로 반출되면서 이른바 투표용지 부족 사태가 새 국면을 맞고 있다. 6·3 지방선거 이후 148일 만에 올림픽공원 봉쇄 시위 상황이 해소되면서 선관위 및 선거 제도 개혁 문제로 정치권의 논의가 다시 집중될 조짐을 보이고 있어서다. 여야 모두 투표용지 부족사태 초반부터 개혁안을 내놓았으나, 정파적 이해관계가 크게 엇갈리는 개헌 문제와 맞물려 있어서 어느 정도나 성과를 만들어낼지는 불투명한 상황이다.
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026102909.summary_zh: （首尔=韩联社）记者 박경준 = 选举管理委员会特别检察官团队在首尔奥林匹克公园手球赛场进行现场核验。随着相关选票被运往其他场所，所谓的选票短缺事件进入新阶段。在6月3日地方选举结束148天后，奥林匹克公园的封锁示威局势得到化解，政界围绕选举管理委员会及选举制度改革的讨论再次成为焦点。执政党和在野党均从选票短缺事件初期起提出改革方案，但由于相关议题与利益分歧巨大的修宪问题交织，能否取得一定成果仍不明朗。
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026102909.body: (서울=연합뉴스) 박경준 기자 = 선거관리위 특별검사팀이 서울 올림픽공원 핸드볼경기장에서 현장검증을 실시하고 해당 투표용지가 다른 장소로 반출되면서 이른바 투표용지 부족 사태가 새 국면을 맞고 있다. 6·3 지방선거 이후 148일 만에 올림픽공원 봉쇄 시위 상황이 해소되면서 선관위 및 선거 제도 개혁 문제로 정치권의 논의가 다시 집중될 조짐을 보이고 있어서다. 여야 모두 투표용지 부족사태 초반부터 개혁안을 내놓았으나, 정파적 이해관계가 크게 엇갈리는 개헌 문제와 맞물려 있어서 어느 정도나 성과를 만들어낼지는 불투명한 상황이다. 이번 사태는 지방선거가 치러진 지난 6월 3일 송파구 내 복수의 투표소에서 투표용지가 부족해 유권자들이 대기하는 상황에서 촉발됐다. 문제가 발생한 원인으로는 '유권자의 60%'로 돼 있던 투표용지 최소 인쇄 기준을 '유권자의 50%'로 낮춘 것이 지목됐다. 이재명 대통령은 선관위를 향해 "신뢰를 잃었다"며 국민에 유감을 표했고, 검찰과 경찰이 참여하는 합동수사본부를 구성해 철저히 진상을 규명하라고 지시했다. 송파구 투표지 약 247만장이 보관된 올림픽공원 핸드볼경기장 앞에서는 투표지 반출을 막아선 시위가 이어졌다. 시위에 참석한 이들은 부정선거 가능성까지 주장한 가운데 국민의힘 장동혁 대표가 이들에 합류해 장외집회에 참석하기도 했다. '제9회 전국동시지방선거 투표용지 부족 사태 등 국민 참정권 침해 진상규명 및 선거관리 개혁을 위한 국정조사 특별위원회'는 6월 18일에 첫 회의를 열고 본격적인 활동에 들어갔다. 그러나 여야는 재검표 실시와 특위 활동 기간 연장 등을 놓고 이견을 좁히지 못했고, 진상 규명과 책임 소재도 결론을 내지 못한 채 선관위 특검법안을 통과시켰다. 9월부터 활동에 들어간 이태한 특별검사팀은 그사이에 드러난 지역 선관위의 투표율 허위 입력 정황을 포함해 선관위 압수수색 등 대대적인 수사를 벌였다. 특검팀이 전날 시작한 투표용지 공개검증은 이날 새벽까지 이어졌고, 선관위가 관리 중인 수도권의 창고로 투표용지가 이송되며 올림픽 공원 시위도 사실상 마무리됐다. 투표용지 부족 사태를 계기로 동일한 사고의 재발을 막고, 근본적으로 선관위를 개혁하려는 움직임이 나타나고 있다. 우선 선관위는 이달 2일 공직선거관리규칙을 개정해 현장 투표 중단 사태를 막고자 전체 선거인 수의 80% 이상에 해당하는 투표용지를 인쇄하도록 했다. 사전투표 관리 부실 해소, 외부 감사관 도입 등의 내용을 담은 공직선거법 개정안, 대법관이 겸직 중인 중앙선관위원장을 상근화하는 내용을 규정한 선관위법 개정안 등이다. 민주당은 선거제도 개혁 태스크포스(TF)를 만들어 선관위법, 인사청문회법, 국회법 개정안 등 '선관위 개혁 3법'을 당론으로 발의한 상태다. 중앙선관위원장을 상임으로 바꾸고 중앙선관위에 감사위원회를 설치하는 한편, 감사 내용은 국회에 제출하도록 해 선관위에 대한 국회 감시를 강화하는 게 골자다. 국민의힘도 선거관리 개혁 특위를 만들어 사전투표제를 폐지하고 본투표 기간을 이틀로 연장하는 방안을 담은 관련 법 개정안을 당론으로 채택한 바 있다. 중앙선관위원장뿐만 아니라 시도 선관위원장도 상근화하고, 모든 선거구에서 투표용지를 선거인 대비 100% 수준으로 인쇄하도록 하는 내용도 담겼다. 이처럼 여야가 선관위 개혁안을 마련해 추진하지만, 개헌 문제 등을 놓고 시각이 엇갈려 좀처럼 그 처리에는 속도가 나지 않는 상황이다. 여당은 선관위의 근본적인 개혁을 위해 감사원의 직무감찰을 허용하는 내용 등을 담아 개헌까지 이뤄져야 한다는 입장이다. 그러나 국민의힘은 이 같은 주장이 정략적이라고 보고 개헌에 반대하며 법안 개정에 속도를 내야 한다고 맞서는 형국이다. 제보는 카카오톡 okjebo <저작권자(c) 연합뉴스, 무단 전재-재배포, AI 학습 및 활용 금지> 2026/10/29 11:41 송고 2026년10월29일 11시41분 송고 (서울=연합뉴스) 류영석 기자 = 28일 선관위 특검의 6·3 지방선거 투표용지 공개검증이 열리는 서울 송파구 올림픽공원 핸드볼경기장에서 검증참관인으로 참석한 국민의힘 장동혁 대표가 검증 준비 상황을 지켜보고 있다. 2026.10.28 ondol@yna.co.kr (서울=연합뉴스) 이태한 선거관리위원회 특별검사가 28일 6·3 지방선거 투표용지 공개 검증을 위해 서울 올림픽공원 핸드볼경기장에 도착해 대기하고 있다. 2026.10.28 [사진공동취재단] photo@yna.co.kr (서울=연합뉴스) 이태한 선거관리위원회 특별검사팀의 공개검증을 마친 6·3 지방선거 송파지역 투표함이 29일 서울 송파구 올림픽공원 핸드볼경기장에서 반출되고 있다. 2026.10.29 [연합뉴스TV 제공. 재판매 및 DB금지] photo@yna.co.kr
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026102909.title_zh: “选票短缺风波与全公职罢工”落幕……中央选举管理委员会改革仍在推进
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026102909.body_zh:
（首尔=韩联社）记者朴京俊=选举管理委员会特别检察组在首尔奥林匹克公园手球比赛馆进行现场验证，同时相关选票被运往其他地点，所谓的选票不足事件因此进入新阶段。在6·3地方选举结束148天后，奥林匹克公园封锁和示威局面得到化解，政界对选管委以及选举制度改革的讨论再次成为焦点。执政党和在野党从选票不足事件初期起便各自提出改革方案，但由于相关问题与利益分歧严重对立的修宪问题相互交织，究竟能取得多大成果仍不明朗。此次事件于6月3日地方选举当天，因松坡区内多个投票站选票不足、选民排队等候而引发。问题原因被指在于，原先规定最低印刷量须达到“选民人数的60%”的选票印刷标准被下调至“选民人数的50%”。李在明总统向选管委表示“已失去信任”，向国民表达歉意，并指示成立由检察和警方参与的联合调查本部，彻底查明真相。约247万张松坡区选票原本存放于奥林匹克公园手球比赛馆前，为阻止选票运走，示威持续进行。参加示威者在主张存在选举舞弊可能的同时，国民力量党党首张东赫也加入其中，并出席了一场场外集会。“第9届全国同时地方选举选票不足事件等侵害国民参政权真相调查及选举管理改革国政调查特别委员会”于6月18日举行首次会议，正式展开活动。然而，执政党和在野党在是否重新计票、延长特别委员会活动期限等方面未能缩小分歧，在尚未得出真相调查和责任归属结论的情况下，便通过了选管委特别检察法案。自9月启动活动的选举管理委员会特别检察官李泰汉团队，期间展开了大规模调查，包括对地方选管委虚报投票率等情况的调查，以及查封选管委。特別检察组前一天启动的选票公开验证持续至当天凌晨，随着选票被运往选管委管理的首都圈仓库，奥林匹克公园的示威也基本结束。以此次选票不足事件为契机，为防止类似事故重演、从根本上改革选管委的社会行动正在出现。首先，选管委于本月2日修订《公职选举管理规则》，为防止现场投票中断，决定印刷相当于全部选民人数80%以上的选票。相关内容包括修订《公职选举法》，以解决提前投票管理不善的问题并引入外部审计人员；以及修订《选管委法》，规定由最高法院法官兼任的中央选管委委员长改为专职担任。民主党已成立选举制度改革专项组（TF），并以党内名义提出《选管委法》《人事听证会法》《国会法》等修订案，即“选管委改革三法”。其核心内容包括将中央选管委委员长改为常任，并在中央选管委内设立审计委员会，同时要求将审计结果提交国会，以加强对选管委的国会监督。国民力量党也已成立选举管理改革特别委员会，并以党内名义通过相关法律修订案，内容包括废除提前投票制度、将正式投票日延长为两天等。相关修订案还包括，不仅中央选管委委员长，各地方选管委委员长也改为专职担任，并在所有选区按照与选民人数100%左右的规模印刷选票。尽管执政党和在野党都已制定并推动选管委改革方案，但由于双方在修宪等问题上意见相左，相关处理进展缓慢。执政党主张，为从根本上改革选管委，应允许审计人员对官员履职情况进行监察，甚至需要推进修宪。然而，国民力量党认为此类主张具有政治目的，反对修宪，并主张应加快法案修订进程。对此，报道可通过KakaoTalk okjabo <版权所有(c) 韩联社，未经许可禁止转载和再分发，禁止用于人工智能学习及使用> 2026/10/29 11:41发布 2026年10月29日11时41分发布

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026102910.summary: (서울=연합뉴스) 전명훈 기자 = 국방부는 29일 최근 북한이 황해도 개풍군 해안가 접경지역에 구형 자주포를 노출한 의도와 관련해 "보이는 곳에 포를 배치하는 것 자체가 군사적으로, 전술적으로 아예 맞지 않은 얘기"라고 말했다. 정빛나 대변인은 이날 정례브리핑에서 관련 질문에 이같이 밝히고 "군은, 합참은 모든 것을 예의주시하고 어떤 것도 단호하게 대응할 수 있는 대비 태세를 갖추고 있다"고 덧붙였다. 포병 전력의 기본 전술인 은폐·엄폐를 생략하고 방호벽이나 위장막도 없이 구형 자주포를 노출한 것은 실제 군사적 위협이라기보다 대외 과시용 '보여주기식' 무력시위라는 취지의 설명이다.

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026102906.body: (서울=연합뉴스) 조성흠 기자 = 삼성전자가 올해 3분기 반도체 사업으로만 106조원이 넘는 영업이익을 거두며 4분기 연속 역대 최대 실적과 동시에 글로벌 빅테크 최초의 분기 100조원대 이익 기록을 달성했다. 완제품 사업은 반도체 등 부품가 상승 부담이 갈수록 커진 결과 2분기 연속 적자를 기록했으나, 모바일 사업부는 적자 폭을 축소하며 반등을 시도했다. 삼성전자는 4분기는 물론 내년에도 반도체 가격 상승세가 이어지며 실적 개선세가 이어질 것으로 보고, 인공지능(AI) 시장 선점과 중장기 수요 대응을 위한 인프라 투자를 이어갈 계획이다. 삼성전자[005930]는 연결 기준 올해 3분기 영업이익이 107조4천405억원으로 지난해 동기보다 783.1% 증가한 것으로 잠정 집계됐다고 29일 공시했다. 매출은 195조2천532억원으로 작년 동기 대비 126.9% 증가했다. 순이익은 75조1천361억원으로 514.6% 늘었다. 환 영향은 달러, 유로 등 주요 환율의 하락에 따라 부품 사업을 중심으로 전사 영업익에 전분기 대비 10조원 수준의 부정적 효과가 발생했다. 반도체 사업을 담당하는 디바이스솔루션(DS) 부문은 매출 147조1천억원, 영업익 106조5천억원을 기록했다. AI 수요 증가에 발맞춰 6세대 고대역폭 메모리(HBM)인 HBM4 판매를 대폭 확대했으며, 서버용 솔리드 스테이트 드라이브(SSD) 수요 증가에도 적극 대응해 역대 최대 분기 실적을 달성했다. 시스템LSI는 하반기 신모델에 시스템온칩(SoC)과 이미지 센서를 탑재하며 분기 매출이 성장했고, 신규 고객과 커스텀 SoC 사업도 구체화했다. 파운드리는 HBM 베이스 다이의 매출 성장과 글로벌 거래선의 선단공정 판매 확대 영향으로 실적이 크게 개선됐으며, 대형 하이퍼스케일러(대규모 데이터센터 운영사)를 중심으로 수주를 지속했다. 모바일 사업을 맡은 MX 사업부는 갤럭시 Z 폴드8 등 플래그십 신모델 출시로 전분기 및 전년 대비 매출이 성장했다. 비용 부담 확대에도 불구하고 프리미엄 제품 판매 비중 증가에 따른 평균판매단가(ASP) 상승으로 실적이 개선됐다. TV 사업을 맡은 VD 사업부는 글로벌 스포츠 이벤트 종료로 수요가 감소했으나, 프리미엄 제품 판매를 확대하고 비용을 효율화해 수익성 하락폭이 제한됐다. 생활가전은 국내 마케팅 활동 강화, 가전 구독 및 기업간거래(B2B) 사업 확대 영향으로 판매는 호조를 보였으나, 원자재 비용 및 물류비용 상승으로 이익이 감소했다. AI 인프라 투자가 지속 확대되는 시장 환경 속에서 메모리 수요가 공급을 크게 상회할 것으로 예상되는 가운데, 삼성전자는 월등한 기술을 바탕으로 HBM4 판매 확대 및 HBM4E 양산, 고성능 DDR5 등 고부가가치 제품 중심의 판매 기조를 강화할 방침이다. 삼성전자는 현재와 같은 공급 부족이 2028년까지 이어질 것으로 보면서도 여러 변수를 고려해 투자 전략을 운용할 계획이다. 선제적 인프라 투자를 통해 클린룸을 확보한 뒤 수요 변화를 면밀히 살피면서 설비 도입을 탄력적으로 실행하겠다는 기조다. 삼성전자는 올해 시설투자를 84조4천억원 규모로 집행할 예정이다. 부문별로는 DS 부문이 76조8천억원, 디스플레이가 3조9천억원 등이다. 제보는 카카오톡 okjebo <저작권자(c) 연합뉴스, 무단 전재-재배포, AI 학습 및 활용 금지> 2026/10/29 11:39 송고 2026년10월29일 11시39분 송고 (서울=연합뉴스) 윤동진 기자 = 삼성전자가 4분기 연속 역대 최대 실적을 기록한 가운데 반도체 사업으로만 106조원이 넘는 영업이익을 거둔 것으로 나타났다. 삼성전자는 연결 기준 올해 3분기 영업이익이 107조4천405억원으로 지난해 동기보다 783.1% 증가한 것으로 잠정 집계됐다고 29일 공시했다. 사진은 이날 서울 서초구 삼성타운. 2026.10.29 mon@yna.co.kr (서울=연합뉴스) 윤동진 기자 = 삼성전자가 4분기 연속 역대 최대 실적을 기록한 가운데 반도체 사업으로만 106조원이 넘는 영업이익을 거둔 것으로 나타났다. 삼성전자는 연결 기준 올해 3분기 영업이익이 107조4천405억원으로 지난해 동기보다 783.1% 증가한 것으로 잠정 집계됐다고 29일 공시했다. 사진은 이날 삼성 서초사옥. 2026.10.29 mon@yna.co.kr (서울=연합뉴스) 김민지 기자 = 삼성전자[005930]는 연결 기준 2026년 3분기 반도체 사업을 담당하는 디바이스솔루션(DS) 부문 영업이익이 106조5천억원을 기록했다고 29일 발표했다. minfo@yna.co.kr X(트위터) @yonhap_graphics 인스타그램 @yonhapgraphics
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026102906.title_zh: 三星电子第三季度半导体营业利润达106万亿韩元……“明年将进行创纪录的人工智能投资”（综合报道2）
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026102906.body_zh:
（首尔=韩联社）记者成钦钦报道：三星电子今年第三季度仅半导体业务的营业利润就超过106万亿韩元，连续第四个季度创下历史最高业绩，同时成为全球大型科技企业首家单季度利润达到100万亿韩元级别的公司。成品业务因半导体等零部件涨价压力持续加剧，连续第二季度出现亏损，但移动业务部门缩小亏损幅度，尝试反弹。三星电子预计第四季度以及明年半导体价格涨势将延续，业绩改善趋势也将持续，并计划继续投资基础设施，以抢占人工智能（AI）市场先机、应对中长期需求。三星电子[005930]29日披露的暂定数据显示，按合并口径计算，公司今年第三季度营业利润为107万亿4054亿韩元，同比增长783.1%；营收为195万亿532亿韩元，同比增长126.9%；净利润为75万亿1361亿韩元，同比增长514.6%。受主要汇率美元、欧元等下跌影响，以零部件业务为主的全公司营业利润较上一季度受到约10万亿韩元的负面影响。负责半导体业务的设备解决方案（DS）部门实现营收147万亿1000亿韩元、营业利润106万亿5000亿韩元。公司配合AI需求增长，大幅扩大第六代高带宽内存（HBM）HBM4的销售，并积极应对服务器用固态驱动器（SSD）需求增长，创下历史最高季度业绩。系统LSI部门下半年新机型搭载系统级芯片（SoC）和图像传感器，推动季度营收增长，新客户及定制SoC业务也已具体落实。代工业务受HBM基底裸片营收增长及向全球一线厂商扩大先进制程销售带动，业绩大幅改善，并继续以大型超大规模云计算企业（大型数据中心运营商）为核心承接订单。负责移动业务的MX部门凭借Galaxy Z Fold8等旗舰新机上市，营收较上一季度及上年同期增长。尽管成本压力扩大，但高端产品销售占比提高带动平均售价（ASP）上升，业绩有所改善。负责电视业务的VD部门因全球体育赛事结束导致需求下降，但通过扩大高端产品销售及提高成本效率，限制了盈利下滑幅度。家电业务受加强韩国国内营销、扩大家电订阅及企业间交易（B2B）业务影响，销售保持良好势头，但原材料和物流成本上涨导致利润减少。在AI基础设施投资持续扩大的市场环境下，内存需求预计将大幅超过供给，三星电子将以业界领先技术为基础，强化以HBM4销售扩大、HBM4E量产及高性能DDR5等高附加值产品为中心的销售方向。三星电子认为，当前这种供应短缺局面可能持续至2028年，但仍将在综合考虑多种变量的情况下调整投资战略。公司将在通过前瞻性基础设施投资确保洁净室后，仔细观察需求变化，并灵活推进设备引进。今年设施投资预计将执行至84万亿4000亿韩元规模，其中DS部门为76万亿8000亿韩元，显示业务为3万亿9000亿韩元等。本报道由韩联社记者okjebo撰写，版权所有，未经许可禁止转载或再发布，禁止用于AI学习及使用。2026年10月29日11:39发布。

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026102910.summary: (서울=연합뉴스) 오진송 기자 = 홍지선 국토교통부 장관은 29일 발표한 신규 공공주택지구 후보지 6곳에 서울 지역이 포함되지 않은 것은 용산공원과 탄천물재생센터 개발 논의와 무관하다고 밝혔다. 홍 장관은 이날 정부서울청사에서 열린 수도권 신규택지 7만6천700가구 공급계획 발표 브리핑에서 서울 내 신규택지가 없는 이유에 대해 "지방정부와 협의가 된 후보지부터 먼저 발표했다"고 말했다. 이어 "용산 미군기지 반환부지는 입법화와 공론화가 필요해 시간이 걸리는 부분"이라며 "이를 논외로 하고 서울시와 단기간에 협력할 수 있는 부분에 대해 실무협의를 진행 중이며, 조만간 서울시에서 답이 올 것을 기다리고 있다"고 덧붙였다.

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026102910.body: (서울=연합뉴스) 오진송 기자 = 홍지선 국토교통부 장관은 29일 발표한 신규 공공주택지구 후보지 6곳에 서울 지역이 포함되지 않은 것은 용산공원과 탄천물재생센터 개발 논의와 무관하다고 밝혔다. 홍 장관은 이날 정부서울청사에서 열린 수도권 신규택지 7만6천700가구 공급계획 발표 브리핑에서 서울 내 신규택지가 없는 이유에 대해 "지방정부와 협의가 된 후보지부터 먼저 발표했다"고 말했다. 이어 "용산 미군기지 반환부지는 입법화와 공론화가 필요해 시간이 걸리는 부분"이라며 "이를 논외로 하고 서울시와 단기간에 협력할 수 있는 부분에 대해 실무협의를 진행 중이며, 조만간 서울시에서 답이 올 것을 기다리고 있다"고 덧붙였다. 서울 내 신규택지 후보지가 한 곳도 포함되지 않은 것이 용산공원과 탄천물재생센터 개발 논의를 고려한 결정이냐는 질문에는 "그 사항과 상관이 없다"고 선을 그었다. 정부는 이날 김포아라(3만7천가구), 구리건원(1만4천600가구), 하남미사 K-컬처(1만2천가구), 하남감일2(6천500가구), 의정부다락원(2천600가구), 고양대곡지식융합확장(4천가구) 등 경기 지역 6곳을 신규택지 후보지로 발표했다. 이번 발표에 따라 지난 8·13 대책 당시 토지거래허가구역으로 지정된 서울 전역의 개발제한구역(그린벨트)과 서울 인접 수도권 그린벨트 가운데 신규택지 후보지 및 주변 영향권을 제외한 지역은 토지거래허가구역에서 해제된다. 이에 따라 서울 그린벨트의 경우 하남감일2지구와 인접한 송파구 내 일부 그린벨트를 제외한 나머지 지역이 해제 대상이다. 정우진 국토부 주택공급추진본부장은 "하남감일2지구가 송파구와 바로 연접해 있어 사업지역의 영향권으로 볼 수 있는 송파 일부는 (토지거래허가구역으로) 남는다"며 "서울의 나머지 지역은 해제된다고 보면 된다"고 설명했다. 토지거래허가구역 해제 조치는 중앙도시계획위원회 의결과 공고를 거쳐 11월 3일께 효력이 발생할 것으로 예상된다. 다만 이번 해제는 8·13 대책 당시 신규택지 후보지의 투기 수요를 차단하기 위해 지정한 그린벨트 내 토지에 한정된다. 10·15 부동산 대책에 따라 서울 전역과 경기 일부 지역의 아파트를 대상으로 지정한 토지거래허가구역은 그대로 유지된다. 홍 장관은 토지거래허가구역에서 해제되는 지역이 향후 신규택지 후보지에서도 제외되는지를 묻는 질문에는 "추가 그린벨트 지역에 물량이 있는지 없는지를 답변드리기는 곤란하다"고 답했다. 정 본부장은 "구체적인 착공 물량은 관계기관 협의와 지구 지정 과정에서 나올 것"이라며 "2030년 착공하는 물량은 통상 3년 정도의 건설기간을 고려하면 이르면 2033년 최초 입주가 가능할 것으로 예상한다"고 말했다. 김포아라지구의 교통난 우려에 대해 홍 장관은 "김포 지역 전체적으로 교통난이 심각하다"며 "5호선 연장사업이 예비타당성조사를 통과했고 경기도에서 기본계획 수립 착수를 준비 중인 만큼 행정절차를 속도감 있게 진행해 교통난을 우선 해결하도록 검토하고 있다"고 말했다. 이번에 발표된 신규택지 후보지에는 환경적 보전가치가 상대적으로 높은 그린벨트 환경평가 1·2등급지도 일부 포함된 것으로 나타났다. 국토부 관계자는 "후보지별로 1·2등급지 비율이 높은 곳은 약 20%에 달하지만, 낮은 곳은 1%에도 미치지 못하는 등 지역별로 차이가 있다"고 설명했다. 특히 의정부다락원지구는 주한미군 반환공여지인 캠프잭슨 부지가 포함돼 있어 그린벨트 환경평가등급을 재조사할 예정이다. 미군이 장기간 주둔하면서 출입이 통제됐던 만큼 과거 평가자료가 실제 현황을 충분히 반영하지 못했을 가능성이 있다는 게 국토부의
