https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/29/s.body: • Lawmakers demand more personnel for Taraba, Plateau, Bauchi border communities •NEMA, North-East Development Commission urged to provide emergency relief The Senate has called for the immediate deployment of additional security personnel and the establishment of security camps along the borders of Taraba, Plateau and Bauchi states following the killing of about 80 people by armed bandits in Binari community, Karim-Lamido Local Government Area of Taraba State. The upper chamber also urged the National Emergency Management Agency (NEMA) and the North-East Development Commission (NEDC) to provide urgent relief materials to residents affected by the attack. The resolutions followed a motion raised during plenary by Senator Isa Lau, who drew attention to the persistent attacks on rural communities in his constituency and the growing threat to lives and property. Lau said the latest assault had claimed scores of lives, heightened insecurity and forced residents to flee their homes, warning that urgent intervention was necessary to prevent further killings. He lamented the continued attacks by armed bandits on rural communities, stressing that the government must fulfil its constitutional responsibility to protect lives and property. The senator warned that failure to take decisive action could lead to further loss of lives, the destruction of communities and a worsening humanitarian crisis in the affected areas. He urged the relevant authorities to strengthen security operations and establish a sustained presence in vulnerable communities to prevent armed groups from exploiting gaps in surveillance along the boundaries of the three states. Contributing to the debate, Senator Mohammed Monguno described the motion as timely, stressing that protecting lives and property remained the fundamental responsibility of government. “The primary purpose of governance is to protect the lives and property of the people,” Monguno said, commending Lau for bringing the plight of his constituents to the attention of the Senate. Following deliberations on the motion, the Senate called on security agencies to deploy additional personnel to the affected communities and establish more security camps along the Taraba, Plateau and Bauchi borders. The proposed measures are aimed at strengthening surveillance, improving security coverage in the vulnerable areas and preventing further attacks on rural settlements. The Senate also urged NEMA and the NEDC to provide emergency assistance to displaced residents and other victims of the violence. https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new.summary_zh: 据国家统计局（NSO）周三公布的数据，印度9月工业生产指数（IIP）显示工业活动增速放缓至6.7%，为四个月以来的最低水平。该数据低于彭博社经济学家的调查结果，后者预计增幅约为7.3%。降幅覆盖多个领域，无论按经济活动还是按用途分类，大多数行业9月的增速均低于8月。
https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new.body: India’s industrial activity, as measured by the Index of Industrial Production (IIP), moderated to 6.7% in September, the lowest in four months, according to data released by the National Statistics Office (NSO) on Wednesday. The reading fell short of the Bloomberg poll of economists which had expected growth of around 7.3%. The reduction was broad-based, with most sectors recording weaker growth in September than in August, whether classified by economic activity or by use. The exception was consumer non-durables under the use-based classification, which recorded stronger growth. To be sure, IIP growth for the April-September 2026 period stood at 6.8%, higher than the 4.4% recorded in the same period last year. Under the economic activity-based classification, manufacturing, which has the highest weight at 76%, recorded growth of 7.6% in September, compared with 8.6% in August. Seventeen of the 23 manufacturing industry groups recorded positive growth, with eight posting double-digit growth in September. Growth was led by beverages (39%), electrical equipment (34%), rubber and plastic products (20%), transport equipment (19%) and motor vehicles, trailers and semi-trailers (19%). The contraction in mining and quarrying deepened to 6.2% in September from 4.6% in August. This was the sector’s steepest contraction in the new series (2022-23), for which yearly growth data is available from April 2024. Electricity and gas supply was the only sector to record double-digit growth, at 11.3% in September according to the use-based classification, a trend it has followed since May 2026 except in July, when growth moderated to 8.2%. Water supply; sewerage and waste management growth weakened to 5.9% in September. Under the use-based classification, growth in primary goods moderated marginally to 4% in September from 4.2% in August. Intermediate goods recorded 12.2% growth in September compared to 14.2% in August. Consumer goods recorded 3.4% growth in September and its sub-components, consumer durables and non-durables recorded 6% and 1.4% growth, respectively. Capital goods saw the sharpest decline, falling by 5.5 percentage points in September (10.4%) from August (15.9%). Infrastructure goods recorded 7.2% growth in September. “As many as five of the six use-based segments, barring consumer non-durables, witnessed a moderation in their YoY growth in September 2026 vis-à-vis August 2026. Notably, the output of capital goods and intermediate goods reported double-digit growth for the sixth and fifth consecutive months, respectively,” said Aditi Nayar, chief economist at ICRA. “Going ahead, industrial activity is likely to face headwinds from geopolitical uncertainties, volatile energy prices, supply-chain disruptions, and rising input costs. Moreover, concerns over rural demand remain amid the deficient southwest monsoon and the associated risks to agricultural output. The emerging inflationary pressures could erode purchasing power and may affect overall demand,” said Rajani Sinha, chief economist at CareEdge Ratings
https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new.title_zh: 9月工业产出增长降至四个月低点，为6.7%
https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new.body_zh: 据国家统计局（NSO）周三发布的数据，印度工业活动以工业生产指数（IIP）衡量，9月增速放缓至6.7%，为4个月以来的最低水平。该读数低于彭博调查的经济学家预期，后者预计增长约为7.3%。降幅具有广泛性，无论按经济活动还是按用途划分，多数部门9月的增速都低于8月。按用途划分，唯一的例外是消费非耐用品，其增速有所加快。2026年4月至9月期间，IIP增速为6.8%，高于去年同期的4.4%。按经济活动划分，占比最高、权重为76%的制造业9月增长7.6%，低于8月的8.6%。23个制造业行业组中有17个实现正增长，其中8个9月录得两位数增长。增长主要由饮料（39%）、电气设备（34%）、橡胶和塑料制品（20%）、运输设备（19%）以及机动车辆、挂车和半挂车（19%）带动。采矿业和采石业的降幅从8月的4.6%扩大至9月的6.2%。这是该行业在新序列（2022—23年度）中最严重的收缩，该序列从2024年4月起提供年度增长数据。按用途划分，电力和燃气供应是唯一录得两位数增长的部门，9月增长11.3%。自2026年5月以来，该行业一直保持这一趋势，唯有7月增速放缓至8.2%。供水、排水和废物管理的增速在9月减弱至5.9%。按用途划分，初级商品增速从8月的4.2%小幅放缓至9月的4%。中间商品9月增长12.2%，低于8月的14.2%。消费品9月增长3.4%，其中消费耐用品和非耐用消费品分别增长6%和1.4%。资本 goods降幅最为明显，从8月的15.9%降至9月的10.4%，下降5.5个百分点。基础设施商品9月增长7.2%。ICRA首席经济学家Aditi Nayar表示：“在按用途划分的六个分部中，除消费非耐用品外，最多有五个分部的同比增速在2026年9月较2026年8月有所放缓。值得注意的是，资本商品和中间商品的产出分别连续第六个月和第五个月实现两位数增长。”她补充说：“展望未来，地缘政治不确定性、能源价格波动、供应链中断和投入成本上升可能对工业活动构成逆风。此外，在西南季风不足及由此对农业产出带来相关风险的情况下，农村需求仍令人担忧。新出现的通胀压力可能侵蚀购买力，并可能影响整体需求。”CareEdge Ratings首席经济学家Rajani Sinha表示。

https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/29/o.title: OPay Deepens Financial Inclusion as Digital Finance Reaches 64.4% of Nigerians, Excluded Population Falls to 21%
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/29/o.summary: The survey found that 79 per cent of Nigerian adults, representing about 94.2 million people, used a financial product or service, while formal financial inclusion rose to 73 per cent in 2026 from 64 per cent in 2023. The figures highlight the growing role of digital financial services in improving access to payments and other financial products, with digital payments company, OPay, among the providers operating in the expanding ecosystem.
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/29/o.summary_zh: 调查发现，79%的尼日利亚成年人使用过某种金融产品或服务，涉及约9420万人；正规金融普惠率则从2023年的64%上升至2026年的73%。这些数字凸显了数字金融服务在改善支付渠道和其他金融产品获取方面日益重要的作用，数字支付公司OPay也是在不断扩大的金融服务生态中开展业务的机构之一。
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/29/o.body: The survey found that 79 per cent of Nigerian adults, representing about 94.2 million people, used a financial product or service, while formal financial inclusion rose to 73 per cent in 2026 from 64 per cent in 2023. Financial exclusion also declined from 26 per cent in 2023 to 21 per cent in 2026, while the use of digital financial services increased from 45 per cent to 64.4 per cent over the same period. The figures highlight the growing role of digital financial services in improving access to payments and other financial products, with digital payments company, OPay, among the providers operating in the expanding ecosystem. OPay, which began operations in Nigeria in 2018, offers mobile payments, money transfers, bill payments, savings, debit cards and merchant services, enabling customers to conduct several transactions without necessarily visiting a bank branch. For commercial drivers, receiving payments promptly can mean having enough money to purchase fuel and continue working. Market traders can transfer money to suppliers without leaving their shops, while families can send money to loved ones within seconds instead of undertaking long journeys. These everyday transactions illustrate the practical value of financial inclusion, particularly for people who need convenient ways to receive, send and manage money regardless of their income or location. However, the EFInA survey indicated that increased access to financial services has not necessarily translated into financial security for most Nigerians. It found that three out of every four Nigerian adults were not financially healthy, while formal credit reached only 10 per cent of adults and insurance coverage stood at five per cent. The findings underscore the need for financial inclusion efforts to go beyond account ownership and payment services to help individuals and businesses build savings, manage risks, access credit and sustain their livelihoods. OPay’s services are designed to bring everyday financial transactions closer to consumers and businesses, particularly those whose activities depend on frequent payments. According to company disclosures, more than 99 per cent of transactions initiated on its application were completed successfully on the first attempt in the first half of 2026. The company said its technology was designed to operate across a range of mobile phones, including entry-level devices, and under unstable network conditions. Reliable transactions are particularly important for people whose daily earnings depend on timely payments, as failed transactions can delay purchases, disrupt business operations and affect income. Small businesses also represent a significant segment of the country’s digital financial services ecosystem. OPay reported that more than one million merchants and businesses were on its network as of June 2026. Through digital payments, shops, food vendors and other businesses can receive money electronically, while eligible merchants providing financial services can earn commissions. The use of digital payments can save time, simplify payment collection and help business owners serve more customers. Beyond financial services, OPay said its operations contribute to employment and economic activity in Nigeria. The company has publicly stated that 99 per cent of its workforce in the country is Nigerian. Its operations support employment in customer service, technology, compliance, sales and other areas, while its merchant and agent networks provide additional income opportunities. Nevertheless, the sustainability of these benefits depends partly on the quality of customer service provided by digital financial service operators. Customers experiencing delayed transfers need clear information, while traders encountering payment problems require practical assistance. First-time users also need guidance on protecting their accounts against fraud. Listening to customers, providing timely updates and resolving complaints remain important to building trust and encouraging continued use of digital financial services. Government policies and regulations will also shape the next phase of financial inclusion in Nigeria. The Central Bank of Nigeria’s new automated teller machine guidelines require card issuers to deploy at least one ATM for every 7,500 payment cards issued, with full compliance due by 2028. While access to cash remains important, particularly for people and communities that continue to rely on cash transactions, the growing use of mobile payments and nearby merchants has created additional channels for accessing financial services. Other priorities include simplifying customer identity checks, strengthening agent networks and promoting digital financial services while maintaining robust safeguards against fraud. At the launch of Payments System Vision 2028, the CBN set out its goal of developing a secure, inclusive and innovative payments system, with collaboration and interoperability as guiding principles. EFInA Chief Executive Officer, Foyinsolami Akinjayeju, has also called on financial service providers and policymakers to measure progress by what access to financial services enables people to achieve, rather than simply by the number of accounts opened. For OPay, the opportunity lies in translating technology into practical benefits through reliable payments, stronger merchant relationships, local employment and easier access to financial services. Ultimately, the effectiveness of financial inclusion will depend not only on how many Nigerians can open accounts, but also on how many can use financial services to earn, save, trade and withstand unexpected costs. As digital finance expands, its impact will be measured by the extent to which it helps individuals and businesses participate more effectively in the economy, one customer, one business and one transaction at a time. https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/29/o.title_zh: 数字金融覆盖64.4%的尼日利亚人口，OPay深化金融普惠，被排除在外的人口降至21%
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/29/o.body_zh: 调查发现，79%的尼日利亚成年人使用过某种金融产品或服务，人数约为9420万；正式金融普惠率从2023年的64%升至2026年的73%。金融排斥率也从2023年的26%降至2026年的21%，同期数字金融服务的使用率从45%升至64.4%。这些数据凸显了数字金融服务在改善支付及其他金融产品可及性方面日益重要的作用，数字支付公司OPay也是这一不断扩张的生态系统中运营的服务商之一。OPay于2018年在尼日利亚开始运营，提供移动支付、转账、账单支付、储蓄、借记卡和商户服务，让客户无需前往银行网点即可完成多种交易。对商业司机而言，及时收到付款可能意味着有足够资金购买燃料并继续工作。市场商户无需离开店铺即可向供应商转账，家庭也能在数秒内把钱转给亲人，而不必长途跋涉。这些日常交易体现了金融普惠的实际价值，尤其是对那些无论收入高低或身处何地，都需要便利的收付款和资金管理方式的人而言。然而，EFInA的调查显示，获得更多金融服务未必能让大多数尼日利亚人获得财务保障。调查发现，每4名尼日利亚成年人中就有3人财务状况不佳，而正式信贷仅覆盖10%的成年人，保险覆盖率也只有5%。这些发现表明，金融普惠工作不能只停留在开户和支付服务层面，还应帮助个人和企业积累储蓄、管理风险、获得信贷并维持生计。OPay的服务旨在让日常金融交易更贴近消费者和企业，尤其是业务依赖频繁收付款的群体。据公司披露，2026年上半年，通过其应用发起的交易中，超过99%在首次尝试时即成功完成。公司表示，其技术能够在各种手机上运行，包括入门级设备，并可在网络不稳定的情况下使用。可靠的交易对于依靠及时收款维持日常收入的人尤为重要，因为交易失败可能延误购物、扰乱业务运营并影响收入。小企业也是该国数字金融服务生态的重要组成部分。OPay报告称，截至2026年6月，其网络已汇集超过100万家商户和企业。通过数字支付，商店、食品摊贩及其他企业可以电子收款；提供金融服务的合资格商户还可通过此赚取佣金。使用数字支付可以节省时间、简化收款流程，并帮助商家服务更多客户。在金融服务之外，OPay表示其运营有助于尼日利亚的就业和经济活动。该公司公开表示，其在尼日利亚的员工中有99%是尼日利亚人。其业务支持客服、技术、合规、销售等领域就业，其商户和代理网络也提供了额外的收入机会。尽管如此，这些惠益能否持续，部分取决于数字金融服务运营商所提供的客户服务质量。遇到转账延迟的客户需要获得明确的信息，而遭遇支付问题的商户需要实际援助。首次使用该服务的人也需要了解如何保护账户免受欺诈。倾听客户意见、及时提供最新进展并解决投诉，仍是建立信任和鼓励 continued 使用数字金融服务的重要方式。政策与监管也将影响尼日利亚金融普惠的下一阶段。尼日利亚中央银行发布的新自动取款机指引要求发卡机构每发行7,500张支付卡至少部署1台ATM，所有机构须在2028年前全面合规。尽管现金获取仍然重要，尤其是仍依赖现金交易的人群和社区，但移动支付和就近商户的日益普及为获取金融服务开辟了更多渠道。其他重点任务包括简化客户身份核查、加强代理网络、推广数字金融服务，同时保持有力的反欺诈保障。在“支付系统愿景2028”启动活动上，尼日利亚中央银行提出建设安全、包容且富有创新性的支付系统，并以协作和互操作性为指导原则。EFInA首席执行官Foyinsolami Akinjayeju也呼吁金融服务提供者和政策制定者，不要仅仅根据开设的账户数量衡量进展，而应衡量金融服务可及性让人们取得了何种成就。对OPay而言，机会在于通过可靠支付、更紧密的商户关系、本地就业和更便利的金融服务获取途径，将技术转化为实际惠益。归根结底，衡量金融普惠成效时，不仅要看多少尼日利亚人能够开户，还要看有多少人能够利用金融服务赚钱、储蓄、经商并应对意外开支。随着数字金融不断扩展，其影响将通过它帮助个人和企业更有效参与经济活动的程度来衡量——从每一位客户、每一家企业和每一笔交易做起。THISDAY于1995年1月22日创刊，由THISDAY NEWSPAPERS LTD.出版，地址为尼日利亚拉各斯阿帕帕溪路35号，在尼日利亚36个州、联邦首都地区及世界各地设有办公室。它是尼日利亚最具权威性的新闻媒体，覆盖所有平台，为政治、商业、专业和外交精英及更广泛的中产阶级服务，同时作为新思想、文化和技术在有抱负者及千禧一代之间的交汇点。该报秉持公共信托精神，追求真理与理性，报道范围涵盖突发新闻、政治、商业、金融市场、艺术、体育和社区，以及人与社会交汇处的各类议题。您可以发送邮件至：hello@thisdaylive.com，或访问我们的联系我们页面

https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/29/h.summary_zh: 众议院批准了一项1005亿奈拉本票计划，用于向约博州政府偿付达马图鲁Muhammadu Buhari国际机场的建设费用，此前联邦政府决定接管该机场。委员会主席Abubakar Hassan Nalaraba在阿布贾国家议会向记者表示，成员们进行了尽职调查，并在建议偿付前视察了机场。
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/29/h.body: The House of Representatives has approved a N100.5 billion promissory note programme to reimburse the Yobe State Government for the construction of the Muhammadu Buhari International Cargo Airport in Damaturu, following the federal government’s decision to take over the facility. The approved sum of N100,509,017,234.55 was granted on Wednesday after the House considered a report submitted by its Committee on Aids, Loans and Debt Management. Speaking with journalists at the National Assembly in Abuja, the committee’s chairman, Abubakar Hassan Nalaraba, said members conducted due diligence and carried out an inspection of the airport before recommending the reimbursement. He explained that officials of the Federal Ministries of Aviation and Finance as well as other relevant government agencies, provided technical assessments and supporting documents for the project. Nalaraba said the committee approved the reimbursement after reviewing the findings of its oversight exercise and receiving technical reports from the Ministries of Aviation and Finance, alongside relevant accounting authorities. According to him, the committee was satisfied with the quality of the airport’s infrastructure and equipment, adding that professionals who assessed the facilities certified them as meeting the required standards. The committee’s report disclosed that the Federal Ministry of Aviation had inspected the completed airport and confirmed that the quality of construction complied with the standards required for the federal government to assume ownership of the facility. It further established that the Yobe State Government had settled payments due to the contractors responsible for executing the project, while the Bureau of Public Procurement confirmed that the procurement process complied with the relevant requirements. In arriving at its recommendation, the committee examined documents and submissions from the Yobe State Government, the Federal Ministries of Finance and Aviation, the Federal Executive Council and the Bureau of Public Procurement. The documents reviewed included contract agreements, certificates of completion, evidence of payments to contractors, due-process compliance reviews and the Bureau of Public Procurement’s certificate of no objection. President Bola Ahmed Tinubu had earlier sought the National Assembly’s approval for the promissory note programme in a communication read on the floor of the House on October 13, 2026. The request was made in accordance with the Debt Management Office (Establishment) Act, 2003, and the Fiscal Responsibility Act, 2007, which require legislative approval for the programme. Promissory note programmes are instruments used by the federal government to settle outstanding verified liabilities, including reimbursements to state governments that execute projects on behalf of the federal authorities. Speaking on the potential economic benefits of the airport, Nalaraba said the facility would provide additional value to the people of Yobe State and help attract investments to the state and the country. He noted that the construction of critical infrastructure in a state could improve the welfare of residents while creating opportunities for economic growth and investment. Also speaking, a member of the committee representing Yobe State, Mohammed Jajere, said the airport had the potential to become a major cargo hub for the North-East, particularly for the transportation of agricultural produce and raw materials. Jajere described Yobe as an agrarian state with abundant agricultural products and raw materials, expressing optimism that the cargo airport would provide an important transportation link for the region. He added that the facility could facilitate the movement of agricultural produce from the North-East to other markets, thereby improving access to buyers and supporting economic activities across the region. However, journalists questioned the commercial viability of airports in Nigeria, citing a report attributed to the Federal Airports Authority of Nigeria (FAAN) which indicated that only three of the country’s 22 domestic and international airports were commercially viable. In response, Nalaraba said the committee based its recommendation on the technical assessments conducted by the relevant aviation authorities, noting that lawmakers relied on the expertise of professionals to evaluate the operational prospects of the facility. He maintained that officials of the Ministry of Aviation and FAAN had inspected the airport and certified it as viable and ready for commercial operations. The committee chairman further stressed that the project had undergone the necessary administrative and technical assessments before the reimbursement request was presented to the National Assembly for consideration. Nalaraba also clarified that the approved amount was not new funding for the construction of the airport but a reimbursement to the Yobe State Government for expenditure already incurred on a project the federal government had decided to take over. He explained that the money had already been spent on the construction of the international cargo airport, describing the proposed payment as a repayment to the state rather than fresh funding for the project. The committee chairman added that Yobe State had undertaken the construction despite aviation being a matter within the exclusive legislative jurisdiction of the federal government. Addressing concerns about the possibility of additional financial obligations arising from the project, the committee indicated the federal government’s takeover would transfer responsibility for the airport, including its future maintenance and development, to the federal authorities. The committee also indicated that the reimbursement would be made as a one-off payment, although details of the specific payment arrangements were not fully disclosed during the briefing. With the approval, attention is expected to shift to the federal government’s management of the airport and its capacity to attract sufficient commercial activity to justify the public investment, particularly through the transportation of agricultural produce and other cargo from the North-East. https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/29/h.title_zh: 众议院批准为博贝机场拨款1005亿奈拉
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/29/h.body_zh: 众议院已批准一项价值1005亿奈拉的期票计划，用于偿还约贝州政府为在达马图鲁建设穆罕马杜·布哈里国际机场而支出的费用，此前联邦政府已决定接管该机场。众议院审议其援助、贷款和债务管理委员会提交的报告后，于周三批准拨款100,509,017,234.55奈拉。委员会主席阿布巴卡尔·哈桑·纳拉拉巴在阿布贾国民议会向记者表示，委员会成员进行了尽职调查，并实地检查了机场，之后才建议偿还相关款项。他解释说，联邦航空部、财政部以及其他相关政府机构的官员为该项目提供了技术评估和支持文件。纳拉拉巴说，委员会在审查监督工作的调查结果，并收到航空部、财政部及相关会计机构的技术报告后，批准了偿还方案。据他介绍，委员会对机场基础设施和设备的质量表示满意，并称对这些设施进行评估的专业人士证明其符合规定标准。委员会的报告披露，联邦航空部已对建成的机场进行检查，并确认其建设质量符合联邦政府接管该设施所需的标准。报告还确认，约贝州政府已经向负责实施项目的承包商支付了应付款项，公共采购局也确认采购流程符合相关要求。委员会在提出建议时，审查了约贝州政府、联邦财政部、联邦航空部、联邦执行委员会和公共采购局提交的文件及材料。审查的文件包括合同协议、竣工证明、向承包商付款的凭证、法定程序合规审查结果，以及公共采购局出具的无异议证明。博拉·艾哈迈德·蒂努布总统此前曾请求国民议会批准这项期票计划，相关函件于2026年10月13日在众议院全体会议上宣读。该请求依据《2003年债务管理办公室（设立）法》和《2007年财政责任法》提出，这两部法律要求该计划必须获得立法批准。期票计划是联邦政府用于清偿经核实未付债务的工具，其中包括向代联邦机构实施项目的州政府偿还费用。谈及机场可能带来的经济效益，纳拉拉巴表示，该设施将为约贝州民众创造更多价值，并有助于吸引对该州和整个国家的投资。他指出，在一个州建设关键基础设施可以改善居民福祉，同时为经济增长和投资创造机会。委员会中代表约贝州的成员穆罕默德·贾杰雷也表示，该机场有望成为东北部地区的重要货运枢纽，尤其适合运输农产品和原材料。贾杰雷称约贝州是一个农产品和原材料丰富的小农州，并乐观认为这座货运机场将为该地区提供重要的运输联系。他补充说，该设施可以促进东北部农产品运往其他市场，从而改善买家获取货物的便利性，并推动全地区的经济活动。然而，记者质疑尼日利亚机场的商业可行性，并援引一份据称出自尼日利亚联邦机场管理局（FAAN）的报告，称该国22座国内和国际机场中只有3座具有商业可行性。对此，纳拉拉巴表示，委员会的建议以相关航空主管部门开展的技术评估为依据，议员依赖专业人士的专业知识评估该设施的运营前景。他坚称，航空部和FAAN的官员已经检查了机场，并确认其具备商业运营条件且已准备就绪。委员会主席进一步强调，在将偿还请求提交国民议会审议之前，该项目已经完成必要的行政和技术评估。纳拉拉巴还澄清，批准的金额并非用于机场建设的新资金，而是联邦政府决定接管该项目后，偿还约贝州政府已经发生的支出。他解释说，这笔钱已经用于建设这座国际机场，因此拟议付款是对该州已经支付费用的补偿，而不是为该项目提供新资金。委员会主席还表示，尽管航空事务属于联邦政府专属立法管辖范围，约贝州仍承担了机场建设。针对该项目可能产生额外财政负担的担忧，委员会指出，联邦政府接管后将把机场的责任，包括未来的维护和发展，交由联邦主管部门承担。委员会还表示，偿还款项将一次性支付，不过简报会并未完全披露具体支付安排的细节。随着批准落地，公众预计将关注联邦政府如何管理这座机场，以及其能否吸引足够的商业活动来证明公共投资的合理性，尤其是通过运输东北部农产品和其他货物。THISDAY于1995年1月22日创办，由THISDAY NEWSPAPERS LTD.出版，地址为尼日利亚拉各斯阿帕帕克里克路35号，在尼日利亚36个州、联邦首都辖区及世界各地设有办事处。它是尼日利亚最具权威性的新闻媒体，覆盖所有平台，服务于政治、商业、专业和外交精英及更广泛的中产阶层，同时为有抱负者和千禧一代提供新思想、文化与技术的交汇点。这份报纸是一项公共信任，致力于追求真相与理性，报道范围涵盖突发新闻、政治、商业、市场、艺术、体育和社区等议题，呈现人与社会的交汇之处。您可以发送邮件至：hello@thisdaylive.com，或访问我们的联系我们页面

https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/29/g.summary: Governor AbdulRahman AbdulRazaq of Kwara State has said his administration has completed over 650 kilometres of roads in the state since assumption of office. He however said the construction of the affected roads have excluded the completed 294km tax credit roads while additional projects are in progress and in the pipeline so as to improve the infrastructure that supports agriculture, commerce, investment, and economic growth.
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/29/g.summary_zh: 夸拉州州长阿卜杜勒拉赫曼·阿卜杜勒拉扎克表示，其政府自上任以来已在该州完成逾650公里的道路建设。不过，他也指出，在建道路不包括已完工的294公里税收抵免道路，另有若干项目正在施工或列入计划，以改善支撑农业、商业、投资和经济增长的基础设施。
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/29/g.body: Governor AbdulRahman AbdulRazaq of Kwara State has said his administration has completed over 650 kilometres of roads in the state since assumption of office. He however said the construction of the affected roads have excluded the completed 294km tax credit roads while additional projects are in progress and in the pipeline so as to improve the infrastructure that supports agriculture, commerce, investment, and economic growth. AbdulRazaq stated this yesterday during the flag-off the construction of 21-kilometre Oke-Oyi/Lanwa road in Ilorin East and Moro Local Government Areas of the state with the sole aim to improve connectivity, ease transportation, and widen economic opportunities in the affected communities. The governor equally flagged-off the construction of Oke Ose/Maya Asunlope road which also falls within Ilorin East. He noted that a road is valuable not merely because it connects two locations, but because of the people it helps, the businesses it supports, and the opportunities it brings within reach. “To the people of Moro and Ilorin East Local Government Areas, particularly the residents of Oke-Oyi, Lanwa, Ilala, Onikoko, Budo Isale, Alufa and neighbouring communities, this project is a statement of our commitment to your wellbeing and the future of your communities. “We understand what this road means for a farmer trying to get produce to market, a trader struggling to move merchandise, or a family making an essential journey. At the groundbreaking ceremony at Oke-Ose, AbdulRazaq reiterated his government’s resolve to continually invest in roads and critical infrastructure, believing that economic prosperity does not happen by chance. “We recognise the transportation difficulties that have affected movement in this area. “We understand that behind every difficult journey is a person trying to earn a living, a trader working to sustain a business, a family meeting its daily needs, or a resident trying to get from one place to another,” he said. Expressing appreciation, the All Progressives Congress House of Representatives candidate for Ilorin East/Ilorin South Federal Constituency come 2027, Hon. Abdulquawiy Olododo said the two road projects further demonstrate the commitment of the administration to the development of rural communities. “For me, today’s occasion is not merely about flagging-off a road construction. “It is about the opportunities this road will create for our farmers, traders, young people and families whose daily lives depend on better connectivity”. Baale of Oke-oyi, Mallam Soliu Abdulkadir and Alangua of Oke-mi Mallam Suleiman Ibrahim, in their separate remarks, said the event indicates that the government is committed to rural development, commending the governor for promoting fairness, inclusion and a stronger government-community relationship. Mallam Ibrahim said his community has been longing for motorable road as far back as 1981, noting that the project is a dream come true. Spokesman for Oke-Ose community, Alhaji Suleiman Aremu, applauded AbdulRazaq for improving their access to basic infrastructure, pledging their continued support to the APC-led government. He described Oke-Ose/Maya Asunlope road project as ‘incredibly unique’ in the history of Oke-Ose and adjoining communities. https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/29/g.title_zh: 州长AbdulRazaq：我的政府已在Kwara修建逾650公里道路
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/29/g.body_zh:
夸拉州州长阿卜杜勒拉赫曼·阿卜杜勒拉扎克表示，自上任以来，其政府已在该州完成了逾650公里道路建设。不过他说，所涉道路建设不包括已完工的294公里税收抵扣道路，另有更多项目正在施工和筹备中，旨在改善支撑农业、商业、投资和经济增长的基础设施。阿卜杜勒拉扎克昨天在伊洛林东区和莫罗地方政府的21公里奥凯奥伊/兰瓦道路开工仪式上发表上述讲话。此次开工的唯一目的，是改善连通性、便利交通，并扩大受影响社区的经济机会。州长还为同样位于伊洛林东区的奥凯奥塞/玛雅阿苏洛佩道路举行开工仪式。他指出，一条道路的价值不只是因为它连接两个地方，更在于它帮助了人们、支持了企业，并让机会触手可及。

“对于莫罗和伊洛林东区的地方政府，尤其是奥凯奥伊、兰瓦、伊拉拉、奥尼科科、布多伊萨莱、阿卢法及周边社区的居民来说，这项工程表明了我们致力于改善你们福祉以及社区未来的决心。

“我们深知这条道路对努力把农产品运往市场的农民、艰难运输货物的商贩，或必须进行重要出行的家庭意味着什么。在奥凯奥塞举行的奠基仪式上，阿卜杜勒拉扎克重申，其政府决心持续投资道路和关键基础设施，因为他认为经济繁荣不会凭空出现。


“我们认识到，交通困难已经影响到这一地区的人员往来。

“我们明白，每一段艰难行程的背后，都是一个努力谋生的人、一位维持经营生意的商贩、一个满足日常需要的家庭，或是一名试图从一地前往另一地的居民。”他说。

即将参加2027年伊洛林东/伊洛林南联邦选区众议院选举的进步大会党候选人阿卜杜勒卡维·奥洛多多阁下表达感谢，称这两个道路项目进一步体现了该政府推动农村社区发展的决心。

“对我来说，今天的活动不只是为道路建设举行开工仪式。

“它还意味着，这条道路将为我们依赖更好连通性的农民、商贩、年轻人和家庭创造机会。”奥凯奥伊的巴阿里·索利乌·阿卜杜勒卡迪尔，以及奥凯米的阿兰瓜·苏莱曼·易卜拉欣分别在致辞中表示，这场活动表明政府致力于农村发展，并赞扬州长推动公平、包容以及加强政府与社区关系。易卜拉欣说，早在1981年，他的社区就盼望拥有一条可供机动车通行的道路，并指出该项目终于让梦想成真。奥凯奥塞社区发言人阿哈吉·苏莱曼·阿雷穆赞扬阿卜杜勒拉扎克改善了社区获得基本基础设施的条件，并承诺将继续支持由进步大会党领导的政府。他将奥凯奥塞/玛雅阿苏洛佩道路项目称为奥凯奥塞及周边社区历史上“独一无二”的项目。

https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new.body: The Supreme Court on Wednesday said that delay in execution of arbitral awards strikes at the very rationale of adopting arbitration over conventional litigation and asked the Law Commission of India to make legislative and procedural recommendations to strengthen the execution regime. A bench headed by justice Vikram Nath said, “The efficacy of an arbitral regime cannot be measured merely by the expedition with which an award is rendered or the circumscribed grounds upon which it may be challenged. It must equally be assessed by the ability of the successful party to realise the fruits of the award within a reasonable time.” The court was deciding an appeal filed by Royal Construction Company Pvt. Ltd. which had won an award against National Projects Construction Corporation Ltd. (NPCC) in 2002 and was awaiting its execution for the past 24 years. The bench, also comprising justices Sandeep Mehta and Aparesh Kumar Singh said, “More than 24 years after the arbitral award was rendered, the parties continue to litigate over its enforcement. Such a state of affairs strikes at the very rationale underlying the adoption of arbitration as an effective alternative to conventional civil litigation.” The court said that the present case was not a solitary instance as the experience of similar cases calls for a closer examination of whether this framework under the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996 has adequately served the objectives it was meant to achieve. “In these circumstances, we request the Law Commission of India to undertake a focused study of the statutory and procedural framework governing the enforcement and execution of arbitral awards,” the judgment said. The study will also include identification of the practical impediments to timely recovery while examining existing practice in global jurisdictions. The court further allowed the commission to consider whether domestic and foreign arbitral awards warrant distinct enforcement procedures or a common framework with appropriate safeguards. The Royal Construction represented by advocate Rishabh Sancheti informed the court that the 2002 arbitral award was upheld up to the Supreme Court in 2015. The court further dismissed an application moved by NPCC seeking modification of the 2023 judgment. The 2002 award had directed NPCC to pay Royal Iraqi Dinars 2,23,777.14 and ₹ 20 lakh, each with interest at 12% p.a. The Supreme Court restored the award in full and in 2023 held it to be payable in foreign currency. In the earlier round of litigation, NPCC had deposited about ₹ 1.5 crore in Indian rupees, which Royal Construction had withdrawn. However, there remained and sought execution of the remaining sum. In the execution proceedings, NPCC contended that its deposit had covered the principal sum (without interest). The matter was agitated before the Delhi High Court which in February this year granted liberty to the parties to seek clarification from the top court
https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new.title_zh: 最高法院要求法律委员会审查裁决执行规则 101793214923659
https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new.body_zh: 印度最高法院周三表示，拖延执行仲裁裁决，直接违背了采用仲裁而非传统诉讼的根本宗旨，并要求印度法律委员会就强化仲裁裁决执行制度提出立法和程序建议。由法官Vikram Nath主持的合议庭表示：“衡量仲裁制度成效，不能仅仅看裁决作出速度，也不能只看提出异议时可依据的狭窄理由，还必须同样考察胜诉方能否在合理时间内实现裁决所赋予的权利。”法院当时正在审理Royal Construction Company Pvt. Ltd.提起的上诉。该公司于2002年在针对National Projects Construction Corporation Ltd.（NPCC）的仲裁中胜诉，但此后24年来一直等待裁决执行。参与审理的合议庭还包括法官Sandeep Mehta和Aparesh Kumar Singh。合议庭表示：“仲裁裁决作出24年多后，当事人仍在为其执行而诉讼。这样的局面直接违背了采用仲裁作为传统民事诉讼有效替代方案的根本宗旨。”法院表示，本案并非孤例，类似案件的司法实践要求进一步审视《1996年仲裁与调解法》下的仲裁框架是否充分实现了预期目标。判决称：“在这种情况下，我们请求印度法律委员会就仲裁裁决执行和落实所适用的法律及程序框架开展有针对性的研究。”这项研究还将包括查明及时收回裁决款项的实际障碍，同时考察全球其他司法辖区的现行做法。法院还允许该委员会考虑，国内和外国仲裁裁决是否应适用不同的执行程序，或采用配有适当保障措施的共同框架。由律师Rishabh Sancheti代理的Royal Construction向法院表示，2002年的仲裁裁决一直维持至2015年最高法院终审。法院随后驳回了NPCC提出的修改2023年判决的申请。2002年的裁决命令NPCC向Royal Construction支付2,23,777.14伊拉克第纳尔和₹ 20 lakh，两笔款项均按年利率12%计息。最高法院全额恢复了该裁决，并于2023年裁定应以外国货币支付。在此前一轮诉讼中，NPCC曾以印度卢比存入约₹ 1.5 crore，Royal Construction随后提取了该款，但剩余款项仍需执行。在执行程序中，NPCC主张其存入的款项已经覆盖本金，但不包括利息。该案曾在德里高等法院审理，该法院于今年2月准许当事人向最高法院申请澄清

https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/10/prop.body: ENUGU – President Bola Tinubu has said the proposed South-East Gas Distribution Pipeline Project will reduce energy costs, boost industrialisation and create jobs across the five states of the region. Tinubu, represented by Deputy Speaker of the House of Representatives, Benjamin Kalu, spoke yesterday at the South-East Gas Infrastructure Investment and Project Development Ceremony in Enugu. The proposed $100 million project, being developed by Gas Sync Limited in partnership with NNPC Gas Marketing Limited and other stakeholders, seeks to connect gas resources to industrial and commercial centres in Abia, Anambra, Ebonyi, Enugu and Imo states. The President said reliable and affordable energy was critical to unlocking the region’s industrial potential, lamenting that manufacturers had continued to spend heavily on alternative power. “There is a sound familiar to every manufacturer in Aba, Nnewi, Onitsha, Enugu and across the South-East. It is the sound of a generator,” he said. Tinubu said the project would strengthen manufacturing, encourage agro-processing and attract new investments, adding that the benefits of the region’s gas resources should be measured by the industries they power and the jobs they create. “The true value of our gas is in the factories it powers, the jobs it creates and the prosperity it brings to our people,” he said. He commended the South-East Development Commission (SEDC) for committing $3 million to the initiative, stressing that the project required cooperation between federal and state governments, private investors and financial institutions. However, he cautioned that the ceremony was only an investment and project-development milestone, with financing, regulatory approvals and construction still ahead. “We are not investing in pipelines for their own sake. We are investing in the industries, businesses and jobs those pipelines will make possible,” Tinubu said. Earlier, SEDC Managing Director, Mark Okoye, disclosed that the commission had completed technical, financial and legal due diligence before making its $3 million investment. Okoye said the commission was targeting up to $30 million in aggregate regional investment participation, including its contribution, with additional funds expected from state governments and private investors. “This is not merely an expression of interest or a promise of future investment. The commission has made an actual financial investment towards advancing this regional infrastructure initiative,” he said. He explained that the project would initially draw on gas resources associated with the Assa North–Ohaji South development in Imo State. Okoye said the initiative formed part of SEDC’s broader industrialisation programme aimed at addressing infrastructure constraints facing manufacturers and businesses across the region. “Our philosophy is simple: Plan. Prepare. Partner,” he said, adding that the commission would work with state governments and private-sector operators to mobilise investment for regional development. Also speaking, SEDC Chairman, Dr Emeka Wogu, said affordable and dependable energy was essential for improving productivity, attracting investments and creating employment. He urged investors and energy companies to support the project, stressing that its success should be measured by its economic impact. “The ultimate purpose of infrastructure development is to improve lives,” Wogu said. He called for transparency, environmental responsibility, community engagement and strict adherence to safety standards in the development and operation of the proposed pipeline. The initiative however aligns with Enugu State Governor Peter Mbah’s call for a high-pressure gas pipeline linking major cities across the South-East to accelerate industrial development. Mbah had argued that reliable access to piped gas would ease energy constraints, lower production costs and improve the competitiveness of industries in the region. Earlier, South-East governors pledged their support for the project, describing energy access as a major challenge facing businesses in the region. They assured that the states would provide the necessary support to ensure the pipeline became a reality. “We will do everything required of us to make sure that the project succeeds. We are happy that the project is here in the South-East because the major problem of the region is energy,” the representative said. “With this project, every company will be able to produce at a lower cost of energy, while more people will have opportunities to work and contribute to the economy,” the representative added. https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/10/prop.title_zh: 拟议中的天然气管道将降低成本并推动东南部经济增长
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/10/prop.body_zh: 恩古——总统博拉·蒂努巴表示，拟议中的东南部天然气分销管道项目将降低能源成本，推动工业化，并在该地区五个州创造就业机会。蒂努巴由众议院议长助理本杰明·卡卢代表，昨日在恩古举行的东南部天然气基础设施投资与项目开发仪式上发表了讲话。这个拟议中的1亿美元项目由Gas Sync Limited与NNPC Gas Marketing Limited及其他利益相关方合作开发，旨在将天然气资源输送到阿比亚、安南布拉、埃博尼、恩古和伊莫各州的工业及商业中心。总统说，可靠且负担得起的能源对于释放该地区的工业潜力至关重要，并感叹制造商一直不得不为替代电力投入巨额成本。他说：“阿巴、恩内维、奥尼查、恩古以及整个东南部的每一家制造商，都熟悉一种声音。那就是发电机的声音。”蒂努巴表示，该项目将强化制造业，促进农产品加工并吸引新投资，同时指出，衡量该地区天然气资源效益的标准，应是这些资源所支撑的产业以及所创造的就业。他说：“我们天然气的真正价值，在于它所 powering 的工厂、它所创造的就业，以及它为我国人民带来的繁荣。”他赞扬东南部发展委员会（SEDC）承诺为这一倡议投入300万美元，并强调该项目需要联邦与州政府、私人投资者和金融机构之间的合作。不过，他也提醒，此次仪式只是投资和项目开发进程中的一个里程碑，融资、监管审批和建设仍在前方。蒂努巴说：“我们投资管道，不是为了管道本身。我们投资的是这些管道使之成为可能的产业、企业和就业。”此前，SEDC董事总经理马克·奥科耶透露，该委员会在投入300万美元之前，已完成技术、财务和法律尽职调查。奥科耶说，该委员会的目标是推动总额最高达3000万美元的区域投资参与，其中包括其自身出资，并预计州政府和私人投资者将提供额外资金。他说：“这不仅仅只是表达兴趣或承诺未来投资。该委员会已经为推进这项区域基础设施倡议作出了实际资金投入。”他解释说，该项目初期将利用伊莫州Assa North–Ohaji South开发项目所关联的天然气资源。奥科耶称，这项倡议是SEDC更广泛工业化计划的一部分，旨在解决该地区制造商和企业面临的基础设施制约。他说：“我们的理念很简单：规划、准备、合作。”他补充说，该委员会将与州政府及私营部门运营商合作，动员投资以推动区域发展。SEDC主席埃梅卡·沃古博士也在会上发言，表示负担得起且可靠的能源对于提高生产率、吸引投资和创造就业至关重要。他呼吁投资者和能源公司支持该项目，强调项目的成效应以经济影响来衡量。沃古说：“基础设施发展的最终目的，是改善人们的生活。”他呼吁在拟议管道的开发和运营中保持透明度、承担环境责任、让社区参与，并严格遵守安全标准。不过，这项倡议与恩古州州长彼得·姆巴呼吁建设一条连接东南部主要城市的高压天然气管道、推动工业发展的主张相契合。姆巴此前认为，稳定获得管道天然气将缓解能源制约、降低生产成本，并提升该地区产业的竞争力。此前，东南部各州州长承诺支持该项目，并称获得能源是该地区企业面临的一项重大挑战。他们保证，各州将提供必要支持，确保管道成为现实。代表说：“我们将完成一切必要工作，确保项目取得成功。我们很高兴该项目能来到东南部，因为该地区面临的最大问题就是能源。”代表补充说：“有了这个项目，每家公司都将能够以更低的能源成本进行生产，同时更多人会获得就业机会，为经济作出贡献。”本文所表达的意见并不代表Vanguard报纸或其任何员工的观点。

https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/29/s.body: As Nigeria joins the rest of the world to mark World Stroke Day today, Thursday, Stroke Action Nigeria (SAN) has called on Nigerians to recognise the warning signs of stroke and seek immediate medical attention, warning that delays could cost lives and leave survivors with permanent disabilities. The organisation, under its “Know the Signs. #ActFAST. Every Minute Counts” campaign, is taking stroke awareness to the streets through a public rally aimed at educating Nigerians on how to identify symptoms and respond swiftly to a suspected stroke. The campaign comes amid concerns that poor public awareness, misconceptions about stroke symptoms and delays in seeking medical care continue to undermine treatment outcomes, increasing the risk of preventable deaths and long-term disabilities. Stroke Action Nigeria said early recognition and prompt access to appropriate medical care were critical to improving outcomes, urging individuals, families and communities to treat suspected stroke as a medical emergency rather than wait for symptoms to disappear or resort to home remedies. The rally, the centrepiece of the organisation’s World Stroke Day 2026 activities, will bring together volunteers, health advocates and supporters to engage members of the public through educational materials, direct conversations and practical guidance on stroke prevention and emergency response. At the heart of the campaign is the internationally recognised FAST approach, which helps people identify common stroke warning signs and understand the urgency of seeking medical attention. The acronym stands for Face, Arms, Speech and Time. Face checks whether one side of the face droops; Arms tests whether one arm is weak or difficult to raise; Speech identifies slurred or difficult-to-understand speech; while Time emphasises the need to seek emergency medical attention immediately. SAN said Nigerians should not ignore these symptoms, even when they appear mild or disappear after a short period, stressing that suspected stroke requires urgent medical assessment. The organisation is also using the campaign to highlight major stroke risk factors, including high blood pressure, diabetes, smoking, physical inactivity and unhealthy dietary habits. It urged Nigerians to pay greater attention to these risks, adopt healthier lifestyles and seek appropriate medical care to help prevent stroke. Beyond the street campaign, Stroke Action Nigeria has begun engaging young people through its Stroke Champions School Engagement Programme, which has targeted four secondary schools in the lead-up to this year’s commemoration. The initiative is designed to equip students with knowledge of stroke symptoms, the importance of early intervention and the role of healthy lifestyle choices in reducing the risk of the condition. Through interactive educational sessions, students are encouraged to become stroke-awareness ambassadors, sharing potentially lifesaving information with their families, friends and communities. The organisation believes that educating young people will help build a generation capable of recognising stroke warning signs and responding appropriately when someone develops symptoms. The school programme also seeks to extend stroke awareness beyond formal healthcare settings, placing practical health information in the hands of young people who can communicate it within their homes and neighbourhoods. SAN is also deploying digital platforms and other public communication channels to expand the reach of the #ActFAST campaign, encourage public participation and reinforce the importance of prompt medical intervention. The organisation said stroke awareness should not be limited to the annual World Stroke Day commemoration but should become a sustained public health priority. It called on individuals, families, community leaders, organisations and other stakeholders to support efforts to improve public understanding of stroke, strengthen prevention education and encourage timely access to appropriate medical care. According to the organisation, ensuring that more Nigerians can identify the warning signs of stroke is an important step towards reducing the burden of stroke-related deaths and disabilities. As the country joins the global observance, SAN reiterated that stroke recognition is essential knowledge for everyone, irrespective of age or background. The Chief Executive of Stroke Action Nigeria and Board Member of the World Stroke Organisation, Dr. Rita Melifonwu, signed the statement. Stroke Action Nigeria is a non-profit organisation committed to reducing the burden of stroke in Nigeria through public awareness, prevention education, rehabilitation support, advocacy, research and community engagement. Through its programmes and partnerships, the organisation also works to improve outcomes for stroke survivors, support caregivers and strengthen public understanding of stroke prevention and recovery. The campaign’s central message remains: Know the signs. #ActFAST. Every minute counts. https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/29/s.title_zh: 中风：分秒必争，SAN将#ActFAST宣传活动带上街头
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/29/s.body_zh: 尼日利亚今天，即星期四，与世界各地一道纪念世界卒中日，Stroke Action Nigeria（SAN）呼吁尼日利亚人识别中风的警示症状并立即寻求医疗救助，警告延误可能造成生命损失，并使幸存者留下永久性残疾。该组织正在开展“认识症状。#快速行动。每一分钟都很重要”宣传活动，通过公众集会向街头推广中风意识，旨在教导尼日利亚人如何识别症状，并在疑似中风时迅速作出反应。开展此次活动之际，相关方面担忧公众意识不足、对中风症状存在误解以及延误就医等因素，继续削弱治疗效果，增加可预防死亡和长期残疾的风险。Stroke Action Nigeria表示，及早识别症状和及时获得适当医疗服务，是改善治疗结果的关键，并敦促个人、家庭和社区将疑似中风视为医疗急症，切勿等待症状消失或使用家庭偏方。作为该组织2026年世界卒中日系列活动的核心内容，这场集会将汇聚志愿者、卫生倡导人士和支持者，通过宣传材料、直接交流以及有关中风预防和紧急应对的实用指导，与公众互动。这项活动的核心是获得国际认可的FAST方法，帮助人们识别常见的中风警示症状，并了解立即寻求医疗救助的紧迫性。该缩写代表面部、手臂、语言和时间。面部检查用于判断脸的一侧是否下垂；手臂检查用于判断一只手臂是否无力或难以抬起；语言检查用于识别说话含糊或难以理解的情况；时间则强调必须立即寻求紧急医疗救助。SAN表示，尼日利亚人不应忽视这些症状，即使症状看似轻微或在短时间内消失，也不应掉以轻心，并强调疑似中风需要紧急接受医疗评估。该组织还借助宣传活动强调中风的主要风险因素，包括高血压、糖尿病、吸烟、缺乏运动和不健康饮食习惯。它敦促尼日利亚人更加关注这些风险，养成更健康的生活方式，并寻求适当医疗服务，以帮助预防中风。除街头宣传活动外，Stroke Action Nigeria已通过其“卒中冠军学校参与计划”开始接触年轻人。在今年纪念活动前夕，该计划已面向4所中学开展工作。该计划旨在使学生掌握中风症状知识，了解早期干预的重要性，以及健康生活方式在降低患病风险方面的作用。通过互动式教育活动，学生被鼓励成为中风意识宣传员，与家人、朋友和社区分享可能挽救生命的信息。该组织认为，教育年轻人将有助于培养一代能够识别中风警示症状，并在有人出现症状时作出恰当应对的人。学校计划还旨在将中风意识推广到正规医疗服务场所之外，把实用健康信息交给年轻人，由他们在家庭和社区内传播。SAN还在利用数字平台和其他公共传播渠道扩大#快速行动宣传活动的覆盖面，鼓励公众参与，并强调及时进行医疗干预的重要性。该组织表示，中风意识不应仅限于每年世界卒中日的纪念活动，而应成为一项长期坚持的公共卫生优先事项。它呼吁个人、家庭、社区领袖、组织及其他利益相关方支持改善公众对中风认识的工作，加强预防教育，并促进及时获得适当医疗服务。该组织表示，确保更多尼日利亚人能够识别中风警示症状，是减少中风相关死亡和残疾负担的重要一步。随着尼日利亚参与全球纪念活动，SAN再次强调，无论年龄或背景如何，识别中风都是每个人必备的知识。Stroke Action Nigeria首席执行官兼世界卒中组织董事会成员Rita Melifonwu博士签署了这份声明。Stroke Action Nigeria是一家非营利组织，致力于通过公众宣传、预防教育、康复支持、倡导、研究和社区参与，减轻尼日利亚的中风负担。该组织还通过各项计划和合作伙伴关系，努力改善中风幸存者的治疗结果，支持照护者，并加强公众对中风预防和康复的认识。此次宣传活动的核心信息依然是：认识症状。#快速行动。每一分钟都很重要。THISDAY于1995年1月22日创办，由THISDAY NEWSPAPERS LTD.出版，地址为尼日利亚拉各斯阿帕帕克里克路35号，并在尼日利亚36个州、联邦首都辖区及世界各地设有办公室。作为尼日利亚最权威的新闻媒体，THISDAY通过所有平台报道政治、商业、职业和外交精英群体及更广泛中产阶级关注的内容，同时为有抱负者和千禧一代提供汇聚新思想、文化和技术的交汇点。这份报纸是一项公共信任，致力于追求真理与理性，报道范围涵盖突发新闻、政治、商业、金融市场、艺术、体育和社区等议题，呈现人们与社会的交汇点。您可以发送邮件至：hello@thisdaylive.com，或访问我们的联系我们页面

Unlock these with Subscription Sourabha Rao, the producer of Miracle in Antarctica , a new film chronicling the story of the building of Dakshin Gangotri, India’s first scientific base station in the frozen continent, says she is constantly surprised by the fact that the story has not been told in as many ways as possible. “It is a privilege for us to tell a story like that,” says the Bengaluru-based writer, poet and filmmaker who thinks of this initiative as groundbreaking. “A project of that scale was not accomplished before 1983-84 and hasn’t happened since, at least not at that pace; over one Antarctic summer.” The idea for the film, which her husband Santosh Saligram has directed, emerged from a serendipitous meeting with Harsh Kumar Gupta, the geophysicist and seismologist who was sent to Antarctica to lead this impossible mission. “One of our friends, also a filmmaker, Prakash Matada, bumped into Dr Gupta at a party in early 2025,” recalls Sourabha. Dr Gupta, who had already written a book, Building Dakshin Gangotri at Antarctica: A Miracle , published in 2021 by the Geological Society of India, and was actively looking for someone to make a film about this mission. Since Prakash was tied up with other projects at the time, he immediately reached out to Sourabha and Santosh, the co-founders of the Hamsagatha Foundation, a Bengaluru-based not-for-profit focused on impactful storytelling. “We just had a very elaborate call, and by the end of that, we decided to take it up.” The biggest challenge at the beginning of the project, as it often is, was funding. “No matter how passionate and hardworking we are to tell or retell a story, and no matter how good a project is, it needs monetary support at the end of the day.” Though Prakash had made it very clear that there was no money for the project, it did not stop them from trying to meet Gupta on his next visit to Bengaluru. “He was so humble and approachable when we met him, asking about what we did as professionals instead of jumping straight into talking about his story. That was really nice.” One thing that really stayed with Sourabha was what the then 83-year-old scientist told her after he had given her the gist of the project. “He told us that he wanted to do it as quickly as possible, because time was not on his side. That hit us really hard,” she says, adding that this statement cemented their decision. “We didn’t know how yet, but we knew we had to make this happen.” They began by first reaching out to some of the people who had been part of the expedition: Gupta, who lives in Hyderabad, of course, but also Ashok Hanjura in Delhi and KJ Mathew in Kochi. “Dr Gupta offered some seed funding to start the project,” explains Sourabha, who, with Santosh, began shooting interviews for the film in May last year. Around the same time, they also began looking for funds, which, after plenty of paperwork, their foundation finally received from the Ashraya Hastha Trust, Rohini Nilekani Philanthropies and Samagata Foundation. “Once we knew we were going to get this support, we went all out.” The film uses a mix of interviews, archival material, stock footage and animation to tell the story of not just Gupta’s life and memories of that fateful summer, but also the relevance of Antarctica today, especially in the age of global warming and extreme weather events. “Standing up to the gravitas of the story or the scientists who made it happen was a monumental responsibility,” says Santosh, whose biggest practical challenge was finding enough archival material to support the storytelling. “For a contemporary audience or diverse, mixed demographic, there has to be a lot of visual support, and initially there was just not enough material,” he says. Meticulous investigation, and yes, a little bit of luck, would soon change that. “We managed to find an old documentary that helped us immensely,” he says. Then came the task of putting it all together on the editing table, says Santosh, who also worked with the Indiranagar-based LastBench Studio to help recreate certain scenes and fill the gaps in the narrative.“Using actors wasn’t an option, for multiple reasons, so I am glad we found a team who understood what was required and brought in that aesthetic,” he says. While they had initially planned to make a short film, Miracle in Antarctica soon grew into a full-length documentary, with a background score by the Indian fusion band, Lakkshya. “The members are all trained in Indian classical music, but they experiment with other Western music like jazz. We wanted to be rooted in Indianness, but have a global appeal, and they understood our vision,” says Sourabha. What the duo cherish the most about the entire process was the time spent with the scientists and their families. “They were all such good storytellers,” says Sourabha, who has especially fond memories of what happened once the cameras stopped rolling. “We had such great conversations, so unexpectedly human, where we shared meals with them, talking about everything under the sun. We got to see the people behind the scientists whose story we were telling,” she says, pointing out that while the film does depict the geopolitical importance of setting up the station in Antarctica, it is not intended to generate nationalistic fervour. Though, of course, she is proud that Indian scientists achieved this, “we are wildlife conservationists first, and the crux of the film is how important Antarctica is for our planet. When we think about planetary health, we can’t think about it in terms of nations but as members of an entire species on a living planet.” “A project like this can’t just be about nostalgia; it has to be relevant, not just for the present, but also the future,” she says. Given that many of these perspectives and views come from these highly credible scientific voices, she truly hopes that more people will pay attention to these issues. “We are just amplifying their voices through this film.” Comments have to be in English, and in full sentences. https://www.thehindu.com/news/cities/ban.title_zh: 南极奇迹：印度如何在这片冰封大陆建立首座科学考察站
https://www.thehindu.com/news/cities/ban.body_zh: 订阅账户还可享受《Premium Stories》《Editorials》《Opinions》等更多内容。订阅者Sourabha Rao是《Miracle in Antarctica》的制片人。这部新电影记录了印度首个科学考察站Dakshin Gangotri在冰封大陆建设的故事。她表示，这个故事尚未以尽可能多的方式讲述，这让她始终感到惊讶。“能够讲述这样一个故事，对我们而言是一份荣幸。”这位常驻班加罗尔的作家、诗人和电影制作人认为，这一项目具有开创性。“如此规模的项目在1983至1984年之前未曾完成，此后也没有再发生过，至少没有以同样的速度完成；此前的一个南极夏季就用了这么长时间。”这部由她丈夫Santosh Saligram执导的电影，构思源于一次偶然相遇。Sourabha说：“我们的一位朋友Prakash Matada也是电影制作人。2025年初，他在一次聚会上偶遇了Gupta博士。”Gupta博士是一位地球物理学家和地震学家，被派往南极领导这项看似不可能的任务。他此前已经撰写了一本书《Building Dakshin Gangotri at Antarctica: A Miracle》，由印度地质学会于2021年出版，当时正在积极寻找有人把这次任务拍成电影。由于Prakash当时忙于其他项目，他立即联系了Sourabha和Santosh。两人是Hamsagatha Foundation的联合创始人，该非营利组织总部位于班加罗尔，致力于讲述能够产生社会影响的故事。“我们进行了一次非常深入的通话，通话结束时便决定接手这个项目。”项目之初面临的最大挑战一如既往，是资金问题。“无论我们讲述或重述一个故事时多么热情、勤奋，也无论这个项目多么出色，归根结底都需要资金支持。”尽管Prakash已经非常明确地表示项目没有资金，但这并未妨碍他们尝试在Gupta下次访问班加罗尔时与他见面。“我们见到他时，他非常谦逊、平易近人。他询问我们从事什么专业工作，而不是直接谈论自己的故事。这种态度真的很好。”Gupta博士当时83岁。在向她概述项目后说的番话，让Sourabha始终难以忘怀。“他告诉我们，希望尽快完成，因为时间并不站在他那边。这句话深深触动了我们。”她补充说，正是这番话坚定了他们的决定。“虽然当时还不知道要如何实现，但我们知道必须促成这件事。”他们首先联系了参加那次考察的一些人：当然包括居住在海得拉巴的Gupta，也包括德里的Ashok Hanjura和科钦的KJ Mathew。“Gupta博士提供了一笔启动资金，用于开展项目。”Sourabha解释说，她与Santosh于去年5月开始为影片拍摄采访。大约在同一时期，他们也开始寻找资金。经过大量文书工作，其基金会最终从Ashraya Hastha Trust、Rohini Nilekani Philanthropies和Samagata Foundation获得了资助。“知道能够获得这些支持后，我们就全力以赴了。”影片通过采访、档案资料、库存画面和动画相结合的方式，不仅讲述Gupta的生平以及他对那个决定命运之夏的记忆，也探讨南极在当今世界的意义，尤其是在全球变暖和极端天气事件频发的背景下。“承担得起这个故事的厚重分量，以及参与其中的科学家们的分量，是一项非凡的责任。”Santosh说。他面临的最大现实难题，是找到足够的档案资料来支撑叙事。“对于当代观众或构成多元的混合人口群体来说，需要大量视觉资料作为支撑，而最初的素材远远不够。”细致的调查，当然再加上一点运气，很快改变了这一状况。“我们找到了一部旧纪录片，对帮助很大。”他说。接下来便是把一切素材整合到剪辑台上的工作。Santosh还与总部位于Indiranagar的LastBench Studio合作，帮助重现部分场景，并填补叙事中的空缺。他说：“出于多种原因，使用演员不是一个选项。因此，找到一支理解所需效果并呈现出相应美学风格的团队，让我感到很高兴。”虽然他们最初计划制作一部短片，《Miracle in Antarctica》却很快发展成长篇纪录片，配乐由印度融合乐队Lakkshya创作。“乐队成员都接受过印度古典音乐训练，同时也会尝试爵士乐等西方音乐。我们希望作品植根于印度特色，同时具备全球吸引力，而他们理解了我们的愿景。”Sourabha说。整个过程中，两人最珍惜的是与科学家及其家人相处的时光。“他们都是非常出色的讲述者。”Sourabha说。她尤其珍视摄影机停止拍摄后的情景。“我们进行了非常棒的交谈，充满人情味，超乎意料。我们和他们一起吃饭，谈论世间万物。我们看到了讲述这些科学家故事的人背后的普通人。”她指出，虽然影片确实呈现了在南极设立考察站的地缘政治重要性，但并非意在激发民族主义情绪。当然，她为印度科学家取得这一成就感到自豪，但她说：“我们首先都是野生动物保护者，影片的核心在于南极对我们的星球有多么重要。思考地球健康时，我们不能以国家来界定，而应把自己视为生活在一个星球上的完整物种的一员。”“这样的项目不能只关乎怀旧；它必须与当下相关，也必须与未来相关。”她说。鉴于其中许多观点和看法都来自这些高度值得信赖的科学界人士，她真心希望更多人关注这些问题。“我们只是通过这部电影放大他们的声音。”评论必须使用英文，并以完整句子书写。不得包含辱骂性或人身攻击内容。请遵守我们的社区评论准则。我们已迁移至新的评论平台。如果你已经是《The Gen. General Theophilus Yakubu Danjuma(Rtd). The House, while adopting a motion jointly sponsored by three lawmakers – Hons Jonathan Gaza Gbefwi, Mark Useni and Ayuba Zaku Dampar, said the university should now be known as T. Y. Danjuma Federal University, Wukari (TYDFUW), subject to the necessary amendment of its enabling Act. The Green Chamber also mandated its Committee on University Education to engage relevant stakeholders and facilitate the legislative measures required to give effect to the proposed renaming. The motion was titled: ‘Call to Rename Federal University, Wukari, Taraba State, as T. Y. Danjuma Federal University, Wukari. Moving the motion on behalf of his colleagues, Hon. Gaza noted that Federal University, Wukari, Taraba State, was established in 2011 to expand access to higher education and promote research and national development. Gaza argued that the contributions of Lieutenant General Danjuma (Rtd), to Nigeria through military and public service, philanthropy and support for education, healthcare, and vulnerable communities deserved such recognition. He noted that naming the university after the former Chief of Army Staff would honour his contributions to national development and preserve a legacy of service for future generations. The motion was seconded by Hon. Bamidele Salam. When the motion was put to a voice vote, the lawmakers overwhelmingly voted in its favour. Speaker Abbas Tajudeen, who presided over plenary, commended Hon. Gaza for bringing the motion, saying, “Hon. Jonathan, thank you for remembering our leader, our mentor. Your motion is apt. The federal government will do the needful. God bless you.” The motion was consequently referred to the House Committee on University Education for further legislative action. We’ve got the edge. 詹姆斯·昆，7秒前发布于新闻

众议院敦促联邦政府将塔拉巴州武卡里联邦大学以资深政治家、前国防部长、退役中将西奥菲卢斯·雅库布·丹朱马阁下之名重新命名。

众议院通过了一项由3名议员——乔纳森·加扎·格贝夫维、马克·乌塞尼和阿尤巴·扎库·丹帕尔——联合提出的动议。动议称，在对相关授权法案作出必要修订后，该大学应更名为T. Y. Danjuma Federal University, Wukari（TYDFUW，武卡里T. Y. 丹朱马联邦大学）。

众议院还授权其大学教育委员会与相关利益攸关方接洽，并推动落实拟议更名所需的立法措施。

该动议的标题为：“呼吁将塔拉巴州武卡里联邦大学更名为武卡里T. Y. 丹朱马联邦大学。”

加扎议员代表同僚提出动议时指出，塔拉巴州武卡里联邦大学成立于2011年，旨在扩大高等教育覆盖面，并推动研究和国家发展。加扎认为，丹朱马中将以退役身份通过军旅和公共服务、慈善事业以及对口教育、医疗和弱势群体的支持为尼日利亚作出的贡献，值得获得这种认可。他指出，以这位前陆军参谋长命名该大学，既能表彰他对国家发展的贡献，也能为后代留下服务国家的精神传承。

该动议由巴米德莱·萨拉姆议员附议。

动议付诸唱名表决时，议员们以压倒性多数表示赞成。主持全体会议的众议院议长阿巴斯·塔朱丁称赞加扎议员提出该动议，并表示：“乔纳森议员，感谢您记得我们的领袖、我们的导师。您的动议十分恰当。联邦政府将采取必要行动。愿上帝保佑您。”

随后，该动议被提交众议院大学教育委员会进一步采取立法行动。

https://leadership.ng/state-police-bill-.title: State Police Bill: Sokoto Assembly Joins 27 Others
https://leadership.ng/state-police-bill-.summary: The bill is the Constitution of the Federal Republic of Nigeria, 1999 (Sixth Alteration) Bill, 2026, transmitted by the National Assembly to the 36 state Houses of Assembly for concurrence. Presenting the bill, Abdullahi said it seeks to amend the 1999 Constitution to establish state police services while retaining the Nigeria Police Force as the federal police.
https://leadership.ng/state-police-bill-.summary_zh: 该法案是《尼日利亚联邦共和国宪法（第六次修订）法案（2026年）》，由国民议会提交给36个州议会审议并表示同意。在提交法案时，Abdullahi表示，该法案旨在修订1999年宪法，以建立各州警察机构，同时保留尼日利亚警察部队作为联邦警察机构。
https://leadership.ng/state-police-bill-.body: The bill was passed on Tuesday evening during plenary presided over by the Speaker, Alhaji Tukur Bala Bodinga. Bodinga, who confirmed the development to LEADERSHIP, said the House would soon issue an official statement on its decision. “Yes, we have passed the bill yesterday. You will see the statement any moment from now,” he said. The bill is the Constitution of the Federal Republic of Nigeria, 1999 (Sixth Alteration) Bill, 2026, transmitted by the National Assembly to the 36 state Houses of Assembly for concurrence. The motion was moved by the Deputy Majority Leader, Mustapha Abdullahi (APC – Sokoto South II). Presenting the bill, Abdullahi said it seeks to amend the 1999 Constitution to establish state police services while retaining the Nigeria Police Force as the federal police. He said the bill was transmitted by the executive, considered by the Senate on June 24 and the House of Representatives on July 23, and presented to the Sokoto Assembly on September 22. Abdullahi explained that under the proposed framework, the federal police would handle interstate and international crimes, terrorism, cybercrime, border security, policing of the Federal Capital Territory and protection of federal assets. He said state police services would be responsible for law enforcement, maintenance of public order and safety, protection of lives and property and investigation of local crimes. He added that the head of a state police service would be known as the State Commander of Police, to be appointed by the governor on the recommendation of the National Police Council, subject to confirmation by the State House of Assembly. He said a State Police Service Commission would be responsible for appointment, promotion and discipline of personnel and would receive funds directly from the state’s Consolidated Revenue Fund to ensure financial autonomy. The passage brings the number of state assemblies that have endorsed the bill to 28, exceeding the constitutional requirement of 24 states, or two-thirds of the 36 assemblies, needed for alteration of the Constitution. The development comes amid persistent security challenges in Sokoto and the North-West, where banditry, kidnapping and attacks on rural communities have disrupted farming and livelihoods. Proponents argue that officers recruited from local communities would better understand the terrain and improve intelligence gathering. The latest approvals were recorded in Kano, Sokoto, Ebonyi and Lagos on Tuesday, according to reports. We’ve got the edge. https://leadership.ng/state-police-bill-.title_zh: 州警察法案：索科托州议会加入另外27个议会行列
https://leadership.ng/state-police-bill-.body_zh: 该法案于周二晚间在众议院议长Alhaji Tukur Bala Bodinga主持的全会上获得通过。Bodinga向《LEADERSHIP》证实了这一进展，并表示众议院很快将就其决定发布正式声明。他说：“是的，我们昨天通过了该法案。你们很快就会看到声明。”该法案是《1999年尼日利亚联邦共和国宪法（第六次修订）法案（2026年）》，由国民议会提交给36个州议会审议并取得一致同意。动议由多数党副领袖Mustapha Abdullahi（APC–索科托南二选区）提出。Abdullahi在提交法案时表示，该法案旨在修订1999年宪法，以建立各州警察机构，同时保留尼日利亚警察部队作为联邦警察。他说，该法案由行政部门提交，参议院于6月24日审议，众议院于7月23日审议，并于9月22日提交索科托州议会。Abdullahi解释称，根据拟议框架，联邦警察将负责处理跨州和国际犯罪、恐怖主义、网络犯罪、边境安全、联邦首都辖区治安以及联邦资产保护。他说，各州警察机构将负责执法、维护公共秩序与安全、保护生命和财产，以及调查地方犯罪。他补充说，各州警察机构的负责人将称为警察州指挥官，由州长根据国家警察委员会的建议任命，并须经州议会确认。他说，州警察服务委员会将负责人员的任命、晋升和纪律管理，并直接从州综合收入基金获得资金，以确保财政自主。该法案获通过后，已有28个州议会表示支持，超过修改宪法所需的24个州、即36个州议会中三分之二的要求。索科托州及西北部持续面临安全挑战，土匪活动、绑架和对农村社区的袭击已扰乱农业生产和生计。支持者认为，从当地社区招募的警员能够更好地了解地形，并改善情报收集工作。据报道，周二最新获得批准的是卡诺、索科托、埃博尼和拉各斯州。欢迎关注我们的优势服务。实时报道、突发独家消息和独家视角将直接发送到您的手机。不要满足于过时新闻。加入《LEADERSHIP NEWS》的WhatsApp频道，获取全天候最新动态 →

https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/10/alak.summary: ABUJA — Minister of Solid Minerals Development, Dr Dele Alake, has dismissed reports that Nigeria sold $700 billion worth of solid minerals to the United States, insisting that no national asset has been sold or transferred under the bilateral cooperation framework.
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/10/alak.summary_zh: 阿布贾——固体矿产发展部长Dele Alake博士否认了有关尼日利亚向美国出售价值$700 billion固体矿产的报道，坚持称在双边合作框架下没有出售或转让任何国有资产。
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/10/alak.body: ABUJA — Minister of Solid Minerals Development, Dr Dele Alake, has dismissed reports that Nigeria sold $700 billion worth of solid minerals to the United States, insisting that no national asset has been sold or transferred under the bilateral cooperation framework. Alake spoke on Tuesday in Abuja while inaugurating the Nigeria-United States Committee on Strategic Cooperation in the Solid Minerals Sector, describing the reports as false and clarifying that the agreement was designed to attract investment and promote partnerships between American investors and Nigerian operators. “There is no sale of any Nigerian asset. There’s nothing exchanging hands,” he said. The minister explained that the memorandum of understanding (MoU) signed by Nigeria and the US was a government-to-government platform intended to facilitate business-to-business engagements, rather than transfer ownership of Nigeria’s mineral resources to foreign interests. “We created a platform to facilitate mingling of US investment ventures with Nigeria’s local operators. It is in the public domain. We signed it in public and published it in four or five national newspapers,” he said. The committee’s inauguration followed the strategic cooperation framework established between both countries during the 81st United Nations General Assembly in New York. Alake also dismissed claims that the United States intended to take over Nigeria’s mineral resources and security architecture, describing the reports as misleading. He said the partnership aligned with President Bola Tinubu’s economic diversification agenda, which seeks to reduce the country’s dependence on crude oil through the sustainable development of its mineral resources. According to him, Nigeria is seeking to change the pattern of international economic transactions in which resource-rich African countries export raw materials without retaining sufficient value from their exploitation. “We have the resources, the critical elements the world needs to transit to clean energy. So we are creating a new paradigm — you bring your capital, expertise and technology, to match with our natural resources and create a win-win situation. The investor gains, Nigeria gains,” he said. The minister lamented that Nigeria had historically operated a mono-product economy, while much of its solid minerals sector remained informal, with ores transported “from pit to port” without adequate local processing. He said the Federal Government had introduced a policy making local processing a condition for the granting of mineral titles, adding that investors must demonstrate a clear pathway for processing minerals within the country. According to Alake, the policy has encouraged the establishment of processing facilities across the country, including what he described as West Africa’s largest lithium processing plant, recently commissioned in Nasarawa State by the Vice President. He said the government’s reform efforts also informed the establishment of the African Minerals Strategy Group, which aims to strengthen cooperation among African countries on mineral development. Alake attributed renewed investor confidence to the macroeconomic reforms introduced by the Tinubu administration, which he said provided assurances on security of tenure and the repatriation of profits. Charging members of the newly inaugurated committee to discharge their responsibilities diligently, the minister described their assignment as critical to achieving the President’s $1 trillion economy target. He urged the committee to coordinate activities, identify viable investment opportunities and translate the Nigeria-US cooperation framework into measurable outcomes that would strengthen the country’s position in the global solid minerals industry. In his welcome address, the Permanent Secretary of the Ministry of Solid Minerals Development, Engr Faruk Yusuf Yabo, said the inauguration would translate growing bilateral engagements into a structured framework for practical cooperation and investment mobilisation. Also speaking, Economic Officer at the US Embassy, Jonathan Baas, said US President Donald Trump had prioritised three areas for American embassies: energy, artificial intelligence and superintelligence, as well as critical minerals. Baas said Washington was seeking partnerships that would secure critical mineral supply chains while ensuring that partner countries benefited from the value generated. “We just signed a contract today on looking into building AI data centres in Nigeria at the Nigerian Economic Summit. That’s the direction Washington wants us to go,” he said. In his vote of thanks, the Chief Executive Officer and Managing Director of the Nigeria Solid Minerals Company (NSMC) said the committee would coordinate implementation, facilitate investment and monitor progress towards achieving the objectives of the Nigeria-US cooperation framework. https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/10/alak.title_zh: 阿拉基否认出售7,000亿美元矿产，并为尼日利亚—美国委员会揭幕
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/10/alak.body_zh:
阿布贾——固体矿产开发部长德勒·阿拉基博士驳斥了尼日利亚向美国出售价值7000亿美元固体矿产的报道，坚称尼日利亚与美国双边合作框架下没有出售或转让任何国家资产。阿拉基周二在阿布贾为尼日利亚—美国固体矿产领域战略合作委员会揭幕时发表上述言论。他称这些报道是虚假消息，并澄清协议旨在吸引投资，促进美国投资者与尼日利亚运营商开展合作。他说：“没有任何尼日利亚资产被出售，也没有任何东西易手。”

部长解释道，尼日利亚与美国签署的谅解备忘录是一个政府间平台，旨在促进企业间商业接洽，而非将尼日利亚矿产资源的所有权转让给外国利益集团。他说：“我们搭建了一个平台，让美国投资业务与尼日利亚本地运营商携手合作。协议已向公众公开，我们公开签署，并刊登在四五家全国性报纸上。”

该委员会的揭幕仪式是在两国于纽约举行的第81届联合国大会期间确立战略合作框架后举行的。阿拉基还驳斥了美国意图接管尼日利亚矿产资源和安全架构的说法，称这些报道具有误导性。他说，合作符合博拉·蒂努布总统的经济多元化议程，即通过可持续开发矿产资源，减少尼日利亚对原油的依赖。

据他介绍，尼日利亚正寻求改变国际经济交易模式。在这一模式下，非洲资源丰富国家出口原材料，却未能从资源开发中保留足够的价值。他说：“我们拥有资源，也拥有世界转向清洁能源所需的关键元素。因此，我们正在创立一种新范式——你们带来资本、专业知识和技术，与我们的自然资源相结合，创造双赢局面。投资者获得收益，尼日利亚也获得收益。”

部长惋惜地表示，尼日利亚长期以来实行单一产品经济模式，而其固体矿产行业很大程度上仍处于非正规状态，矿石通常“从矿坑运往港口”，缺乏充分的本地加工。他说，联邦政府出台了一项政策，将本地加工设为授予矿业权的前提条件，投资者必须证明其在国内加工矿产的明确路径。据阿拉基称，这项政策鼓励了全国范围内加工设施的建设，其中包括他所说的西非最大锂加工厂，该厂最近已由副总统在纳萨拉瓦州主持投产。

他说，政府的改革努力也为非洲矿产战略小组的成立提供了指导，该小组旨在加强非洲各国在矿产开发方面的合作。阿拉基将投资者信心回升归因于蒂努布政府实施的宏观经济改革，并称这些改革就土地使用权的保障以及利润汇回提供了保证。

部长要求新揭幕的委员会成员勤勉履职，并表示委员会肩负的使命对于实现总统提出的经济规模达到1万亿美元的目标至关重要。他敦促委员会协调各项活动、发掘可行的投资机会，并将尼日利亚—美国合作框架转化为可衡量的成果，从而巩固尼日利亚在全球固体矿产产业中的地位。

在欢迎辞中，固体矿产开发部常务秘书法鲁克·优素福·亚博工程师表示，此次揭幕将把日益增多的双边接触转化为务实合作和投资动员的结构化框架。美国大使馆经济官员乔纳森·巴斯也出席并发言，称美国总统唐纳德·特朗普已要求美国大使馆优先关注三个领域：能源、人工智能与超级智能，以及关键矿产。巴斯说，华盛顿正在寻求能够保障关键矿产供应链的合作伙伴关系，同时确保伙伴国家能够分享所创造的价值。

他说：“我们今天刚在尼日利亚经济峰会上签署了一份合同，研究在尼日利亚建设人工智能数据中心的可行性。这就是华盛顿希望我们前进的方向。”

尼日利亚固体矿产公司首席执行官兼董事总经理在致谢辞中表示，该委员会将协调合作框架的落实，促进投资，并监督实现尼日利亚—美国合作框架目标的进展。

https://www.myjoyonline.com/telecel-ghan.body: Telecel Ghana marked World Sustainability Day with a renewed commitment to practical climate action, showcasing how it integrates sustainability into its network operations, products, employee culture, and social impact initiatives. The organisation celebrated this year’s World Sustainability Day as a premium partner of the Ghana National Climate & ESG Policy Summit 2026, organised by Intelligence Nature International under the auspices of the Office of the Minister of State for Climate Change and Sustainability. The summit brought together policymakers, regulators, development institutions, and private-sector leaders to discuss Ghana’s green transition and businesses' role in accelerating climate action. Speaking during a private-sector panel discussion, Rita Agyeiwaa Rockson, Head of Sustainability, Foundation and External Communications at Telecel Ghana, called for sustainability to move from complex concepts and high-level commitments to practical actions organisations, entrepreneurs, and individuals can understand and adopt. “Sustainability cannot remain a conversation that only happens at the top, based on the assumption that everyone understands it. We need to simplify the language and connect it to the everyday decisions of organisations and individuals. When people understand how sustainability reduces costs, strengthens resilience and improves access to customers and investors, it becomes relevant to them,” Rita said. She encouraged organisations to start with achievable interventions, measure results, and use credible data to build toward broader climate ambitions. “There are practical actions that corporate organisations, small businesses and individuals can take to contribute to the larger sustainability goals we want to achieve. The important thing is to start, collect the data and communicate the impact being created,” she added. For Telecel Ghana, this approach is reflected in how the organisation integrates sustainability across its operations. To reduce the environmental footprint of its operations, Telecel Ghana is transitioning parts of its network infrastructure to renewable energy, with 15 exchanges currently powered by solar. The investment reduces its reliance on the national grid and supports more sustainable network operations. In August 2026, Telecel Ghana introduced its biodegradable Eco-SIM, manufactured with 90 per cent less plastic than standard SIM cards. The organisation has also planted more than 40,000 trees across the Achimota, Chipa and South Fomangso forest reserves, contributing to reforestation and ecosystem restoration. Its sustainability efforts also extend to digital and financial inclusion. Telecel Ghana’s services let customers complete essential transactions remotely, reducing the need to travel, costs, and associated emissions. Its digital inclusion initiatives equip entrepreneurs, including women-led businesses, with the skills and tools to improve efficiency, access new markets and strengthen their enterprises. According to Rita, inclusion must remain central to Ghana’s transition to a greener economy. “As we build the communities and economies of the future, we must pay attention to who is being included. Digital and financial inclusion are essential to ensuring that the benefits of sustainable development reach entrepreneurs, small businesses and underserved communities,” she said. Throughout the Month, Telecel Ghana also encouraged employees to make more environmentally responsible choices. Activities included No-Plastic Days, which promoted alternatives to single-use plastics, and a Green Market that connected employees with local entrepreneurs offering environmentally responsible and locally made products. The activities demonstrated how everyday choices can promote responsible consumption while creating opportunities for entrepreneurs advancing circular production. The organization’s participation in the summit extended the internal campaign into a broader national conversation on climate action, sustainable finance, ESG disclosure, carbon markets and green investment. “We recognise that sustainability is a journey and that there is still more work to be done. Our ambition is clear: connect people and organisations in ways that support a more inclusive society while progressively reducing our environmental impact. Achieving this requires collaboration across sectors, practical action and consistent measurement of progress,” Rita said. Telecel Ghana’s sustainability agenda rests on four pillars: Responsible Business, Inclusion for All, Environmental Responsibility, and Sustainable Society. These pillars guide how the organisation manages its operations, deploys technology, supports communities and contributes to Ghana’s sustainable development. Through investments in renewable energy, responsible products, environmental restoration, digital inclusion and employee engagement, Telecel Ghana is working to make sustainability an enduring part of its business and the communities it serves
https://www.myjoyonline.com/telecel-ghan.title_zh: Telecel Ghana在全国ESG峰会上展示务实的气候行动
https://www.myjoyonline.com/telecel-ghan.body_zh:
加纳Telecel以实际行动强化承诺纪念世界可持续发展日，并展示如何将可持续发展融入网络运营、产品、员工文化和社会影响项目。该公司以高级合作伙伴身份参加2026年加纳国家气候与ESG政策峰会，庆祝今年的世界可持续发展日。峰会由Intelligence Nature International组织，在气候变化与可持续发展国务部长办公室支持下举行。峰会汇聚政策制定者、监管机构、发展机构和私营部门领袖，讨论加纳的绿色转型以及企业在加快气候行动方面的作用。

Telecel加纳可持续发展、基金会与对外传播负责人Rita Agyeiwaa Rockson在私营部门专题讨论中呼吁，可持续发展不应只停留在复杂理念和高层承诺上，而应转化为组织、创业者和个人都能理解并采取的实际行动。

Rita表示：“可持续发展不能只是一场只在高层进行的对话，更不能建立在所有人都理解它的假设之上。我们需要简化相关表述，并将其与组织和个人的日常决策联系起来。当人们明白可持续发展如何降低成本、增强韧性以及改善接触客户和投资者的渠道时，它才会真正与他们产生关联。”

她鼓励各组织从可实现的干预措施入手，衡量结果，并利用可信数据推动更宏大的气候目标。Rita补充道：“企业组织、小型企业和个人都可以采取实际行动，为实现我们期望的更大可持续发展目标作出贡献。重要的是迈出第一步、收集数据，并传达由此产生的影响。”

对Telecel加纳而言，这一方针体现在该公司将可持续发展融入各项运营的方式中。为减少运营对环境造成的影响，Telecel加纳正将部分网络基础设施转换为可再生能源，目前已有15个交换局由太阳能供电。这项投资减少了公司对国家电网的依赖，并支持更加可持续的网络运营。

2026年8月，Telecel加纳推出可生物降解的Eco-SIM，其制造过程使用的塑料比标准SIM卡少90%。该组织还在Achimota、Chipa和South Fomangso森林保护地种植了4万多棵树，为再造林和生态系统恢复作出贡献。

其可持续发展工作还延伸至数字普惠和金融普惠。Telecel加纳的服务让客户能够远程完成必要交易，从而减少出行需求、成本及相关排放。其数字普惠项目为创业者，包括女性创办的企业，提供技能和工具，帮助他们提高效率、开拓新市场并增强企业实力。

Rita表示，包容必须继续成为加纳向更绿色经济转型的核心。“在建设未来的社区和经济时，我们必须关注谁正被纳入其中。数字普惠和金融普惠对于确保可持续发展的成果惠及创业者、小型企业和服务不足的社区至关重要。”

在整个活动月期间，Telecel加纳还鼓励员工作出更具环境责任的选择。相关活动包括提倡减少一次性塑料制品的‘无塑料日’，以及把员工与提供环保及本地制造产品的当地创业者连接起来的绿色市场。这些活动表明，日常选择既可以促进负责任消费，也能为推动循环生产的企业创造机会。

该公司参加峰会，将内部活动扩展至围绕气候行动、可持续金融、ESG披露、碳市场和绿色投资的更广泛全国讨论。Rita表示：“我们认识到，可持续发展是一段旅程，仍有更多工作要做。我们的目标十分明确：以支持更具包容性的社会的方式连接人们和组织，同时逐步减少我们的环境影响。实现这一目标需要跨部门协作、实际行动以及持续衡量进展。”

Telecel加纳的可持续发展议程建立在四大支柱之上：负责任业务、人人包容、环境责任和可持续社会。这些支柱指引该组织管理运营、部署技术支持社区并为加纳的可持续发展作出贡献。

通过投资可再生能源、负责任的产品、环境恢复、数字普惠和员工参与，Telecel加纳正努力让可持续发展成为其业务及其所服务社区的一项长期特征

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary_zh: “他们那边存在一些情况，因此我认为我们需要听听他们的说法。”当记者问及会议能否推迟至12月以后时，康这样表示。不过，美国国防部周二称，预计会议将于2027年初举行，理由是高级官员之间存在日程冲突。周三达成的协议确认了此次延期，从而结束了这场年度会议是否会于今年举行的不确定性。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: Defense Minister Kang Shin-chul and U.S. Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth confirmed the postponement during their first face-to-face meeting Wednesday on the sidelines of a regional defense gathering in Cebu, Philippines. The two also agreed to hold a bilateral defense meeting in Washington in December, ahead of the rescheduled SCM, reaffirming their commitment to strengthening defense cooperation and maintaining a strong combined defense posture. The meeting, initially scheduled to take 15 minutes, lasted about 40 minutes. Conducted with simultaneous interpretation, the extended talks allowed for in-depth discussion of alliance issues. Before departing for the Philippines, Kang said the SCM schedule might need to be discussed with Washington, noting that the U.S. side had its own situation to consider. “There are circumstances on their side, so I think we need to hear what they have to say,” Kang told reporters when asked whether the meeting could be pushed beyond December. Asked whether he would personally raise the SCM schedule with Hegseth, Kang said, “I think we need to discuss it if necessary. I believe it is an important issue.” The SCM is traditionally held in the fall. However, the U.S. Department of Defense said Tuesday that the meeting was expected to be held in early 2027, citing scheduling conflicts among senior officials. The agreement reached on Wednesday confirmed the postponement, ending uncertainty over whether the annual meeting would take place this year. Kang and Hegseth also agreed that holding a successful 58th SCM would be important for the alliance. Before the agreement, a U.S. defense official had described the decision to postpone the meeting as having been mutually agreed upon, but Seoul maintained that no schedule had been finalized. Earlier Wednesday, Korea’s defense ministry had said, “We are consulting with the U.S. Department of Defense, taking into account mutually available dates, and no specific details have been finalized.” Despite the differing public statements, scheduling difficulties on the U.S. side are believed to be a major factor behind the delay. Washington faces competing priorities, including ongoing military operations and political developments at home, which could complicate efforts to arrange the annual meeting before the end of the year. “As the minister has repeatedly said, there are no major differences between Korea and the U.S.,” a military official noted. “Any differences at the military level can be resolved through close consultations.” Hegseth expressed hope that the two countries would strengthen defense cooperation while maintaining a robust combined defense posture. While the allies have faced questions over the pace of OPCON transfer, the latest talks indicated that both sides remain committed to moving the process forward through close consultations. The postponement comes as Seoul seeks to complete the full operational capability (FOC) verification of the future Combined Forces Command and agree with Washington on a target year for OPCON transfer. Kang told lawmakers Monday that the government was working with the United States to complete the verification process and determine a target year by the end of 2026. FOC verification is the second stage of a three-stage, conditions-based process to assess the readiness of a future combined command led by a Korean four-star general. The allies have also faced questions over whether the standards used to assess the conditions for OPCON transfer should change to reflect evolving security threats. The FOC verification is also understood to assess specific capabilities required for the future combined command to carry out its missions, rather than the overall military capabilities of the alliance, which continue to evolve in response to changing security threats
