https://www.premiumtimesng.com/regional/.body: The Anambra State Government has called on the Nigeria Medical Association (NMA) to support its efforts to eradicate quack and unregistered health facilities in the state. Adam Obidike, the commissioner for health in Anambra made the appeal during the closing ceremony of the 2026 Physicians Week and Scientific Conference of the Nigerian Medical Association, Awka Zone in Awka on Sunday. The theme of the Week, Luncheon and Award Presentation Ceremony was “Securing the Future of Medicine in Nigeria and Sub-Saharan Africa”. Mr Obidike, a medical doctor, said the NMA was a critical partner and that the government would collaborate with the association to track fake and unregistered facilities. “We are determined to shut all of them down because when people go there, they receive treatment that is not proper for their ailment. “We have a checklist and anybody who wants to set up a facility should go to the department of medical services and get the conditions, including the design of the building,” he said. In his welcome address, Tim-Uzoma Mbaeri, chairman of NMA, Awka Zone, said this year’s Physicians Week and Scientific Conference was a time to celebrate the profession and reconnect members with each other. Mr Mbaeri, a professor, said the association used the event to visit sick colleagues, provide free laboratory tests including prostate specific antigens testing, urinalysis among others. He thanked members and partners of the NMA, Awka branch, whose contributions ensured the success of the physicians’ week. “We also enjoyed a novelty football match, had an opportunity for friendship, recreation, and strong inter-agency relationships. “We find satisfaction not merely in the event we organised, but in the lives we have touched, the colleagues we have encouraged, the relationships we have strengthened and the visibility we have given to our profession,” he said. Mr Mbaeri said three personalities were honoured with awards of meritorious service to the medical profession and the NMA, including Ifeoma Njelita, Emmanuel Umenweke and Amaka Ezeno. Njelita is an associate professor and a consultant in community medicine at the Chukwuemeka Odumegwu Ojukwu University Teaching Hospital. Umenweke is a medical doctor with the Nnamdi Azikiwe University Medical Center, Awka while Ezeno, the third awardee is a lawyer, Notary Public and member of the Body of Benchers
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/regional/.title_zh: 安ambra州政府寻求尼日利亚医学会支持打击非法医疗机构
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/regional/.body_zh: 阿纳姆拉州政府已呼吁尼日利亚医学协会支持该州打击、取缔虚假及未注册医疗机构的努力。阿纳姆拉州卫生专员亚当·奥比迪克于周日在奥沃卡举行的尼日利亚医学协会奥沃卡区分会2026年医师周暨科学会议闭幕式上提出这一呼吁。本届医师周、午餐会及颁奖典礼的主题是“保障尼日利亚和撒哈拉以南非洲医学的未来”。身为医学博士的奥比迪克先生表示，尼日利亚医学协会是重要的合作伙伴，政府将与该协会合作，追踪虚假和未注册的医疗机构。他说：“我们决心关闭所有这类机构，因为人们前往那里接受的治疗并不适合其疾病。我们有一份清单，任何想设立医疗机构的人都应前往医疗服务部门了解相关条件，包括建筑设计方案。”尼日利亚医学协会奥沃卡区分会主席蒂姆·乌佐马·姆巴埃里在欢迎辞中表示，今年的医师周暨科学会议是庆祝医学职业、让会员彼此重新联络交流的时刻。姆巴埃里教授说，该协会利用这次活动探望患病同事，并提供免费实验室检测，包括前列腺特异性抗原检测、尿液分析等。他感谢尼日利亚医学协会奥沃卡分会的会员和合作伙伴，正是他们的贡献确保了医师周圆满成功。他说：“我们还举办了一场别开生面的足球赛，获得了交流友谊、放松娱乐和加强机构间关系的机会。我们不仅从自己组织的活动中获得满足，也从帮助他人、鼓励同事、加强联系以及提升本职业社会可见度中感受到价值。”姆巴埃里先生表示，3人因对医学职业和尼日利亚医学协会作出卓越贡献而获颁奖项，包括伊费奥马·恩杰利塔、埃马纽埃尔·乌门韦克和阿玛卡·埃泽诺。恩杰利塔是楚库韦梅卡·奥杜梅格武·奥朱克武大学教学医院的社区医学副教授及顾问医师。乌门韦克是奥沃卡南纳姆迪·阿齐基韦大学医学中心的医学博士，第三位获奖者埃泽诺则是律师、公证人及律师公会成员。

https://www.rappler.com/newsbreak/fact-c.summary: The Chinese embassy did not confirm that President Marcos sent Duterte to The Hague at Senator Pangilinan's request, contradicting claims made on social media. The embassy's response to Pangilinan's remarks was rhetorical and did not affirm any statements regarding Duterte's arrest or the senator's request. Claim: The Chinese embassy confirmed that President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. sent former president Rodrigo Duterte to The Hague at Senator Kiko Pangilinan’s request.
https://www.rappler.com/newsbreak/fact-c.summary_zh: 中国大使馆没有证实马科斯总统应帕尼利南参议员的要求将杜特尔特送往海牙，此事与社交媒体上的说法相矛盾。中国大使馆对帕尼利南言论的回应仅是反问，并未确认任何有关杜特尔特被捕或参议员提出请求的说法。相关说法称：中国大使馆证实，费迪南德·马科斯三世总统应基科·帕尼利南参议员的要求，将前总统罗德里戈·杜特尔特送往海牙。
https://www.rappler.com/newsbreak/fact-c.body: Already have Rappler+? Sign in to listen to groundbreaking journalism. The Chinese embassy did not confirm that President Marcos sent Duterte to The Hague at Senator Pangilinan's request, contradicting claims made on social media. The embassy's response to Pangilinan's remarks was rhetorical and did not affirm any statements regarding Duterte's arrest or the senator's request. Duterte's arrest in March 2025 was based on an ICC warrant, and the ICC has denied any collusion with the Philippine administration regarding the case. This is AI-generated. Read the article for full context. Report any errors . Claim: The Chinese embassy confirmed that President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. sent former president Rodrigo Duterte to The Hague at Senator Kiko Pangilinan’s request. The posts were made on October 21, 2026, several hours after the Chinese embassy in Manila responded to Senator Kiko Pangilinan’s remarks on Chinese Ambassador Jing Quan. As of writing, the posts drew a total of 7,400 reactions, more than 1,000 comments, and 1,254 shares. The facts: While the Chinese embassy did undermine Pangilinan, it did not say that the senator requested Marcos to send Duterte to The Hague. Instead, the embassy replied to an earlier post made by Pangilinan asking the President to send Chinese Ambassador Jing Quan back to China. In his post , Pangilinan wrote: “Mr. President, if you can send Duterte, Quiboloy and Remualdez to jail… then you can most certainly send this arrogant, insulting, crude and insolent alien back to his country of origin,” referring to the Chinese Ambassador. The Chinese embassy’s official Facebook page only responded with rhetorical questions regarding the senator’s language. It did not officially affirm his statements on Duterte, Quiboloy, and Romualdez. The embassy’s post read: “Using thuggish, hooligan-style language to launch personal attacks on others—is this the calibre and standards of a Philippine senator? Is this the diplomacy and prudence that the DFA claims to uphold?” Duterte’s arrest: In March 2025, Duterte’s arrest was facilitated by Philippine authorities, in accordance with an arrest warrant issued by the International Criminal Court (ICC) on charges of crimes against humanity . President Marcos affirmed that this facilitation complied with the Philippines’ commitment to the International Criminal Police Organization (Interpol). The ICC has also repeatedly refuted allegations of dependence on the Philippine administration. In a statement sent to the Inquirer , ICC spokesperson Oriane Maillet said the court is mandated to operate independently and impartially under the Rome Statute. A separate interview with ICC spokesperson Fadi El Abdallah presents a denial of collusion with the Marcos administration, as court judges make decisions independently. Chinese embassy and the West Philippine Sea: In an interview with the media on October 15 , the ambassador said the Philippines “should feel fortunate” that China does not use force in its maritime dispute. His statement was a response to Defense Secretary Gilberto Teodoro Jr.’s statement saying Beijing was a troublemaker in the region, and not Manila. Public officials, including Pangilinan, then reacted to the ambassador’s statement. Before this incident, it was reported that since Jing took over in December 2025, the Chinese embassy in Manila has amplified its rhetoric and engaged in online word wars with Philippine government spokespersons and officials. Previous fact-checks: As the maritime dispute continues, Duterte remains at the ICC . The actual trial will begin on November 30. Rappler has previously fact-checked claims regarding Duterte at the ICC: Jade Florido is a volunteer for Rappler’s Research and Data unit. She is a third-year Development Studies student at the University of the Philippines – Manila. https://www.rappler.com/newsbreak/fact-c.title_zh: 事实核查：中国大使馆并未证实杜特尔蒂遭国际刑事法院“策划”逮捕
https://www.rappler.com/newsbreak/fact-c.body_zh: 已经订阅Rappler+？登录即可收听突破性新闻。中国大使馆没有确认马科斯总统应参议员帕尼利南的请求将杜特尔特送往海牙，此举与社交媒体上的说法相悖。大使馆对帕尼利南言论的回应是反问式的，没有确认任何有关杜特尔特被捕或参议员提出请求的说法。杜特尔特于2025年3月被捕的依据是国际刑事法院的逮捕令，国际刑事法院也否认了与菲律宾政府就该案存在任何串通。本文由人工智能生成。阅读全文以了解完整背景。报告任何错误。说法：中国大使馆确认，费迪南德·马科斯三世总统应参议员基科·帕尼利南的请求，将前总统罗德里戈·杜特尔特送往海牙。这些帖子发布于2026年10月21日，即中国驻马尼拉大使馆回应参议员基科·帕尼利南针对中国大使景泉言论的数小时后。截至撰稿时，这些帖子共获得7,400次互动、逾1,000条评论和1,254次分享。事实：虽然中国大使馆确实反驳了帕尼利南，但没有说参议员请求马科斯将杜特尔特送往海牙。相反，大使馆回复的是帕尼利南早先发布的一则帖子，该帖要求总统将中国大使景泉送回中国。帕尼利南在帖子中写道：“总统先生，如果您能把杜特尔特、基博洛伊和雷穆亚尔德斯送进监狱……那么您当然也能把这个傲慢、侮辱别人、粗鲁和无礼的外国人送回他的原籍国。”他指的是中国大使。中国大使馆的官方脸书页面只用反问回应了参议员措辞问题，没有正式确认他关于杜特尔特、基博洛伊和罗穆亚尔德斯的说法。大使馆的帖子写道：“使用暴徒、流氓式的语言对他人进行人身攻击——这就是菲律宾参议员的水准和标准吗？这就是外交部声称要维护的外交和审慎吗？”杜特尔特被捕：2025年3月，杜特尔特在菲律宾当局配合国际刑事法院签发的逮捕令下被捕，罪名是危害人类罪。马科斯总统确认，这一协助行动符合菲律宾对国际刑警组织的承诺。国际刑事法院也多次驳斥了有关该法院依赖菲律宾政府的指控。国际刑事法院发言人奥里安·梅莱特向《问询者报》发来声明称，根据《罗马条例》，该法院必须独立、公正地运作。国际刑事法院发言人法迪·埃尔·阿卜杜拉在接受另一次采访时否认与马科斯政府串通，并表示法院法官独立作出决定。中国大使馆与西菲律宾海：10月15日接受媒体采访时，大使表示，在海洋争端中，中国没有使用武力，菲律宾“应该感到幸运”。这番言论是针对国防部长小吉尔伯特·特奥多罗的说法，后者称北京是该地区的麻烦制造者，而不是马尼拉。包括帕尼利南在内的菲律宾公职人员随后对大使的这番言论作出反应。据报道，在此次事件之前，自2025年12月景泉接任大使以来，中国驻马尼拉大使馆一直强化其言辞，与菲律宾政府发言人和官员在网上展开口水战。此前的核查：随着海洋争端持续，杜特尔特仍被关押在国际刑事法院。审判将于11月30正式开始。Rappler此前已核查过有关杜特尔特在国际刑事法院案件的说法：哈德·弗洛里多是Rappler研究与数据部门的志愿者。她是菲律宾大学马尼拉校区发展研究专业三年级学生。如果您在社交网络上发现可疑的脸书页面、群组、账号、网站、文章或照片，请通过factcheck@rappler.com联系我们。让我们一次核查一条信息，共同打击虚假信息。订阅Rappler+，解锁独家内容和无限访问权限

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.summary_zh: 据朝鲜官方媒体周一报道，朝鲜官员在平壤友谊塔向阵亡中国军人敬献花圈，以纪念他们。此前，朝鲜领导人Kim Jong-un于上周突袭访问中国丹东。朝鲜中央通讯社（KCNA）称，高级官员于周日在纪念碑前敬献花圈，纪念中国志愿军参加1950—53年朝鲜战争76周年。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body: North Korean officials have paid tribute at the Friendship Tower in Pyongyang in honor of fallen Chinese soldiers, state media reported Monday, after leader Kim Jong-un's surprise day trip to China's Dandong last week. The Korean Central News Agency (KCNA) said senior officials laid wreaths at the monument Sunday to mark the 76th anniversary of the Chinese People's Volunteers' entry into the 1950-53 Korean War. Among them were Kim Hyong-sik, vice chairman of the Supreme People's Assembly standing committee, and Vice Foreign Minister Kim Myong-su. They were joined by Chinese embassy officials, including Qi Han, charge d'affaires ad interim, and a Chinese delegation led by Hong Zongming, vice minister of China's veterans affairs ministry. Wreaths were also laid at cemeteries and graves of Chinese soldiers in Anju, Hoechang County, Onsong County and Kaesong. The Chinese side hosted a reception later Sunday to mark the anniversary, the report added. The North Korean leader traveled to the Chinese border city of Dandong on Saturday, a trip meant to showcase the decades-old alliance with China and mark the anniversary. He visited a war memorial to Chinese soldiers who fought in the Korean War, attended a banquet and toured a bus factory

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: Korea's budget ministry said Monday it will begin reviewing spending restructuring measures in November for inclusion in the 2028 budget proposal, as part of efforts to develop detailed plans to improve spending efficiency. The Ministry of Planning and Budget unveiled the plan after incorporating 88 measures to cut spending by 44.2 trillion won ($33.4 billion) into the 2027 budget proposal. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary_zh: 韩国祖国和 Veterans Affairs 部周一表示，一名参加1950年至1953年朝鲜战争的法国老兵遗骸将于周二运抵韩国，并于本周末安葬在釜山联合国纪念公墓，从而实现他希望长眠于曾经为之战斗的国家的遗愿。谢尔盖·阿尔尚博于6月5日去世，享年96岁。他主动报名参战，于1951年10月至1952年9月担任联合国军法国营第3连反坦克火箭炮手。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: The remains of a French veteran of the 1950-53 Korean War will be brought to Korea on Tuesday and buried at the U.N. Memorial Cemetery in Busan this weekend, fulfilling his wish that he be laid to rest in the country he fought for, the Ministry of Patriots and Veterans Affairs said Monday. Serge Archambeau, who died on June 5 at the age of 96, volunteered for the war and served as a bazooka gunner with the 3rd Company of the French Battalion, part of the United Nations forces, from October 1951 to September 1952. He fought in some of the war’s fiercest battles, including the so-called Battle of T-Bone Hill and the Battle of the Iron Triangle, and received the Cross for Military Valour with bronze star and other French honors. His remains will arrive at Incheon International Airport’s Terminal 2 on Tuesday. Roger Quintard, secretary-general of a French veterans’ association and executor of Archambeau’s will, will accompany them because the veteran’s family is unable to travel for health reasons. A ceremony marking the arrival of the remains will begin at 12:20 p.m. A Ministry of National Defense honor guard will escort the remains to a hearse. Attendees will include Michel Miraillet, the French charge d’affaires in Seoul. Also attending will be Roland Monclar, son of Gen. Ralph Monclar, who voluntarily took a demotion from lieutenant general to lieutenant colonel so he could lead the French battalion in Korea. The burial, hosted by the French Embassy, will take place Saturday at 2 p.m. Vice Minister Kang Yun-jin and crew members of the French Navy frigate Vendemiaire will attend. “Today’s Korea exists thanks to the dedication of the U.N. veterans who fought at the cost of their lives in the brightest years of their youth,” Minister Kwon Oh-eul said. He noted that the burial falls in the year marking 140 years of diplomatic ties between Korea and France. Archambeau will be the 39th U.N. veteran buried at the cemetery since 2015. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 法国朝鲜战争老兵遗骸将在釜山安葬
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 韩国祖国和 veterans 事务部周一表示，一名参加1950年至1953年朝鲜战争的法国老兵的遗骸将于周二运抵韩国，并于本周末安葬于釜山联合国纪念公墓，从而实现他安葬在曾经效力过的国家的遗愿。96岁的 Serge Archambeau 于6月5日去世。他自愿参战，于1951年10月至1952年9月担任联合国部队法国营第3连的一名火箭筒手。他参加过战争中最激烈的几场战斗，包括所谓的“T骨山战役”和“铁三角战役”，并获得带铜星的军事勇气十字勋章及法国其他荣誉。他的遗骸将于周二抵达仁川国际机场2号航站楼。法国退伍军人协会秘书长、Archambeau 遗嘱执行人 Roger Quintard 将陪同遗骸前来，因为这位老兵的家人因健康原因无法出行。迎候遗骸抵达的仪式将于中午12时20分开始。国防部礼宾仪仗队将护送遗骸登上灵车。出席人员包括法国驻首尔代办 Michel Miraillet。法国海军“旺多姆号”护卫舰船员也将参加由法国大使馆主办、于周六下午2时举行的安葬仪式。副部长 Kang Yun-jin 和法国海军“旺多姆号”护卫舰船员将出席。Kwon Oh-eul 部长说：“今天的韩国，得益于联合国老兵在人生最灿烂的年华以生命为代价所付出的奉献。”他指出，此次安葬恰逢韩法建交140周年。Archambeau 将成为自2015年以来安葬在该公墓的第39名联合国老兵。本文在生成式人工智能协助下完成，并由《韩国时报》编辑。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.summary: 24 visit to Dandong, China, and his meeting with Wang Huning should not be dismissed as another diplomatic ceremony. More importantly, it should serve as a warning to the United States, South Korea and Japan that the strategic environment in Northeast Asia is changing. His involvement in Kim’s visit, including conveying Chinese President Xi’s personal greetings, underscores the political significance Beijing attaches to its relationship with North Korea.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.summary_zh: 王沪宁24日访问中国丹东并会见朝鲜最高领导人金正恩，不应被视为又一次外交仪式。更重要的是，此事应向美国、韩国和日本发出警告：东北亚的战略环境正在发生变化。王沪宁参与金正恩此次访华行程，包括转达中国国家主席习近平的亲切问候，凸显了北京对朝韩关系的重视。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.body: North Korean leader Kim Jong-un’s Oct. 24 visit to Dandong, China, and his meeting with Wang Huning should not be dismissed as another diplomatic ceremony. It was a carefully staged demonstration of strengthening relations between Beijing and Pyongyang. More importantly, it should serve as a warning to the United States, South Korea and Japan that the strategic environment in Northeast Asia is changing. Wang Huning is not an ordinary Chinese official. He ranks fourth in the Chinese Communist Party hierarchy and serves as chairman of the Chinese People’s Political Consultative Conference. A former professor at Fudan University, Wang has been one of China’s most influential political thinkers and strategists, advising three successive leaders: Jiang Zemin, Hu Jintao and Xi Jinping. Few Chinese officials have enjoyed such sustained influence across three administrations. Wang has helped shape the ideological foundations of modern Chinese governance. His involvement in Kim’s visit, including conveying Chinese President Xi’s personal greetings, underscores the political significance Beijing attaches to its relationship with North Korea. Equally important was Kim’s crossing of the recently opened New Amnok River Bridge connecting the Chinese border city of Dandong with North Korea's Sinuiju. Completed in 2014, the bridge remained unused for approximately 12 years before opening this October. Its four lanes and modern infrastructure provide new opportunities for transportation, trade and economic cooperation. The bridge is more than concrete and steel. It is a political statement. China and North Korea are signaling their intention to expand economic engagement. The opening of the bridge could facilitate the movement of industrial equipment, raw materials, energy products and other goods essential to North Korea’s economy. This raises an uncomfortable question: What remains of the international sanctions regime against North Korea? United Nations sanctions have not formally ended. Nevertheless, sanctions are effective only when major countries enforce them. If China expands economic cooperation while Russia continues its military relationship with Pyongyang, the practical effectiveness of international pressure could be seriously weakened. The international community must distinguish between sanctions that exist on paper and sanctions that actually influence North Korean behavior. There is another dimension to this development. North Korea is strengthening its relations with both China and Russia. These relationships are not identical. China provides North Korea with its principal economic lifeline, while Russia has become an increasingly important military partner. Together, these relationships could give Pyongyang greater strategic flexibility and reduce its incentive to negotiate seriously over its nuclear weapons. This is a serious development for the United States and its allies. However, the challenge is not exclusively military. Economic dependence has become a strategic vulnerability, and South Korea provides a clear example. China remains an enormous market for South Korean businesses and an important supplier of industrial materials, components, and critical minerals. South Korea cannot simply abandon this economic relationship without significant consequences for its industries and national economy. At the same time, South Korea relies on foreign suppliers for essential energy resources, including nuclear fuel. Russia has been a significant supplier of enriched uranium used in South Korea’s civilian nuclear power industry. These dependencies create potential vulnerabilities during periods of international confrontation. The United States frequently encourages its allies to reduce their strategic dependence on China and Russia. That objective is understandable. But Washington must recognize that economic independence cannot be achieved through political declarations alone. If America expects its allies to diversify away from potentially unreliable suppliers, it must help provide practical alternatives. This means expanding cooperation in critical minerals, advanced manufacturing, energy security and nuclear fuel supplies. It also means strengthening investment, encouraging reliable supply chains and accepting that economic security requires long-term commitments. America cannot expect its allies to assume substantial economic risks without helping them manage the consequences. Equally important is the relationship between South Korea and Japan. The two countries are democratic, economically advanced and closely allied with the United States. They face many of the same security challenges, particularly North Korea’s nuclear weapons and missile capabilities. Yet historical disagreements continue to undermine political trust. Japan must recognize that historical sensitivities among Koreans are real and cannot simply be dismissed as outdated nationalism. Japan’s colonial rule over Korea remains an important part of Korean historical memory. Symbolic gestures by Japanese political leaders matter. Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi’s offerings to Yasukuni Shrine, where convicted Class-A war criminals are enshrined alongside Japan’s war dead, create unnecessary tensions. Japan has every right to remember those who died in its service. But its leaders should find ways to honor their dead without reopening historical wounds among neighboring countries. Such gestures are particularly unhelpful when regional security cooperation is becoming more important. South Korea also has responsibilities. Koreans must recognize that legitimate historical grievances cannot become a permanent obstacle to necessary security cooperation. Geography, economic interdependence and shared security interests make cooperation with Japan indispensable. Neither country needs to forget its history. Both must understand that protecting their future requires practical cooperation today. This cooperation should include intelligence sharing, missile defense coordination, maritime security, supply-chain resilience and closer communication between political and military leaders. The United States has a particularly important responsibility in making this possible. American leadership in Northeast Asia is urgently needed, but leadership means more than maintaining military forces or demanding increased defense spending from allies. It requires consistent diplomatic engagement, credible security commitments and a willingness to help allies overcome political and economic obstacles. Washington must understand that strengthening the U.S.–South Korea alliance and the U.S.–Japan alliance separately is not enough. It must also encourage a durable relationship between Seoul and Tokyo. The three countries do not have to agree on every political issue. But they must recognize that their security interests are closely connected. China and North Korea are strengthening their relationship. Russia continues to deepen its cooperation with Pyongyang. These developments do not necessarily mean that Beijing, Moscow and Pyongyang constitute a unified military alliance. Their interests differ, and those differences should not be ignored. Nevertheless, their growing cooperation presents challenges that deserve serious attention. Kim’s visit to Dandong should therefore be understood as more than a bilateral diplomatic event. It is a reminder that economic relationships, military cooperation and political symbolism are increasingly intertwined. The United States, South Korea and Japan must respond with greater strategic coordination, not complacency or unnecessary confrontation Military deterrence remains essential. But deterrence without economic resilience, political trust and sustained American leadership will not be sufficient to preserve stability in Northeast Asia. Chun In-bum is the former commander of the Republic of Korea Army Special Warfare Command
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.title_zh: 金正恩访问丹东为韩美日合作敲响警钟
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.body_zh: 朝鲜领导人金正恩于10月24日访问中国丹东并会见王沪宁，不应被视为又一场外交仪式。这是一场精心安排的展示，旨在加强北京与平壤之间的关系。更重要的是，它应当向美国、韩国和日本发出警告：东北亚的战略环境正在发生变化。王沪宁并非普通的中国官员。他在中国共产党的权力体系中排名第四，担任中国人民政治协商会议主席。王沪宁曾任复旦大学教授，是中国最具影响力的政治思想家和战略家之一，先后为江泽民、胡锦涛和习近平三代领导人提供顾问Few Chinese officials have enjoyed such sustained influence across three administrations. 王沪宁帮助塑造了现代中国治理的思想基础。他参与金正恩此次访问，包括转达中国国家主席习近平的 personal 问候，凸显北京对与朝鲜关系所赋予的政治意义。同样重要的是，金正恩跨越了新安鸭河大桥。这座连接中国边境城市丹东与朝鲜新义州的大桥 recently opened，于2014年完工，此后约12年一直未获使用，直至今年10月才正式通车。大桥的四条车道和现代化基础设施为交通、贸易及经济合作提供了新机遇。这座桥远不只是钢筋水泥，更是一份政治声明。中国和朝鲜正在表明扩大经济联系的意愿。大桥通车可能便利工业设备、原材料、能源产品以及朝鲜经济所需其他货物的运输。这引出了一个令人不安的问题：针对朝鲜的国际制裁制度还剩下什么？联合国制裁并未正式终止。然而，制裁只有在主要国家予以执行时才有效。如果中国扩大经济合作，同时俄罗斯继续与平壤保持军事关系，国际施压的实际效果就可能严重削弱。国际社会必须区分纸面存在的制裁与真正影响朝鲜行为的制裁。这一发展还有另一个层面：朝鲜正在加强同中国和俄罗斯的关系，但这两层关系并不相同。中国为朝鲜提供主要经济生命线，俄罗斯则日益成为重要的军事伙伴。这两层关系结合起来，可能赋予平壤更大的战略灵活性，并降低其在核武问题上认真谈判的意愿。这对美国及其盟友而言是一项严重发展。然而，挑战并非仅限于军事层面。经济依赖已成为战略脆弱性，韩国提供了一个鲜明例证。中国仍是韩国企业巨大的市场，也是工业材料、零部件和关键矿产的重要供应国。韩国无法在不承受显著产业和经济后果的情况下simple abandon这种经济关系。与此同时，韩国依赖外国供应商提供包括核燃料在内的重要能源资源。俄罗斯一直是韩国民用核工业所用浓缩铀的重要供应国。这些依赖关系可能在国际对抗时期造成潜在脆弱性。美国经常敦促盟友降低对中国和俄罗斯的战略依赖。这个目标可以理解。但华盛顿必须认识到，经济独立无法仅凭政治宣言实现。如果美国希望其盟友摆脱可能不可靠的供应商，就必须帮助提供切实可行的替代方案。这意味着扩大关键矿产、先进制造、能源安全和核燃料供应等方面的合作，也意味着加强投资、培育可靠供应链，并接受经济安全需要长期投入。美国不能一面要求其盟友承担重大经济风险，一面又不帮助它们应对后果。同样重要的是韩国与日本之间的关系。两国都是民主国家，经济发达，且与美国结有紧密同盟。它们面临许多相同的安全挑战，尤其是朝鲜的核武器和导弹能力。然而，历史分歧持续侵蚀政治互信。日本必须认识到，朝鲜半岛民众的历史敏感问题真实存在，不能简单斥为过时的民族主义。日本对朝鲜的殖民统治仍是朝鲜历史记忆的重要组成部分。日本政治领袖的象征性举动具有影响。首相高市早苗向靖国神社供奉的物品制造了不必要的紧张。靖国神社除供奉日本战死者外，还供奉着被判决犯有甲级战争罪的人。日本完全有权纪念那些为其效力而阵亡的人，但其领导人应找到既能悼念本国死者，又不重新撕开邻国历史伤疤的办法。在地区安全合作变得愈发重要之际，此类举动尤其无益。韩国同样负有责任。韩国人必须认识到，正当的历史诉求不能成为必要安全合作的永久障碍。地理条件、经济相互依存和共同安全利益使同日本合作成为不可或缺的选择。两国都不需要忘记历史，但都必须明白，保护未来需要从今天的务实合作开始。合作应包括情报共享、导弹防御协调、海上安全、供应链韧性和政治及军事领导人之间更密切的沟通。美国在促成这一切方面负有特别重要的责任。东北亚亟需美国发挥领导作用，但领导不仅仅意味着维持军事力量或要求盟友增加国防开支。它需要持续的外交接触、可信的安全承诺，以及帮助盟友克服政治和经济障碍的意愿。华盛顿必须明白，分别强化美韩同盟和美日同盟还不够，还必须推动首尔与东京建立持久关系。这三国不必在每个政治问题上意见一致，但必须认识到它们的安全利益紧密相连。中国和朝鲜正在加强双边关系，俄罗斯继续深化与平壤的合作。这些发展未必意味着北京、莫斯科和平壤已经组成统一军事联盟。三方利益存在差异，这些差异不应被忽视。尽管如此，它们日益扩大的合作带来了值得严肃关注的挑战。因此，金正恩访问丹东应当被理解为一场超出双边外交活动范畴的事件。它提醒人们，经济关系、军事合作与政治象征正日益交织。美国、韩国和日本必须以更强的战略协调作出回应，不能自满，也不能进行不必要的对抗。军事威慑仍不可或缺，但仅有威慑，而没有经济韧性、政治互信和持续的美国领导，将不足以维护东北亚稳定。Chun In-bum曾任大韩民国陆军特殊 warfare 司令部司令官

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.summary: Global credit rating agencies have assigned ratings in line with Korea's sovereign ratings to the state-run company tasked with implementing Seoul's $350 billion investment pledge to the United States, the firm said Monday. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.summary_zh: 该公司周一表示，全球信用评级机构给予负责落实韩国向美国3500亿美元投资承诺的国有公司与其韩国主权信用评级一致的评级。韩国与美国战略投资公司（KUIC）称，Moody's Ratings给予其Aa2发行人评级，评级展望稳定；S&P Global Ratings则给予其AA长期信用评级。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.body: Global credit rating agencies have assigned ratings in line with Korea's sovereign ratings to the state-run company tasked with implementing Seoul's $350 billion investment pledge to the United States, the firm said Monday. The Korea-U.S. Strategic Investment Corporation (KUIC) said Moody's Ratings assigned it an Aa2 issuer rating with a stable outlook, while S&P Global Ratings assigned it long-term credit ratings of AA. These were the company's first credit ratings since its launch earlier this year. "KUIC's rating is driven by the Government of Korea's very high willingness and ability to provide timely support, given the strong credit linkages between KUIC and the Government of Korea," Moody's Ratings said in a release. "The government's strong ability to support KUIC is underpinned by the sovereign's ample financial reserves and strong creditworthiness, as reflected in its Aa2 rating," it added. "This is based on the institution's critical policy role for, and integral link with, the Korean government. We therefore equalize our ratings on KUIC with the sovereign rating on Korea," S&P added. KUIC said the latest ratings would help bolster its credibility in international financial markets and pave the way for stable funding. The company officially launched in June after the National Assembly passed the Special Act for Korea-U.S. Strategic Investment Management in March. In October last year, Seoul and Washington reached an agreement on Korea's $350 billion investment pledge made in return for lower U.S. tariffs. The investment will comprise $150 billion for shipbuilding cooperation and $200 billion for projects in various strategic sectors
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.title_zh: 韩美投资机构获评信用评级，展望稳定
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.body_zh: 全球信用评级机构已按照韩国主权信用评级，为负责落实首尔向美国作出的3,500亿美元投资承诺的国有公司授予评级。该公司周一表示，Moody's Ratings给予其Aa2发行人评级，展望稳定；S&P Global Ratings则给予其AA长期信用评级。这是该公司今年早些时候启动以来首次获得信用评级。Moody's Ratings在一份声明中说：“鉴于KUIC与韩国政府之间存在密切的信用联系，韩国政府有非常高的意愿和能力及时提供支持，这推动了KUIC的评级。”该声明补充道：“韩国政府支持KUIC的强大能力以该国充足的金融储备和良好的信用状况为基础，而其Aa2评级也反映了这一点。”S&P补充说：“这一评级依据该机构对韩国政府所具有的关键政策作用以及与韩国政府的紧密联系。因此，我们对KUIC的评级与韩国主权评级保持一致。”KUIC表示，最新评级将有助于提升其在国际金融市场的信誉，并为稳定的融资铺平道路。今年3月，国会通过《韩美战略投资管理特别法》后，该公司于6月正式成立。去年10月，首尔和华盛顿就韩国为换取美国降低关税而作出的3,500亿美元投资承诺达成协议。这笔投资将包括1,500亿美元用于造船合作，以及2,000亿美元用于各战略领域的项目

https://www.myjoyonline.com/jerry-ahmed-.body: The Member of Parliament for Weija-Gbawe, Jerry Ahmed Shaib, has urged the Ministry of Transport to extend Metro Mass Transit buses to his constituency to help address persistent transport challenges. He welcomed the introduction of contraflow on the Kasoa-Accra road as a potential measure to ease congestion but cautioned that road safety must be the priority. “My expectation is that we should do it in a manner that would not end up actually causing accidents,” he said in an interview on Channel One Newsroom on Sunday, October 26. Mr Shaib said commuters in Weija-Gbawe and surrounding communities, including Tetegu, face high transport costs and often have to board multiple vehicles to reach their destinations. He appealed to the Transport Minister to provide at least four to six Metro Mass Transit buses to serve the area. “I’m praying that the Minister of Transport would also hear our cry and also furnish us with at least four or six Metro buses so that they can ply both Weija and Gbawe, Tetegu, all of these places,” he said. According to the MP, some commuters who normally spend between GH¢15 and GH¢20 on a journey now pay as much as GH¢60 to GH¢70 because of the transport difficulties. He said additional buses would help reduce fares and ease the daily burden on residents

https://www.myjoyonline.com/roads-minist.body: The Ministry of Roads and Highways has won the Public Sector PR Organisation of the Year award for the second consecutive time at the Institute of Public Relations (IPR) Ghana Excellence Awards. The award recognises the Ministry’s efforts to improve public communication, stakeholder engagement and access to information on road infrastructure development. The IPR Ghana citation said the Ministry had distinguished itself through timely dissemination of information on road projects and the use of innovative communication tools to engage the public. This year’s awards ceremony, held in Koforidua in the Eastern Region, recognised public institutions that demonstrated leadership in communication and applied public relations best practices to promote public trust. The Institute commended the Ministry’s Public Relations Unit, led by Alhaji Nasir Ahmad Yartey, a public relations practitioner and development communication professional with more than 17 years of experience in Ghana’s public sector, for its strategic and professional work. It said the Unit had strengthened proactive media engagement, community outreach programmes and relationships with key stakeholders to keep the public informed about road infrastructure projects across the country. The Ministry had also introduced digital communication tools to improve access to road development updates, enhanced social media reporting, used visual storytelling to showcase infrastructure progress and strengthened crisis communication systems, it said. In 2022, the Ministry received the Best Social Media PR Unit award at the Government PROs Excellence Awards, while Mr Yartey was named second runner-up in the PRO of the Year category. The Ministry reaffirmed its commitment to sustaining communication reforms, deepening citizen engagement, and supporting the delivery of safe, resilient, and modern road infrastructure. The IPR Ghana Excellence Awards are a major event that recognises individuals and institutions for outstanding performance, accountability, and innovation in public relations practice and professional communication
https://www.myjoyonline.com/roads-minist.title_zh: 道路部连续第二年荣获年度公共关系组织奖
https://www.myjoyonline.com/roads-minist.body_zh: 道路与公路部在加纳公共关系协会（IPR）卓越奖颁奖典礼上连续第二年获得“年度公共部门公关组织”奖，以表彰该部在改善公共沟通、利益相关方参与以及公众获取道路基础设施开发信息方面所做的努力。IPR Ghana的颁奖词称，该部通过及时发布道路项目信息，并运用创新传播工具与公众互动，在工作中脱颖而出。今年的颁奖典礼于东部 region's 科福里dua举行，表彰了在沟通方面发挥领导作用并运用公共关系最佳实践来增进公众信任的公共机构。公共关系协会对该部公共关系处的工作予以肯定。该处由Alhaji Nasir Ahmad Yartey领导，他是一名公共关系从业者和开发传播专业人士，在加纳公共部门拥有17年以上经验。协会称，该处加强了主动媒体沟通、社区外展项目以及与关键利益相关方的关系，以持续向公众通报全国道路基础设施项目的情况。协会还表示，该部引入了数字传播工具，改善了公众获取道路开发进展信息的方式；加强了社交媒体报告；利用视觉叙事展示基础设施进展；并强化了危机沟通系统。2022年，该部在政府PROs卓越奖评选中获得“最佳社交媒体公关处”奖，Yartey先生则获得“年度PRO”类别亚军。该部重申，将继续推动传播改革，深化公民参与，并支持建设安全、有韧性和现代化的道路基础设施。IPR Ghana卓越奖是表彰在公共关系实践和专业传播方面取得杰出表现、体现问责和创新精神的个人与机构的重要活动……

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/head.title: 920249 editorial why the us midterm elections matter
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/head.summary: On Tuesday, 3 November, Americans will vote in what is known as the midterm elections. https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/head.body: On Tuesday, 3 November, Americans will vote in what is known as the midterm elections. In addition to a slew of elections at the municipal levels and a broad range of citizen and legislatively referred initiatives, voters will have their say on all 435 seats in the United States House of Representatives, 35 of the 100 seats in the United States Senate (including two special elections) and for 36 state governors, amongst others. Yet, the one name that is not on the ballot, that of the US president, looms large over this cycle. Historically, midterm elections have been difficult for the president’s party. Indeed, over the last 22 US midterm elections, from 1934 to 2022, the president’s party gained seats in the House of Representatives in only three elections. It lost House seats in the other nineteen. The polls, as of 16 October, give Democrats a 90 per cent chance of winning the House and a 63 per cent chance of controlling the Senate. These predictions are par for the course. The problem is that up until these elections, the Donald Trump presidency has opted to alter courses in unpredictable, if not outrightly illegal ways. Ignore his failed insurrection on 6 January, 2021, and from inciting gerrymanders in Republican-controlled states, to trying to insert the US Postal Services into election processes that are constitutionally state bailiwicks, the Trump administration has been a force for chaos. Its economics, especially the president’s obsession with tariffs, have hurt Americans while strengthening China. His love of tyrant-leaders has seen him cozy up to dictators in North Korea and Russia. In taking up the dictatorship in Iran, in a war whose goals remain as clear as the president’s thinking, he unintentionally handed leverage on the global economy to one of its pariah states, and helped include Israel in a listing of infamous regimes worldwide. To think that all of these were aimed at Making America Great Again (MAGA). While accounting for about 26 per cent of the global economy just before the beginning of the second Trump presidency, America was never a tiddler. Yet, the MAGA quest for further US greatness has seen the US gut much of the infrastructure that has held the global system together during the interwar years. PREMIUM TIMES recognises that from the United Nations through to the many agencies that have been critical to maintaining world peace over the years, the world needs to think differently about how it will be organised over the next one hundred years. The challenges are as onerous as they have always been. The AI revolution and the growing belief in the might-is-right view of international relations only complicate this task further. This newspaper is also aware that much of the thinking for the redesign of the global architecture has already been done by the agencies entrusted with this responsibility. The missing ingredient is the whimsical bent of the leaders of the world’s leading countries. These whimsies, alas, have been lent wings by the capricious Trump administration over the last two years. Will the next Congress keep or lose its ability to check Trump’s policies? In Africa, as the concerns over the administration’s evisceration of the World Health Organisation (WHO) indicates, this is already a major policy conundrum. As if muzzling the WHO were not enough, the Trump administration’s use of aid as a political lever, continues to put Africa in deficit. One can admit that aid is a sovereign US choice, while objecting to its being used to humiliate and punish. The incumbent US federal government tied its decision to end the President’s Emergency Plan for AIDS Relief (PEPFAR) support for South Africa to an executive order accusing the country of discriminating against white Afrikaners. Congress has been the backstop before. A similar effort by the administration to claw back unspent PEPFAR funds as part of a wider cut to foreign aid, was stymied by Republican defections in Congress. A renewal of the Trump majority would weaken this backstop. Opposition from the White House and conservative Republicans created an additional vulnerability for the continent when Speaker Mike Johnson was forced to cut the House’s initial renewal of the African Growth and Opportunity Act (AGOA) from three to one year. The US trade preference programme enacted in 2000, which provides duty‑free access to the US market for over 1,800 products from eligible sub‑Saharan African countries, has been kept alive until 31 December, after Trump signed a law extending AGOA by one year. This means the next Congress would decide the programme’s future almost immediately. A Republican Congress aligned with the White House is more likely to turn AGOA, whose effectiveness is already weakened by the administration’s rash of tariffs, into a “reciprocity” bargaining chip. South Africa, for example, may have kept its AGOA eligibility, but the 30 per cent “reciprocal” tariffs imposed in 2025 largely cancel its benefits. There are, no doubt, few benefits to the continent from America’s collective ban on mobility. Thirty-six of Africa’s 54 countries now face either US travel bans or visa bonds. This disproportionately hurts students, professionals, diaspora ties, and remittances. While these measures are outcomes of executive orders issued by the White House, congressional oversight and appropriations shape how far they can go. The outcome of the midterm elections will also bear on where deportees go. An AFP investigation found that Washington used the threats of tariffs, visa suspensions, or aid cuts to compel African countries into accepting deportees. Burundi recently became the 15th African nation to agree to this arrangement. The harm here is not only to migrants. As one analysis puts it, these secret deals set precedents that erode the rule of law and transparency that African democracies so sorely need. Congressional scrutiny is one of the few ways these terms become public. A Congress that holds hearings and demands evidence is a check on policy driven by information disorder. A compliant one is not. This matters most when much of the measures taken by the US administration against South Africa draw on “genocide” framings that the two governments reject and that many analysts consider distorted. Because war powers are essentially congressional powers, the US Congress’ willingness to question an expansive reading of a 2001 counterterrorism law will offer African states far more protection from the Trump administration’s penchant for unilateral action. For Nigeria, this is the sharpest issue. Strikes in northwest Nigeria in December were the first US military strikes ever in the country, authorised under the 2001 Authorisation for Use of Military Force Act. Built, as it is, on bogus and false narratives, the Trump administration has been an ill-wind that has served the world poorly over the last 24 months. This is why, PREMIUM TIMES looks forward to a return of a Democratic majority in the US House of Representatives, and hopefully, in the Senate, too

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/head.body_zh: 11月3日星期二，美国将举行所谓的期中选举。除了一系列市政层级选举以及广泛的公民提案和立法机构转交提案外，选民还将决定美国众议院全部435个席位、美国参议院100个席位中的35席（包括两场特别选举），以及36个州州长等职位。然而，在这一选举周期中，唯一没有出现在选票上的名字——美国总统——却投下了巨大的阴影。历史上，期中选举对总统所属政党而言往往十分艰难。事实上，在美国过去22次期中选举中，从1934年至2022年，总统所属政党仅在3次选举中增加了众议院席位，其余19次均失去席位。截至10月16日的民意调查，民主党赢得众议院控制权的概率为90%，控制参议院的概率为63%。这些预测并不令人意外。问题在于，在此次选举之前，唐纳德·特朗普总统选择了以难以预测、甚至公然违法的方式改变政策路线。先不提他在2021年1月6日失败的叛乱，从煽动共和党控制的州实施选区重划，到试图将美国邮政署纳入宪法上属于各州管辖的选举程序，特朗普政府始终是一股制造混乱的力量。其经济政策，尤其是总统对关税的痴迷，伤害了美国人，却壮大了中国。他对暴君领袖的喜爱，使他与朝鲜和俄罗斯的独裁者沆瀣一气。在对伊朗采取独裁压制并发动一场目标与总统思维一样含混不清的战争时，他无意中将全球经济中的谈判筹码拱手交给了全球最受孤立的国家之一，还帮助把以色列列入全球声名狼藉政权的名单。难以想象，这一切竟然是为了实现“让美国再次伟大”（MAGA）。在特朗普第二任期开始前夕，美国约占全球经济的26%，从来都不是一个无足轻重的国家。然而，“让美国再次伟大”的追求，已使美国掏空了战间期维系全球体系的大量基础设施。PREMIUM TIMES认识到，从联合国到多年来对维护世界和平至关重要的众多机构，世界都需要重新思考未来一百年应如何组织自身。挑战一如既往地艰巨。人工智能革命，以及越来越多人相信国际关系中强权即真理的观点，只会使这项任务更加复杂。本报也知道，重新设计全球架构的许多思路，实际上已经由受托承担这一责任的机构完成。缺少的要素，是世界主要国家领导人异想天开的奇思妙想。可惜的是，过去两年，特朗普政府任性妄为，为这些奇思妙想助长了翅膀。下一届国会会保留还是失去制约特朗普政策的能力？在非洲， administration's 对世界卫生组织（WHO）的削弱所引发的担忧表明，这已经是一个重大的政策难题。仿佛让世卫组织噤声还不够，特朗普政府把援助当作政治杠杆，继续令非洲陷入亏空。人们可以承认援助是美国的主权选择，同时反对将援助用于羞辱和惩罚。美国现任联邦政府把终止“总统艾滋病紧急救援计划”（PEPFAR）对南非支持的决定，与一道指控南非歧视白人南非荷兰人的行政命令挂钩。国会在过去一直是最后的保障。特朗普政府也曾试图追回尚未使用的PEPFAR资金，并将其纳入更广泛的对外援助削减计划，但因共和党议员在国会中倒戈而受阻。特朗普阵营若重新取得多数席位，这一保障将被削弱。白宫和共和党保守派的反对，也令非洲大陆面临更多风险；众议院议长迈克·约翰逊被迫将众议院最初提出的《非洲增长与机会法案》（AGOA）续期从三年缩短至一年。这项于2000年颁布的美国贸易优惠计划，为符合条件的撒哈拉以南非洲国家超过1,800种产品提供免关税进入美国市场的待遇；在特朗普签署将AGOA延长一年的法律后，该计划被保留至12月31日。这意味着，下一届国会几乎会立即决定该计划的未来。与白宫立场一致的共和党国会，更有可能把AGOA变成“互惠”谈判的筹码；其成效已经因政府接连推出关税而受到削弱。例如，南非或许仍保有AGOA资格，但2025年加征的30%“对等”关税在很大程度上抵消了它享有的好处。毫无疑问，美国全面限制人员流动给非洲大陆带来的好处寥寥无几。非洲54个国家中，如今已有36个面临美国旅行禁令或签证保证金要求。这对留学生、专业人士、侨民联系以及汇款造成了不成比例的伤害。尽管这些措施是白宫行政命令的结果，国会的监督和拨款决定着它们能够实施到什么程度。期中选举的结果还将影响被驱逐者的去向。法新社的一项调查发现，华盛顿利用关税威胁、暂停签证或削减援助等手段，迫使非洲国家接收被驱逐者。布隆迪最近成为第15个同意这一安排的非洲国家。这里的伤害不只涉及移民。正如一份分析所指出的，这些秘密协议树立了破坏法治和透明度的先例，而非洲民主制度恰恰迫切需要法治和透明度。国会审查是这些条件得以公开的少数途径之一。举行听证会并要求提供证据的国会，可以制约由信息混乱驱动的政策；唯唯诺诺的国会则不能。当美国政府针对南非采取的大量措施都援引两国均不接受的“种族灭绝”叙事，而许多分析人士认为这些叙事扭曲事实时，国会监督就尤为重要。由于战争权本质上属于国会权力，美国国会是否愿意质疑对2001年反恐法律的扩张性解读，将为非洲各国提供远多于以往的保护，使其免受特朗普政府单方面行动偏好的侵扰。对尼日利亚而言，这是最为尖锐的问题。12月，尼日利亚西北部遭到袭击，这是美国首次在该国实施军事打击；此次行动依据2001年《军事力量使用授权法案》获得批准。特朗普政府建立在虚假和捏造的叙事之上，过去24个月里始终是一股令世界深受其害的逆风。正因如此，PREMIUM TIMES期待美国众议院重新由民主党占据多数，并希望参议院也能如此

https://moderndiplomacy.eu/2026/10/26/ho.summary_zh: 缅甸军方关联的能源网络使用虚假贸易文件和误导性航运记录，将伊朗航空燃料伪装成南非柴油，掩盖了价值数百万美元的交易。尽管美国实施旨在切断缅甸军方航空燃料供应的制裁，这套做法仍使燃料继续运入缅甸。2025年12月，油轮Reef号运载约113,000桶伊朗航空燃料抵达缅甸，相关文件将货物描述为南非柴油。
https://moderndiplomacy.eu/2026/10/26/ho.body: Myanmar’s military-linked energy network disguised Iranian jet fuel shipments as South African diesel, using false trade documents and misleading shipping records to conceal transactions worth millions of dollars. The scheme allowed fuel to continue reaching Myanmar despite US sanctions targeting its military’s aviation fuel supply. In December 2025, the tanker Reef , carrying approximately 113,000 barrels of Iranian jet fuel, arrived in Myanmar under paperwork describing the cargo as South African diesel. A $15.8 million sales contract between Myanmar-based energy broker Dynamic Wave and Thailand’s Tawan-Oil Trading presented the transaction as a legitimate diesel purchase, despite no recorded South African diesel trade with Myanmar in 2025, according to the United Nations and shipping data provider Vortexa. Myanmar’s foreign exchange regulator also appeared to facilitate the arrangement. In a November 30 letter, the regulator reportedly authorized import documents that would label the shipment as diesel rather than jet fuel. The letter also approved payments from Dynamic Wave and its client, National Energy Prime Aviation Services Company, to Tawan. Satellite imagery and shipping analysis by SynMax Intelligence traced the tanker’s journey from Iran’s Bandar Abbas port to Southeast Asia, supporting the conclusion that the cargo originated in Iran. MD Briefing delivers expert analysis across five global fronts — the Indo-Pacific, energy, geoeconomics, European security, and the Middle East — every Monday morning. Free. The United States imposed targeted sanctions on Myanmar’s jet fuel industry in 2023 in response to the military’s air attacks on civilian targets during the country’s ongoing conflict. Purchases of Iranian oil and fuel also expose buyers to US sanctions. Since seizing power in 2021, Myanmar’s military has fought armed resistance groups in a conflict marked by widespread violence and deadly aerial attacks. The United Nations reported in August that military air assaults had killed thousands of people, including civilians. Iran became Myanmar’s primary jet fuel supplier between October 2024 and December 2025, with shipments carried partly by the tankers Reef and Noble . The continued flow of fuel provides Myanmar with supplies for commercial aviation and military air operations, while generating foreign currency for Tehran. The December delivery was not an isolated incident. In May 2025, Dynamic Wave agreed to purchase approximately 202,000 barrels of purported South African diesel from Tawan under a $26 million contract. However, the fuel specifications in the invoice reportedly matched jet fuel rather than diesel, according to jet fuel expert Joshua Heyne of Washington State University and data from Platts. The stated price was also more than 50% above a global diesel benchmark. Shipping records showed that the tanker Noble arrived in Yangon in June carrying just under 200,000 barrels of jet fuel intended for Dynamic Wave. According to SynMax’s satellite analysis, the vessel loaded its cargo at Bandar Abbas and transmitted location signals that made it appear to be heading towards Chittagong, Bangladesh. These transactions suggest that the network relied on multiple methods to obscure the fuel’s origin and destination, including misleading contracts, mislabelled import documents and deceptive shipping signals. The contracts directed payments to Tawan’s account at Siam Commercial Bank (SCB), Thailand’s oldest bank. A 2024 report by United Nations experts had identified Tawan as a jet fuel supplier to Myanmar’s military and described SCB as a major facilitator of military procurement. SCB previously stated that it complied with anti-money-laundering laws and that its Myanmar-related transactions were legitimate and unrelated to the arms trade. Reuters could not establish whether the bank knew the nature of Tawan’s business. Thai regulators had ordered banks in 2024 to scrutinize Myanmar-related transactions more closely to comply with sanctions and anti-money-laundering requirements. SCB, Tawan and the Bank of Thailand did not respond to Reuters’ latest requests for comment. The case highlights both the reach and limitations of US economic sanctions. The apparent need to disguise Iranian jet fuel as diesel suggests that sanctions have raised the risks associated with these transactions. Yet the continued arrival of Iranian fuel indicates that restrictions have not fully stopped the trade. The transactions also raise questions about the role of intermediaries, import documentation and financial institutions in enforcing sanctions across borders. Even when a government restricts direct purchases, opaque commercial arrangements and misleading shipping records can make it difficult to identify the origin and end use of sensitive goods. Myanmar’s military-linked companies and Iranian suppliers have continued to operate despite these restrictions. Reuters reported in October that Iranian jet fuel shipments to Myanmar were still taking place in 2026. The case therefore illustrates a central challenge for sanctions enforcement: restricting access to strategic supplies requires not only targeting suppliers and buyers but also detecting the commercial and financial mechanisms used to conceal transactions. https://moderndiplomacy.eu/2026/10/26/ho.body_zh: 缅甸军方关联的能源网络把伊朗航空煤油伪装成南非柴油，使用虚假贸易文件和误导性航运记录，掩盖价值数百万美元的交易。尽管美国实施针对缅甸军方航空燃油供应的制裁，这套网络仍让燃油持续运入缅甸。2025年12月，油轮Reef载有约113,000桶伊朗航空煤油抵达缅甸，相关文件却将货物描述为南非柴油。据联合国和航运数据提供商Vortexa提供的信息，总部位于缅甸的能源经纪商Dynamic Wave与泰国的Tawan-Oil Trading签订了一份价值1,580万美元的销售合同，将这笔交易包装成正常的柴油采购，尽管2025年并无任何南非柴油与缅甸之间的贸易记录。缅甸外汇监管机构似乎也为这一安排提供了便利。据报道，该监管机构在11月30日的一封信中批准了进口文件授权，将这批货物标为柴油而非航空煤油。这封信还批准了Dynamic Wave及其客户National Energy Prime Aviation Services Company向Tawan付款。SynMax Intelligence的卫星图像和航运分析追踪了这艘油轮从伊朗阿巴斯港前往东南亚的航程，支持货物源自伊朗的结论。MD Briefing每周一上午提供印太、能源、地缘经济、欧洲安全和中东五大全球领域的专家分析。免费。2023年，美国针对缅甸航空煤油行业实施定向制裁，以回应军方在该国持续冲突期间对民用目标发动的空袭。购买伊朗石油和燃油也会使买方面临美国制裁。自2021年夺取政权以来，缅甸军方一直与武装抵抗组织交战，冲突伴随大范围暴力和致命空袭。联合国8月报告称，军方空袭造成数千人死亡，包括平民。2024年10月至2025年12月，伊朗成为缅甸的主要航空煤油供应国，部分货物由Reef和Noble油轮运输。燃油持续流入，为缅甸的商业航空和军事空中行动提供补给，同时为德黑兰创造外汇收入。12月的交付并非孤立事件。2025年5月，Dynamic Wave同意根据一份价值2,600万美元的合同，从Tawan购买约202,000桶所谓的南非柴油。然而，据华盛顿州立大学航空煤油专家Joshua Heyne和Platts的数据，发票所列燃油规格实际上与航空煤油相符，而非柴油。发票标示的价格也比全球柴油基准价格高出50%以上。航运记录显示，油轮Noble于6月抵达仰光，载有略少于200,000桶、拟交付Dynamic Wave的航空煤油。根据SynMax的卫星分析，该船在阿巴斯港装载货物，并发送位置信号，伪装成驶往孟加拉国吉大港。这些交易表明，该网络采用了多种手段掩盖燃油的来源和目的地，包括误导性合同、错标进口文件以及欺骗性航运信号。合同将付款导向Tawan在泰国历史最悠久的银行Siam Commercial Bank（SCB）的账户。联合国专家2024年的一份报告将Tawan认定为缅甸军方的航空煤油供应商，并称SCB是军方采购的重要协助方。SCB此前表示，其遵守反洗钱法律，与缅甸有关的交易合法且与军火贸易无关。路透社无法确定该银行是否知道Tawan业务的实际性质。2024年，泰国监管机构曾命令银行加强审查与缅甸有关的交易，以遵守制裁和反洗钱要求。SCB、Tawan和泰国央行均未回应路透社最新的置评请求。此案凸显了美国经济制裁的覆盖范围及其局限。把伊朗航空煤油伪装成柴油的明显需求表明，制裁提高了这些交易的风险。然而，伊朗燃油仍持续运抵缅甸，说明限制措施尚未完全切断贸易。这些交易也引出了有关中介机构、进口文件和金融机构如何在跨境执行制裁的问题。即使政府限制直接采购，不透明的商业安排和误导性航运记录仍可能使人难以识别敏感货物的来源和最终用途。尽管受到这些限制，缅甸军方关联公司和伊朗供应商仍在继续运营。路透社10月报道称，2026年仍有伊朗航空煤油运往缅甸。因此，此案说明了制裁执行面临的一项核心挑战：要限制战略物资的获取，不仅要针对供应商和买方，还要识别用来掩盖交易的商业和金融机制。MD不支持任何特定议程、叙事或思想流派。我们旨在让所有观点、思想和论点接受审视，并检验其中哪些仍然有效且站得住脚

https://www.thehindu.com/opinion/op-ed/u.body: Account subscription benefits alongside Premium Stories, Editorials, Opinions and more. Unlock these with Subscription In its second term, the Donald Trump administration has been active in restricting legal immigration to the United States. The administration’s attempt to impose a $100,000 payment requirement on certain new H-1B petitions, changes to visa renewal procedures, the introduction of a wage-weighted selection system, and the latest suspensions of the Program Electronic Review Management (PERM) process are cases in point, disproportionately impacting Indian immigrants and firms. It is tempting to read these developments as a product of the Trump administration alone, but they reflect deeper political interests that are likely to survive post-Trump. Indian nationals account for 70% of H-1B visa approvals, with one-fifth of the visas going to employees of Indian-origin companies. This means that, as the bipartisan focus on immigration reform continues, the issue is likely to sustain as a friction point in India-U.S. relations. Democrats are expected to dominate the upcoming midterm elections in November. They view immigration through a rights-based lens, and their voters remain supportive of both legal immigration and increased legalisation of undocumented immigrants. Some 75% of Democrats see skilled immigration as good for the U.S., compared with 54% of Republicans. Even under the current administration, Democrats have pushed for easing F-1 student visa requirements and have traditionally enjoyed the support of diaspora communities in the U.S., including the Indian diaspora. Immigrants seeking U.S. citizenship targeted in Trump administration's illegal voting crackdown U.S. proposes new rule to scrap 60-day grace period for H-1B workers after job loss However, prominent Democratic Senators such as Dick Durbin and Richard Blumenthal, as well as progressive Independents such as Bernie Sanders, have also pushed for bills seeking H-1B reforms. Democrats view alleged fraud in the H-1B visa system as a serious challenge that needs to be addressed. Similarly, the labour wing of the Democratic Party views the H-1B visa programme as a potential threat to domestic labour protections and workers’ rights. The Democrats’ immigrant voter base, their open opposition to the H-1B visa fee hikes, and resistance to these restrictions from businesses and unions suggest that a Democratic-controlled Congress may soften the harshest executive measures and tone down the rhetoric. However, concerns about visa fraud and worker protections mean that Democrats are likely to keep up the pressure on the outsourcing model and continue pushing for H-1B reforms. While a plurality of Republicans support restrictions on legal immigration, this number has declined considerably since 2025. Among the Republican leadership, there is a visible split between anti-immigration nationalists and pro-immigration business interests. The Trump administration’s hikes in the H-1B visa fee is an example of this conflict. While the administration was openly critical of the programme and aggressively pushed for the fee increase, it subsequently diluted the measure by including exemptions for graduates of U.S. universities and existing visa holders, following pressure from businesses and universities. The debate over wage-weighted entries versus the lottery system for H-1B visas has dominated discussions on immigration within the U.S. business community. There are three broad categories in this debate. The first is the random lottery system that was in place until 2026, which benefited outsourcing firms and start-ups. The second is the wage-weighted lottery system (February 2026), which infers wage levels based on experience, job role and location, dividing visa quotas into four categories. On the surface, this system might benefit big-tech firms, but it could also benefit outsourcing firms that hire highly experienced workers for lower wages. The third is the actual wage weighted lottery model, which is supported by U.S.-based industries. This approach could dilute the advantages enjoyed by outsourcing firms while benefiting American hires and also F1 student hires. If India plays its cards right, suspension of PERM may be an opportunity: Priyank Kharge Trump’s move to suspend PERM programme for Indian IT majors raises talent-retention concerns MEA says U.S. green card suspension measures do not advance shared India-U.S. ambitions For the artificial intelligence (AI) and big-tech business community, this reform could be beneficial in two ways. First, AI graduate programmes and advanced research roles in the U.S. rely heavily on international talent, with demand for AI skills growing faster than the supply of domestic graduates. The reform could therefore help AI firms secure top international talent for higher wages. Second, the AI sector is expanding into market segments traditionally occupied by start-ups and outsourcing companies, which often perform low technology maintenance and communication roles. The AI sector could therefore benefit if these start-ups and outsourcing firms were compelled to hire fewer workers. With the AI sector playing a prominent role in campaign contributions for the 2026 midterm elections, these policies to counter outsourcing firms are likely to continue. With over 54% of India’s software services exports going to the U.S., which remains the top market for Indian information technology (IT) outsourcing, this represents a major challenge for India. However, these developments could also be viewed as positive news for Indian students at U.S. universities. The U.S. Department of Labor’s suspension of eight firms, including not only Indian outsourcing companies such as Infosys, Tata Consultancy Services and Wipro but also major technology firms such as Microsoft and Adobe, from green card sponsorship reinforces this trend. It raises the cost of hiring foreign workers for businesses as a whole, creating pressure that remains largely beyond partisan control. With Mr. Trump’s political power potentially diminished after November, anti-immigration rhetoric could decline. However, with both parties committed to immigration reform, India should continue to expect an unfavourable and unpredictable immigration landscape. https://www.thehindu.com/opinion/op-ed/u.title_zh: 美国移民限制措施可能比特朗普任期更长久
https://www.thehindu.com/opinion/op-ed/u.body_zh:
订阅可享受《The Hindu》会员故事、社论、观点等更多内容。订阅即可解锁这些内容。

特朗普政府进入第二个任期以来，积极限制合法移民赴美国。该政府试图对某些新的H-1B申请施加10万美元缴费要求、改变签证续签程序、推出工资加权筛选系统，以及最近暂停项目电子审查管理（PERM）流程，这些都是其典型做法，对印度移民和企业造成了不成比例的影响。人们很容易将这些 developments 解读为特朗普政府单独推出的产物，但它们实际上反映了更深层次的政治利益，而这种利益很可能在特朗普卸任后继续存在。

印度公民占H-1B签证批准人数的70%，其中五分之一的签证发放给了印度裔公司的员工。这意味着，随着两党继续关注移民改革，该问题很可能持续成为印美关系中的摩擦点。预计民主党将在11月即将举行的中期选举中占据优势。他们从权利视角看待移民，其选民仍然支持合法移民以及增加无证移民合法化。约75%的民主党人士认为技术移民有利于美国，而共和党人士的这一比例为54%。即便在现任政府执政期间，民主党也一直主张放宽F-1学生签证要求，并且历来得到美国侨民社群的支持，其中包括印度侨民。

特朗普政府打击非法投票行动所针对的、寻求美国公民身份的移民

美国提议制定新规，取消H-1B工人在失业后的60天宽限期

不过，Dick Durbin和Richard Blumenthal等资深民主党参议员，以及Bernie Sanders等进步派独立人士，也一直在推动旨在改革H-1B的法案。民主党认为，有关H-1B签证系统存在欺诈的指控是一项必须解决的严重挑战。同样，民主党内的劳工派将H-1B签证项目视为对国内劳工保护和工人权利的潜在威胁。

民主党所拥有的移民选民基础、他们对提高H-1B签证费率的公开反对，以及企业和工会对这些限制的抵制，都表明由民主党控制的国会可能会软化最严厉的行政措施，并降低相关言论的强硬程度。

不过，对签证欺诈和劳工保护的担忧意味着，民主党很可能继续向外包模式施压，并继续推动H-1B改革。

虽然多数共和党人士支持限制合法移民，但这一比例自2025年以来已大幅下降。在共和党领导层中，反移民民族主义者与支持移民的商业利益之间出现了明显分化。特朗普政府提高H-1B签证费就是这种冲突的一个例子。该政府公开批评这一项目，并积极推动提高费用，但在企业和大学施加压力后，随后通过为美国大学毕业生和现有签证持有者设置豁免，削弱了该措施的影响。

围绕H-1B签证采用工资加权录取还是抽签制度展开的争论，一直主导着美国商业界的移民讨论。这场争论大致分为三类。第一类是截至2026年一直采用的随机抽签制度，它有利于外包企业和初创公司。第二类是工资加权抽签制度（2026年2月推出），该制度根据工作经验、职位和所在地推定工资水平，将签证配额划分为四个类别。表面上，这套制度可能有利于大型科技公司，但也可能让那些以较低工资聘用经验丰富的员工的外包企业受益。第三类是真正的工资加权抽签模式，得到美国本土行业的支持。这一做法可能削弱外包企业的优势，同时让美国本土招聘和F1学生招聘受益。

如果印度审慎应对，暂停PERM可能是一个机会：Priyank Kharge

特朗普暂停面向印度IT专业人士的PERM项目，引发人才留任担忧

印度外交部表示，美国暂停绿卡措施无助于推进印美共同目标

对于人工智能（AI）和大型科技商业群体而言，这项改革可能带来两方面好处。第一，美国的人工智能研究生项目和高水平研究岗位高度依赖国际人才，而对人工智能技能的需求增长快于本土毕业生供给。因此，这项改革可能帮助人工智能企业以更高薪酬留住顶尖国际人才。第二，人工智能行业正在向传统上由初创公司和外包企业占据的市场领域扩张，而这些企业通常承担低技术维护和沟通工作。因此，如果这些初创公司和外包企业被迫减少招聘，人工智能行业可能从中受益。

鉴于人工智能行业在2026年中期选举的竞选捐款中占据重要地位，这些制衡外包企业的政策很可能会延续下去。印度超过54%的软件服务出口流向美国，而美国仍是印度信息技术（IT）外包的首大市场，因此上述趋势对印度构成重大挑战。

不过，这些 developments 也可以被视为印度学生在美国大学就读的利好消息。美国劳工部暂停八家企业为外籍员工提供绿卡担保，其中包括Infosys、Tata Consultancy Services和Wipro等印度外包企业，也包括Microsoft和Adobe等大型科技企业，这进一步强化了这一趋势。它提高了整个企业群体聘用外国劳工的成本，从而形成一种基本不受党派控制的压力。

如果特朗普先生的政治权力在11月之后可能减弱，反移民言论或许会减少。然而，由于两党都致力于移民改革，印度应继续预期移民环境将处于不利且难以预测的状态。

A video circulating on social media has sparked discussion over border security along the India-China frontier. The footage is being shared with claims that Indian Army personnel confronted Chinese People’s Liberation Army (PLA) soldiers allegedly attempting to cross into Indian territory near Arunachal Pradesh.

According to the claims accompanying the video, the Chinese personnel were intercepted and later released under established border protocols along the Line of Actual Control (LAC).

However, the video’s authenticity, date, location and the circumstances of the alleged confrontation have not been independently verified. No definitive conclusion can be drawn from the circulating footage alone.

India and China have experienced border tensions in the past, making incidents along the LAC a matter of significant public interest. The latest claims require confirmation from official sources before the video can be treated as evidence of an actual border confrontation.

Algeria's Core Motivation is that Algiers is acting purely out of national interest. https://x.com/dana916/status/21147516680.snippet:
🇻🇳A Canal of Discord
Vietnam Assesses New Risks

A major infrastructure project has the potential to alter not only trade routes but also relations with neighboring states - especially when the economic calculations appear to mask the geopolitical interests of a third party.

In Cambodia, construction of the Funan Techo Canal is gradually moving forward. This new 180-kilometer-long shipping route will provide a direct link between the capital, Phnom Penh, and the Gulf of Thailand, bypassing the Mekong River Delta.

The project is estimated to cost approximately $1.2 billion. The primary contractor is the Chinese firm China Road and Bridge Corporation (CRBC), while the main lender is the Export-Import Bank of China.

The primary objective is to reduce the dependence of Cambodia’s foreign trade on Vietnam’s transport infrastructure. Currently, the majority of cargo moving along river routes toward the Cambodian capital passes through Vietnamese territory and ports.

While Hanoi does not officially oppose Cambodia’s right to develop the project, it insists on a joint assessment of its transboundary impacts. For Vietnam, this is a matter involving national security, economic development, and a shift in the strategic landscape.

A Potential Threat to National Interests

▪️Vietnam is particularly concerned about disruptions to the hydrological regime downstream of the Mekong and Bassac rivers. This is precisely why Hanoi is pushing for an exchange of technical data and a collaborative evaluation of the project’s consequences.

▪️For Vietnam, the emergence of this new Cambodian route implies a reduction in transit flows and cargo turnover at its ports. Furthermore, it weakens one of the key mechanisms of economic interdependence between the two nations. 

▪️Strategically, the canal will strengthen Cambodia’s ties with China, further increasing the significance of the "Chinese factor" in the regional balance. Vietnam is compelled to take these shifts along its southwestern borders into account - especially given the unresolved disputes to its east, in the South China Sea.

Formally, Cambodia has presented the shipping route as its own independent initiative. In practice, however, its implementation is gradually becoming integrated into a broader framework of Sino-Cambodian cooperation, aligned with Beijing’s "Belt and Road Initiative."

It is precisely this Chinese involvement that gives the canal a geopolitical dimension. For Beijing, it represents an opportunity to expand its footprint within the infrastructure of mainland Southeast Asia, complementing the high-speed railway network already operating in Laos and currently under construction in Thailand.

❗️Ultimately, the project’s primary impact will not merely be the success with which cargo is transported along the canal to Phnom Penh; equally significant will be how it influences the distribution of economic and political influence across the region.

https://x.com/dana916/status/21147516680.snippet_zh:
🇻🇳纷争之渠
越南评估新风险

一项大型基础设施项目不仅可能改变贸易路线，还可能影响越南与邻国的关系，尤其是在经济考量似乎掩盖了第三方地缘政治利益的情况下。

在柬埔寨，扶南—德昭运河的建设正在逐步推进。这条全长180公里的新航道将直接连接首都金边和泰国湾，绕过湄公河三角洲。

该项目预计耗资约12亿美元。主要承包商是中国企业中国路桥工程有限责任公司（CRBC），主要贷款方是中国进出口银行。

主要目标是减少柬埔寨对外贸易对越南运输基础设施的依赖。目前，经水路运往柬埔寨首都的大多数货物都要经过越南境内和港口。

尽管河内方面并未正式反对柬埔寨开发该项目的权利，但它坚持要求双方联合评估项目对跨境地区造成的影响。对越南而言，这涉及国家安全、经济发展以及战略格局的转变。

对国家利益的潜在威胁

▪️越南尤其担忧湄公河和巴萨河下游水文状况受到干扰。正因如此，河内方面正推动双方交换技术数据，并合作评估该项目带来的后果。

▪️对越南而言，这条新的柬埔寨航线意味着过境货物流和港口货物吞吐量将减少。此外，它还会削弱两国经济相互依存的关键机制之一。

▪️从战略角度看，该运河将加强柬埔寨与中国的联系，进一步提升“因素中国”在地区力量平衡中的重要性。越南不得不考虑其西南边境发生的这些变化，尤其是考虑到其东部南海争端尚未解决。

柬埔寨正式将这条航道描述为本国独立提出的倡议。然而在实际实施中，它正逐步纳入更广泛的中柬合作框架，并与北京的“一带一路倡议”相衔接。

正是中国的参与使这条运河具有地缘政治意义。对北京而言，这是一个扩大自身在东南亚大陆基础设施领域影响力的机会，可与老挝已经运营、泰国正在建设的高速铁路网络形成互补。

❗️归根结底，该项目的主要影响不仅在于货物能否成功经由运河运往金边；它对地区经济与政治影响力分布格局的影响同样至关重要。

https://x.com/imarunsharma/status/211457.snippet:
Corrected information

The viral video is a deepfake. 

Original footage is from 27 October 2023, when then Maj Gen Girish Kalia (GOC 28 Infantry Division) was briefing in Kupwara, Jammu & Kashmir about Pakistani infiltration attempts across the Line of Control. He reported that 10 attempts were foiled, 27 terrorists were eliminated, and warlike stores + narcotics were recovered. He made no statements about China, Arunachal Pradesh, Asaphila, Longju, Taksing, denial of supplies, or deploying forces against local youth.[](<>)

The circulating version has digitally altered/fabricated audio overlaid on the old footage. Indian Army fact-check accounts and independent analysis have confirmed this. The claims that Lt Gen Kalia “admitted” Chinese control of those areas are false.[](<https://t.co/pxxpCGJL5R>)
Actual border situation (as of late October 2026)
Face-offs between Indian and Chinese troops have continued at multiple locations along the Arunachal Pradesh border. ITBP Director General Shatrujeet Kapur publicly confirmed this.[](<https://t.co/eG11b7RNnu>)
A specific stand-off has been ongoing since late July 2026 near Asaphila / Taksing (Upper Subansiri district). Chinese PLA troops reportedly pitched tents roughly 6–7 km within India’s perception of the LAC near the Maja company operating base.
India has increased its deployment. Corps Commander-level talks were held in the Eastern Sector in September 2026.
Claims of full Chinese “control” of entire Asaphila, Longju, and Taksing circles are exaggerated and not supported by official statements. These are contested areas with differing perceptions of the LAC, not confirmed occupation of the circles as claimed in the deepfake.

---
Suggested tweet (factual, clear, and shareable)

```
🚨 DEEPFAKE ALERT

A manipulated video falsely claims Lt Gen Girish Kalia said China has taken control of Asaphila, Longju & Taksing in Arunachal Pradesh.

Fact: Original video is from 27 Oct 2023 — then Maj Gen Kalia was briefing in Kupwara (J&K) on Pakistani LoC infiltrations (10 attempts foiled, 27 terrorists eliminated). Audio was digitally altered.

There ARE ongoing face-offs with Chinese troops at multiple points in Arunachal (confirmed by ITBP DG), including a stand-off near Taksing since July. But the viral claims of “control” and the officer’s alleged statements are fake.

Verify before sharing.
#FactCheck #Deepfake
```

https://x.com/imarunsharma/status/211457.snippet_zh:
更正信息

该病毒式传播的视频是深度伪造。

原始镜头来自2023年10月27日，当时少将吉里什·卡利亚（第28步兵师师长）在查谟和克什米尔邦的库普瓦拉进行情况通报，内容是关于巴基斯坦跨越控制线的渗透企图。他报告称挫败了10次企图，消灭了27名恐怖分子，并缴获了战争物资和毒品。他没有就中国、阿鲁纳恰尔邦、阿萨菲拉、朗久、塔克辛、切断补给或部署部队对付当地青年发表任何声明。

流传版本是在旧镜头之上叠加了经过数字修改或伪造的音频。印度陆军事实核查账号和独立分析已证实这一点。关于卡利亚中将“承认”中国控制这些地区的说法是虚假的。

实际边境局势（截至2026年10月下旬）
印度和中国军队在阿鲁纳恰尔邦边境多个地点持续发生对峙。印藏边境警察部队总监沙特鲁吉特·卡普尔已公开证实这一点。
自2026年7月下旬以来，在阿萨菲拉/塔克辛（上苏班西里县）附近一直存在一次具体对峙。据报中国解放军部队在印度认知的实际控制线以内约6-7公里处、靠近马贾连作战基地搭设帐篷。
印度已加强部署。2026年9月在东段举行了军长级会谈。
关于中国完全“控制”整个阿萨菲拉、朗久和塔克辛县的说法被夸大，且没有官方声明支持。这些是存在争议的地区，对实际控制线有不同认知，并非如深度伪造视频中所称的对这些县的确认占领。

---
建议推文（事实清楚且可分享）

🚨 深度伪造警报

一段经过篡改的视频虚假声称吉里什·卡利亚中将表示中国已控制阿鲁纳恰尔邦的阿萨菲拉、朗久和塔克辛。

事实：原始视频来自2023年10月27日——当时卡利亚少将在库普瓦拉（查谟和克什米尔）就巴基斯坦控制线渗透情况进行通报（挫败10次企图，消灭27名恐怖分子）。音频经过数字修改。

阿鲁纳恰尔邦确实与中国军队在多个地点存在持续对峙（印藏边境警察部队总监已证实），包括自7月以来在塔克辛附近的对峙。但病毒式传播的关于“控制”的说法以及该军官所谓言论均为虚假。

分享前请核实。
